Switching to this weapon while you are damaged strongly increases its handling for a short duration.

desc.zh: 快速治疗盟友可为你提供固有特性元素增益。该增益对你和盟友都更为强效。

desc.en: While you are not Charged with Light, any kill or assist has a small cumulative chance to cause you to become Charged with Light.
desc.zh: 若你未充斥光能，任意击杀或助攻将有少量累积几率使你充斥光能。

desc.en: Rounds at the end of the magazine deal more damage. Improved damage starts earlier in the magazine.
desc.zh: 弹匣中最后的几发弹药可造成更高伤害。弹匣中更高伤害的弹药增多。

desc.en: Adds a pink rabbit crest to your transmat effects.
desc.zh: 为你的传送效果添加一个粉色兔子纹章。

desc.en: Gradually reloads your stowed Submachine Guns over time. Multiple copies of this perk stack to reduce the time taken to fully reload.
desc.zh: 随着时间推移，逐渐为已收起的微型冲锋枪装填弹药。此特性的效果可以叠加，以缩短完全重新装弹的耗时。

desc.en: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
desc.zh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

desc.en: Slightly reduces zoom magnification.
desc.zh: 小幅降低变焦倍率。

desc.en: Defeating a Void-debuffed target grants an overshield that lasts for an improved duration.
desc.zh: 消灭虚空减益目标可提供覆盖护盾，持续时间延长。

desc.en: While surrounded by multiple combatants, defeating a combatant with a Fusion Rifle, Shotgun, Sidearm, or Submachine Gun adds ammo for that weapon to your reserves.
desc.zh: 当被多名战斗人员包围时，以融合步枪、霰弹枪、手枪或微型冲锋枪消灭一个战斗人员将向该武器备弹中添加弹药。

desc.en: Blighted targets take damage over time and blight the nearby area on death.
desc.zh: 被凋零的目标会受到持续伤害并在死亡时对附近区域造成凋零效果。

desc.en: Impulse push that suppresses targets' abilities. Strong against [Disruption] Overload Champions.
desc.zh: 可以压制目标技能的斥力。克制过载勇士。

desc.en: With the Operator Augment, you gain periodic bursts of healing when your health is depleted.
desc.zh: 拥有操作员增益时，你会在生命值较低时获得周期性爆发治疗效果。

desc.en: Reloading this weapon after defeating a target overcharges this weapon for a short period of time, causing it to jolt on its next hit.
desc.zh: 击败目标后填装此武器会短时间过充武器，下次命中时震颤敌人。

desc.en: -10 Weapon ▼

Activating your class ability or landing precision hits grants you and nearby allies increased reload speed and Weapons stat for a short duration. Stacks ten times.

Final blows while at ten stacks cure you.
desc.zh:
激活职业技能或造成精准命中可让你和附近盟友在短时间内提升填装速度和武器属性。可叠加十次。

达到十层时造成最后一击将治愈你。

desc.en: Generate gunsmith telemetry data on any elemental weapon final blow.
desc.zh: 在任意元素武器最后一击时生成枪匠遥测数据。

desc.en: Generate gunsmith telemetry data on any elemental weapon final blow at an increased rate.
desc.zh: 在任意元素武器最后一击时以更快的速度生成枪匠遥测数据。

desc.en: Spark of Recovery
desc.zh: 恢复火花

desc.en: Grants slightly increased vent speed and handling.
desc.zh: 略微提升排气速度和操控性。

desc.en: Summon your Throwing Hammer back to you.
desc.zh: 将你的投掷飞锤召回。

desc.en: Increases the maximum number of Dynamic Charge stacks.
desc.zh: 增加动态充能的最高堆叠层数。

desc.en: Holding down the trigger increases rate of fire. Final blows while spun up grant bonus Special ammo progress.  [Alternate Weapon Action]  to swap to Dual Speed Receiver.
desc.zh: 按住扳机可提升射速。旋转加速期间造成最后一击可提供特殊弹药进度加成。按下[替换武器动作] 切换至双重速率接收器。

desc.en: Detect caches or resources within a 30-meter range while on the Tangled Shore.
desc.zh: 在纷争海岸上探测30米范围内的缓存箱或资源。

desc.en: +10 Vent Speed
desc.zh: +10排气速度

desc.en: Guardians you make invisible gain damage resistance.
desc.zh: 被你隐形的守护者获得伤害抗性。

desc.en: Threadling damage increases this weapon's damage.
desc.zh: 线虫伤害可提升此武器的伤害。

desc.en: Combatant weapon final blows with a damage type that matches your subclass element have an escalating chance to spawn an elemental well.
desc.zh: 用符合你的分支职业元素类型的伤害类型取得战斗人员武器最后一击有更高几率生成元素井。

desc.en: Arrows fired through a Guidance Ring release seeking projectiles, which scorch targets and do more damage based on distance traveled. Precision hits help guide these seekers toward their targets.
desc.zh: 穿过指引光环的箭会放出追踪射弹灼烧目标，离目标距离越远，命中后伤害越高。精准命中可帮助追踪弹锁定目标。

desc.en: Reduces flinching from incoming fire while aiming Submachine Guns.
desc.zh: 降低使用微型冲锋枪瞄准时因受到伤害而产生的画面颤动。

desc.en:
Your Glacier, Duskfield, Coldsnap, and Shatter grenades have enhanced functionality.

Glacier Grenade: Adds a [Stasis] Stasis crystal and changes the formation.

Duskfield Grenade: Increases slow-field size and creates a small [Stasis] Stasis crystal on impact.

Coldsnap Grenade: Seekers duplicate after freezing a target and create a [Stasis] Stasis crystal on detonation.

Shatter Grenade: Creates additional shrapnel projectiles on detonation. Hitting frozen targets with this grenade refunds some grenade energy.
desc.zh:
你的冰川、暮域、急冻和碎裂手雷的功能增强。

冰川手雷：增加一个冰影水晶，并改变其结构。

暮域手雷：扩大减速力场的范围，并在撞击时生成一个小冰影水晶。

急冻手雷：追踪弹在冻结目标后将会复制，并在引爆时生成冰影水晶。

碎裂手雷：引爆时产生额外碎片射弹。用此手雷命中被冻结的目标会返还部分手雷能量。

desc.en: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
desc.zh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

desc.en: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
desc.zh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

desc.en: One-shot, status effect grenades.
desc.zh: 发射单发的状态效果榴弹。

desc.en: Rapidly defeating combatants with explosive damage spawns a Solar elemental well.
desc.zh: 使用爆炸伤害快速消灭战斗人员可产生一个烈日元素井。

desc.en:
You have an additional grenade charge.

Your Grappling Hook creates a Grapple Tangle at the grapple point.
desc.zh:
你拥有一次额外手雷充能。

你的抓钩会在抓取点生成一个抓取缠结。

desc.en: Substantially improved handling and reload speed when allies are nearby.
desc.zh: 友军在附近时，大幅提高操控性和填装速度。

desc.en: Grants access to Helmet armor mods that combine the effects of the Strand Siphon and Arc Siphon mods.
desc.zh: 可使用将缚丝虹吸与电弧虹吸模组效果相结合的头盔护甲模组。

desc.en: The armor energy costs of all armor mods affecting your melee are significantly discounted.
desc.zh: 影响近战所有护甲模组的护甲能量花费均享有大量折扣。

desc.en: The armor energy costs of all armor mods affecting your Strand weapons are significantly discounted.
desc.zh: 影响缚丝武器的所有护甲模组的护甲能量花费均享有大量折扣。

desc.en: The armor energy costs of all armor mods affecting your Void weapons are significantly discounted.
desc.zh: 影响虚空武器的所有护甲模组的护甲能量花费均享有大量折扣。

desc.en: The armor energy costs of all armor mods affecting your Arc weapons are significantly discounted.
desc.zh: 影响电弧武器所有护甲模组的护甲能量花费均享有大量折扣。

desc.en: Rapid final blows against weakened combatants grant you Devour.
desc.zh: 对被削弱的战斗人员造成快速最后一击为你提供吞食效果。

desc.en: Shortly after guarding with a Sword, your light and heavy attacks stun unshielded combatants. Strong against [Stagger] Unstoppable Champions.
desc.zh: 使用刀剑格挡后不久，你的轻攻击与重攻击会眩晕没有护盾的战斗人员。克制势不可挡勇士。

desc.en: Machine Gun rapid final blows heal you.
desc.zh: 机枪快速最后一击会治疗你。

desc.en: Finisher final blows grant grenade and melee energy.
desc.zh: 终结技最后一击提供手雷和近战能量。

desc.en: Breaking a combatant's shield grants increased weapon stability, handling, and reload speed. Swords gain increased guard resistance.
desc.zh: 打破战斗人员的护盾可以提高武器的稳定性、操控性和填装速度。刀剑可获得更高的防御抗性。

desc.en: Precision hits with Bows and Sniper Rifles grant a stacking bonus to their reload speed.
desc.zh: 使用弓箭和狙击步枪的精准命中会为其填装速度提供可叠加的加成。

desc.en: Sustained Kinetic weapon damage and rapid final blows have a chance to generate a unique ammo brick. Collecting this brick will grant ammo to equipped Kinetic damage weapons and grant Special and Heavy ammo progress.
desc.zh: 持续的动能武器伤害和快速最后一击有几率生成独特弹药盒。拾取该弹药盒会为已装备的动能伤害武器提供弹药，同时提供特殊和重型弹药进度。

desc.en:
Solar weapon final blows grant you and your allies increased health for a short duration. Stacks 3 times.

While Ember of Tempering is active, your weapons have increased airborne effectiveness, and your Solar weapon final blows create a Firesprite.
desc.zh:
烈日武器最后一击可让你和盟友在短时间内获得更高的生命值。可叠加3层。

激活回火余烬时，你的武器将拥有更高的空中效率，并且烈日武器最后一击可生成一个焰灵。

desc.en: Nova Bomb travels slowly and seeks enemies. Detonations shatter into smaller seeker projectiles. Fire your weapon at the Nova Bomb to detonate it early.
desc.zh: 新星炸弹会缓慢移动并追踪敌人。发生爆炸时会碎裂成较小的追踪性弹头。使用武器射击新星炸弹可提前引爆它。

desc.en: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
desc.zh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

desc.en: Improved target acquisition, accuracy, and aim-down-sights speed for Hand Cannons.
desc.zh: 改善手炮的目标捕获能力、精度和瞄准速度。

desc.en: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
desc.zh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

desc.en: Your equipped Auto Rifles fire shield-piercing rounds and stun [Shield-Piercing] Barrier Champions.
desc.zh: 你装备的自动步枪会发射护盾穿透子弹并眩晕屏障勇士。

desc.en: Reduces recoil for the equipped Kinetic weapon.
desc.zh: 降低已装备动能武器的后坐力。

desc.en: Grants additional damage to your Super against Nightmare Hunt bosses. This benefit does not stack with other mods that provide the same or greater benefit.
desc.zh: 在对抗梦魇狩猎首领时，你的超能可造成额外伤害。此增益无法与其他提供同样或更高效果的模组叠加。

desc.en: Grants additional damage to your Super against Nightmare Hunt bosses. This benefit does not stack with other mods that provide the same or greater benefit.
desc.zh: 在对抗梦魇狩猎首领时，你的超能可造成额外伤害。此增益无法与其他提供同样或更高效果的模组叠加。

desc.en: Your Stasis weapons gain a small bonus to damage while you have any Armor Charge. Your Armor Charge now decays over time.
desc.zh: 在拥有任何护甲充能时，你的冰影武器会获得小幅额外伤害加成。你的护甲充能现在会逐渐衰减。

desc.en: Causing damage with this weapon reduces recoil and flinch over time. Improves base stability.
desc.zh: 使用此武器造成伤害可逐渐减少后坐力和抖动。提高基础稳定性。

desc.en: The Void rocket suppresses combatants. The Solar rocket scorches.
desc.zh: 虚空火箭压制战斗人员。烈日火箭可造成灼烧。

desc.en: Rapid Sword strikes increase this weapon's damage for an improved duration. Guarding ends the effect.
desc.zh: 快速刀剑打击将增加此武器的伤害，持续时间延长。防御将中断此效果。

desc.en: Reduces flinching from incoming fire while aiming Bows.
desc.zh: 降低弓瞄时因受到伤害而产生的画面颤动。

desc.en: Defeating a combatant with your Super spawns an elemental well that matches your subclass energy type.
desc.zh: 用超能击败战斗人员会生成一个符合你的分支职业能量类型的元素井。

desc.en: Landing multiple hits turns your next shot into a homing micro-missile.
desc.zh: 造成多次命中会将你的下一发子弹变成一枚制导微型导弹。

desc.en: Once activated, walk into the portal on the Relocator Pad to teleport to the Exit Pad.
desc.zh: 激活后，走进重定位器板上的传送门来传送到出口板。

n.en: Once activated, walk into the portal on the Relocator Pad to teleport to the Exit Pad.
n.zh: 激活后，走进重定位器板上的传送门来传送到出口板。

desc.en: Swapping to a Heat weapon, Submachine Gun, or Hand Cannon grants a short period of increased handling and accuracy. This effect is extended by dealing damage with that weapon.
desc.zh: 切换到热量武器、微型冲锋枪或手炮会在短时间内提升操控性和精度。使用该武器造成伤害可延长此效果。

desc.en: Dealing final blows while Reflex Action is active grants a bonus to weapon stat and increases stability, reload, and aim assist for Heat weapons, Submachine Guns, and Hand Cannons for a moderate duration.
desc.zh: 在反射动作生效时造成最后一击会获得武器属性提升，并在一定时间内提升热量武器、微型冲锋枪和手炮的稳定性、填装和瞄准辅助。

desc.en:
Throwing a grenade or hitting a target with a charged melee grants a stacking bonus to weapon stability, handling, and range.

Using a Super grants maximum stacks.
desc.zh:
投掷手雷或使用充能近战击中目标可提供武器稳定性、操控性和射程叠加加成。

使用超能可提供最大叠加次数。

desc.en: Deals bonus damage to targets with overshields. Deals a small amount of bonus damage to combatant shields.
desc.zh: 对拥有覆盖护盾的目标造成额外伤害。对战斗人员的护盾造成少量额外伤害。

desc.en: Improves Glaive melee. Glaive projectile final blows cause detonations.
desc.zh: 提升偃月近战。偃月射弹最后一击会引起爆炸。

desc.en: Increases this armor's resilience, allowing you to absorb more damage.
desc.zh: 提高这件护甲的韧性，以提高你的伤害接受能力。

desc.en: Bonus socket for stat adjustments.
desc.zh: 用于属性调整的额外插槽。

desc.en: Increases the radius and damage of Dragonfly.
desc.zh: 提高蜻蜓的爆炸范围和伤害。

desc.en: Void sources deal increased damage to weakened targets.
desc.zh: 虚空来源对被削弱目标造成的伤害增加。

desc.en: While you have Armor Charge, dealing damage with a Sword consumes an Armor Charge and empowers your Sword for a short time, granting it bonus damage and energy charge rate.
desc.zh: 当你有护甲充能时，使用刀剑造成伤害会消耗护甲充能，并在短时间内为你的刀剑赋能，使其获得额外伤害和充能速度。

desc.en: When you cast your Super, each member of your fireteam with a Super type different than yours gains a bonus to weapon damage.
desc.zh: 施放超能时，你的火力战队中与你的超能类型不同的每位成员可获得武器伤害加成。

desc.en: When you have an Arc or Prismatic subclass equipped, Arc final blows while you are amplified summon a burst of lightning that damages and jolts targets.
desc.zh: 装备电弧或棱镜分支职业的情况下，处于增幅状态时造成电弧最后一击可召唤出一道闪电，伤害并震颤目标。

desc.en: Sniper Rifle hits grant stacking Sniper Rifle damage, stability, and reload bonuses for a short time. Heavy ammo Sniper Rifle hits count as more than one.
desc.zh: 狙击步枪命中会在短时间内提供可叠加的狙击步枪伤害、稳定性和填装加成。重型弹药狙击步枪命中被视为多次命中。

desc.en:
Gain increased grenade and melee damage while transcendent.

Weapon final blows while transcendent refund Light and Dark energy after Transcendence ends.
desc.zh:
处于超凡状态时，可获得更高的手雷和 近战伤害。

处于超凡状态时，武器最后一击在超凡结束后可返还光能和暗影能量。

desc.en:
While you have Woven Mail, Frost Armor, or a Void Overshield, your melee recharges faster and deals increased damage.

While you are amplified or radiant, your grenade recharges faster and deals increased damage.
desc.zh:
当你拥有织造铠甲、冰霜护甲或虚空覆盖护盾时，你的 近战充能会更快，造成的伤害也会增加。

当你处于增幅或焕光状态时，你的 手雷充能会更快，造成的伤害也会增加。

desc.en: Reloading a short time after a final blow also reloads stowed weapons.
desc.zh: 最后一击后短时间内进行填装时可以为收起的武器也进行填装。

desc.en: Adds a pumpkin appearance to your transmat effects.
desc.zh: 为你的传送效果添加一个南瓜外观。

desc.en: Increases ammo and reserves but reduces damage, blast radius, and reload speed.
desc.zh: 可提升弹药和备弹，但会减少伤害、爆炸范围和填装速度。

desc.en: Increases reload speed of Grenade Launchers.
desc.zh: 提高榴弹发射器的填装速度。

desc.en:
While this weapon is equipped, taking damage accelerates its next reload.

Taking more damage increases the effect.
desc.zh:
装备此武器时，受到伤害可加速其下次重新填装。

受到更多伤害可提升此效果。

desc.en: Fires a stable beam of pure Arc energy.
desc.zh: 发射一束稳定的纯净电弧能量。

desc.en: Adds a rainbow appearance to your transmat effects.
desc.zh: 为你的传送效果添加一个彩虹外观。

desc.en: Increased reload, stability, and handling when enemies are in close proximity.
desc.zh: 当敌人接近时，填装速度、稳定性和操控性均会提高。

desc.en: Final blows with this weapon have a chance to create experimental submunitions at the target's location.
desc.zh: 用此武器造成最后一击，将有几率在目标位置产生实验性子弹药。

desc.en: [Alternate Weapon Action]  : Consume the magazine and load a more powerful round.
desc.zh: [替换武器动作]  ： 消耗弹匣以填充一枚更强大的弹药。

desc.en: Recurve. Charge quick, move fast.
desc.zh: 反曲弓。快速拉弓，移动迅速。

desc.en:
Substantially increases stats based on the currently equipped Super.
• [Solar] increases your reload speed.
• [Arc] increases handling.
• [Void] increases stability.
• [Stasis] moderately controls recoil and increases movement speed when aiming down sights.
• [Strand] increases airborne effectiveness.
desc.zh:
根据当前装备的超能显著增加属性。
•  加快填装速度。
•  增加操控性。
•  增加稳定性。
•  适度地控制后坐力，并提高瞄准时的移动速度。
•  提升空中效率。

desc.en: Reduces melee cooldown each time you pick up an Orb of Power.
desc.zh: 每次拾取能量球都将缩短近战技能的冷却时间。

desc.en: Increases the reload speed of Machine Guns.
desc.zh: 提高机枪的填装速度。

desc.en: Damaging unraveled targets with a weapon occasionally spawns a threadling.
desc.zh: 用武器伤害被瓦解的目标有时会产生一个线虫。
tier5_mod3

desc.en:
Shattering frozen targets and Stasis crystals deals increased damage.

Shattering Stasis crystals releases shards of ice that damage and slow targets.
desc.zh:
击碎被冻结目标和冰影水晶会造成更多伤害。

击碎冰影水晶会释放出伤害并减慢目标速度的冰影碎片。

desc.en: Firing a Rocket Launcher consumes one stack of Armor Charge, granting increased damage and reload speed until you reload or stow your Rocket Launcher.
desc.zh: 发射火箭发射器会消耗一层护甲充能，在你填装或收起火箭发射器前可提升伤害和填装速度。
tier5_mod4

desc.en: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
desc.zh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

desc.en: Greatly increases ready and stow speed for Sidearms.
desc.zh: 大幅提高手枪的收举速度。

desc.en: Breaking a combatant's shield with this weapon makes them more vulnerable to Kinetic damage for an improved duration.
desc.zh: 使用武器破坏战斗人员的护盾，使他们对动能伤害的承受力更低，持续时间延长。

desc.en:
Perfectly drawn arrows that detonate Sacred Flames increase arrow damage.

Striking targets unaffected by Sacred Flame instead refreshes Causality Arrows' duration.
desc.zh:
完美的搭弓射箭会引爆神圣之焰，提升箭矢伤害。

击中未收到神圣之焰影响的目标会刷新因果箭矢的持续时间。

desc.en: Detect resources within a 30-meter range while on the moon Titan.
desc.zh: 在土卫六上探测30米范围内的资源。

desc.en:
Periodically marks a nearby combatant as a priority target for you and your team. Entering invisibility immediately marks a target.

Defeating priority targets creates a weakening cloud of smoke that makes you and allies invisible when passing through it. 

When priority targets are defeated, you and nearby allies gain increased weapon reload speed and stability for a short duration and are granted grenade, melee, and class ability energy.
desc.zh:
周期性将附近的一名战斗人员标记为你和你队伍的首要目标。进入隐形状态会立即标记一个目标。

击败首要目标会生成具有削弱效果的烟雾云，你和盟友穿过它时会获得隐身状态。

当首要目标被击败时，你和附近的盟友会在短时间内提升武器填装速度和稳定性，并获得手雷、近战和职业技能能量。

desc.en: When your grenade energy is fully expended, your Armor Charge is consumed and you gain grenade energy for each Armor Charge used.
desc.zh: 在手雷能量完全耗尽时，你的护甲充能会被消耗，每一层被消耗的护甲充能都会赋予你额外的手雷能量。

desc.en: Gain a powerful overshield while performing your finisher.
desc.zh: 在使用终结技时获得一个强大的力场护盾。

desc.en: Greatly increases reload speed of Hand Cannons, Sidearms, Submachine Guns, and Bows.
desc.zh: 大幅提高手炮、手枪、微型冲锋枪和弓箭的填装速度。

n.zh: 强化型小型武器装填装置

desc.en: Adds a green Dawning lantern to your transmat effects.
desc.zh: 为你的传送效果添加一个绿色曙光灯笼。

desc.en: Greatly increases charge rate and guard resistance.
desc.zh: 大幅提升充能速度和防御抗性。

desc.en: Primary ammo weapons do increased damage to [Stasis] Stasis crystals and frozen targets.
desc.zh: 主弹药武器对冰影水晶以及被冻结的目标造成更多伤害。

desc.en: Nearby [Stasis] Stasis shards track to your position.
desc.zh: 附近的冰影碎片会追踪至你的位置。

desc.en: Your Frost Armor has increased duration and maximum stack count.
desc.zh: 你的冰霜护甲拥有更久的持续时间和最大层数。

desc.en: Increases the melee energy gained from picking up [Stasis] Stasis shards.
desc.zh: 增加拾取冰影碎片时得到的近战能量。

desc.en:
Defeating Cabal Centurions grants Gunsmith Materials.

Mod does not stack.
desc.zh:
消灭卡巴尔百夫长可获得枪匠材料。

模组无法叠加。

desc.en:
Sustained damage from this weapon exhausts the target for an improved duration.

Exhausted targets deal reduced outgoing damage.
desc.zh:
此武器的持续伤害会在更长时间内使目标疲惫。

疲惫的目标造成的伤害会减少。

desc.en: High damage, high recoil.
desc.zh: 高伤害，高后坐力。

desc.en: Grants additional rewards when you're defeating Scorn.
desc.zh: 当击败嗤魅时有机会获得额外奖励。

desc.en: Grants a chance to receive an extra Vanguard token whenever you get one.
desc.zh: 任何时间得到一枚先锋代币时都有几率获得一枚额外代币。

desc.en:
Collecting an Elemental pickup or destroying a Tangle grants this weapon a stacking period of increased damage. Throwing a Tangle provides additional time.

Elemental pickups include [Solar]Firesprites, [Void]Void Breaches, [Arc]Ionic Traces, [Stasis]Stasis Shards, and [Strand]Strand Tangles.
desc.zh:
收集一个元素拾取物或摧毁缠结会赋予此武器一段叠加期，期间提升伤害。投掷缠结会延长持续时间。

元素拾取物包括焰灵、虚空裂口、离子轨迹、冰影碎片和缚丝缠结。

desc.en: Highlights nearby loot caches on Mercury for you and your fireteam.
desc.zh: 为你和你的火力战队在水星上标记出位于附近的战利品缓存箱。

desc.en: Sword final blows grant increased charge rate and defense until this weapon is stowed.
desc.zh: 刀剑最后一击可提高充能速度和防御，效果持续至收起此武器。

desc.en: This weapon adapts its damage output and effectiveness against energy shields that don't match the weapon's damage type.
desc.zh: 此武器可调整其伤害输出和效率来对抗与其伤害类型不匹配的能量护盾。

desc.en: This transmat effect may be awarded in pink or purple color variants.
desc.zh: 此传送效果可能出现粉色或紫色变幻。

desc.en: Slightly increases the range at which radar detects enemies.
desc.zh: 在雷达监测到敌人时，侦测范围略微提高。

desc.en: Spending a Defiant Key at the end of a Season of Defiance Battleground in which you received Favors of Grace, Justice, and Zeal will award an additional Defiant Engram and War Table reputation.
desc.zh: 在你获得优雅、正义和狂热恩惠的抗战赛季战场结束时，花费抗战密钥可奖励额外抗战记忆水晶和战争圆桌声望。

desc.en: This visual effect is suppressed while in combat.
desc.zh: 此视觉效果在战斗中会被压制。

desc.en: Your Solar ignitions have increased area of effect.
desc.zh: 你的烈日点燃范围效果获得提升。

desc.en: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
desc.zh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

desc.en: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
desc.zh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

desc.en: Greatly increases the weapon's ready speed and aim down sights speed temporarily after sprinting.
desc.zh: 在冲刺后短暂地大幅提升武器的准备速度和瞄准速度。

desc.en: Final blows and precision hits build up Dynamic Charge. Swapping to Arc Seeker mode increases damage and partially reloads the magazine based on the number of charges. Charged Arc Seeker hits grant, and can spend, Bolt Charge.
desc.zh: 最后一击和精准命中会积累动态充能。切换至电弧追踪弹模式时，根据充能数量增加伤害并填装部分弹匣。充能电弧追踪弹命中可获得和消耗电光充能。

desc.en: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
desc.zh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

desc.en: The armor energy costs of all armor mods affecting your Strand weapons are significantly discounted.
desc.zh: 影响缚丝武器的所有护甲模组的护甲能量花费均享有大量折扣。

desc.en: The armor energy costs of all armor mods affecting your Void weapons are significantly discounted.
desc.zh: 影响虚空武器的所有护甲模组的护甲能量花费均享有大量折扣。

desc.en: The armor energy costs of all armor mods affecting your Solar weapons are significantly discounted.
desc.zh: 影响烈日武器的所有护甲模组的护甲能量花费均享有大量折扣。

desc.en: The armor energy costs of all armor mods affecting your grenades are significantly discounted.
desc.zh: 影响手雷的所有护甲模组的护甲能量花费均享有大量折扣。

desc.en: Grants access to armor mods in your helmet that combine the effects of the Strand Siphon mod with the Solar Siphon and Void Siphon mods.
desc.zh: 可在头盔中使用将缚丝虹吸模组与烈日虹吸及虚空虹吸模组效果相结合的护甲模组。

desc.en: Swap between scopes to alter firing mode. Strong against [Stagger] Unstoppable Champions.
desc.zh: 切换瞄准镜来改变射击模式。克制势不可挡勇士。

desc.en:
Defeating Cabal combatants grants a small amount of Glimmer.

Mod does not stack.
desc.zh:
消灭卡巴尔战斗人员可获得少量微光。

模组无法叠加。

desc.en:
Arc melee abilities recharge faster.
  •  Stacks up to 3 times
desc.zh:
提高电弧近战技能充能速度。
  •  最高可叠加3次

desc.en: Fires a single slug round.
desc.zh: 发射单发弹头。

desc.en:
Activate your Barricade ability to create a ripple in reality that travels forward along the ground, suspending and damaging the targets it hits.

Final blows on targets affected by Suspend, Unravel, or Sever grant class ability energy.

This ability's damage increases with your Class stat when your Class stat is 100 or higher.
desc.zh:
激活屏障技能来在现实世界中生成一道沿着地面向前传播的涟漪，悬停击中的目标并对其造成伤害。

对受到悬停、瓦解或断舍影响的目标造成最后一击可获得职业技能能量。

当你的职业属性达到100或更高时，此技能伤害会根据职业属性而增加。

desc.en:
ASPECT OF INFLUENCE
Purchase this Stasis Aspect from the Exo Stranger on Europa after completing the Beyond Light campaign.
desc.zh:
感应之星相
在完成凌光之刻战役后，从木卫二上的Exo陌客处购买此冰影星相。

desc.en: This visual effect is suppressed while in combat.
desc.zh: 此视觉效果在战斗中会被抑制。

desc.en: Increases the damage and size of the burst of [Stasis] Stasis when you destroy a [Stasis] Stasis crystal or defeat a frozen target.
desc.zh: 摧毁冰影结晶或消灭被冻结的目标时，提高 冰影的伤害和爆炸范围。

desc.en: Increases magazine size. While you are the last living member of your fireteam, each final blow refills your magazine.
desc.zh: 提高弹匣容量。如果你是火力战队中唯一生还的成员，每次最后一击都会为你回满弹匣。

desc.en: Increased damage against Taken enemies.
desc.zh: 提高对傀儡敌人的伤害。

desc.en: Damaging a Glyphkeeper with a grenade causes your equipped Pulse Rifles, Sidearms, Machine Guns, and Submachine Guns to deal additional damage.
desc.zh: 使用手雷对雕文守护者造成伤害，可使你装备的脉冲步枪、手枪、机枪和微型冲锋枪造成额外伤害。

desc.en: You apply more scorch stacks to targets.
desc.zh: 你可对目标施加更多灼烧层数。

desc.en:
Increased stats based on the currently equipped Super.
• [Solar] increases your reload speed.
• [Arc] increases handling.
• [Void] increases stability.
• [Stasis] moderately controls recoil and increases movement speed when aiming down sights.
• [Strand] increases airborne effectiveness.
desc.zh:
根据当前装备的超能增加属性。
•  加快填装速度。
•  增加操控性。
•  增加稳定性。
•  适度地控制后坐力，并提高瞄准时的移动速度。
•  提升空中效率。

desc.en: Reduces recoil deviation for the weapon.
desc.zh: 降低武器的后坐力偏转。

desc.en: Increase Glimmer gains by 10% in Strikes.
desc.zh: 在打击中微光获取量提升10%。

desc.en: Exotic drops from encounters in the raids "Leviathan" and "Leviathan, Eater of Worlds" have a 50% chance of being a Year 1 Exotic not already in your collection.
desc.zh: “利维坦”和“世界吞噬者，利维坦”突袭中的遭遇战所掉落的异域装备，有50%的几率是你的收藏中未包含的首年异域装备。

desc.en: Adds an explosion of bones appearance to your transmat effects.
desc.zh: 为你的传送效果添加一个骨头爆炸的外观。

desc.en: Defeating targets with other weapons before drawing this one transfers ammo to the magazine from reserves. This effect can overflow the magazine based on the number of targets defeated.
desc.zh: 拿出此武器前使用其他武器击败目标，可从储备弹药中转移弹药至弹匣。此效果可基于击败目标的数量溢出弹匣。

desc.en: Dealing precision damage to combatants affected by Arc debuffs spawns an Ionic Trace.
desc.zh: 用精准伤害消灭被电弧减益状态影响的战斗人员，会产生一个离子轨迹。

desc.en: Stay amplified longer.
desc.zh: 保持增幅状态更久。

desc.en: Grants bonus Arc Super damage if cast while critically wounded or while amplified. Lasts until the end of the Super activation.
desc.zh: 在重伤或增幅状态下施放可获得电弧超能伤害加成。持续至超能激活结束。

desc.en: Rapid precision hits against distant combatants weaken them for a short duration.
desc.zh: 对远距离战斗人员的快速精准命中会在短时间内削弱他们。

desc.en: After throwing an Arc grenade, gain increased grenade recharge for a short time. Arc final blows extend the duration of this benefit.
desc.zh: 投掷电弧手雷后，短时间内手雷充能速度加快。电弧最后一击会延长此增益的持续时间。

desc.en: After using your class ability, final blows with this weapon grant you bonus damage resistance for a longer duration.
desc.zh: 使用你的职业技能后，使用此武器造成最后一击可在更长的时间内获得额外的伤害抗性。

desc.en: Reloading increases this weapon's damage if you hit with at least half the rounds in the magazine, but fail to defeat anything.
desc.zh: 在消耗了至少一半的弹匣却没有造成击败的情况下，填装会增加武器造成的伤害。

desc.en: Gain 10% more XP while in the Crucible.
desc.zh: 在熔炉竞技场中获取10%的额外经验值。

desc.en:
Greatly increases the chance of a weapon drop from your next Necropolis or Chamber of Suffering encounter in the Pit of Heresy.

Effect lasts until the dungeon encounter is completed.
desc.zh:
大幅提高你在“异端深渊”里的墓地或苦难之穹战斗后武器掉落概率。

此效果将持续到地牢战斗完成为止。

desc.en: Defeating targets with your Stasis Super refunds Super energy.
desc.zh: 使用你的冰影超能击败目标可返还超能能量。

desc.en: Gain bonus Super energy when defeating a combatant near a limb of the Witness.
desc.zh: 击败靠近见证者肢体的战斗人员可获得额外超能能量。

desc.en: Final blows grant a stacking stability, range, and accuracy bonus to this weapon. Precision final blows grant more stacks.
desc.zh: 精准最后一击会赋予该武器可叠加的射程奖励。非精准最后一击将移除叠加射程奖励，但会在所有叠加射程被消除后奖励额外精准度和稳定性。

desc.en: Increases the Class stat.
desc.zh: 提升职业属性。

desc.en: Greatly increases reload speed of Sniper Rifles.
desc.zh: 大幅提高狙击步枪的填装速度。

n.zh: 强化狙击步枪装填装置

desc.en: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
desc.zh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

desc.en: Grants additional Failsafe vendor reputation from all sources. For each piece of armor equipped with this perk, this bonus increases.
desc.zh: 可从所有来源获得额外智能失效保险商人声望。具有此特性的护甲装备得越多，此加成越高。

desc.en: While Charged with Light, using your grenade attack grants you Super energy, consuming all stacks of Charged with Light. The more stacks you have, the more energy you gain, up to a maximum of 50% of your Super energy.
desc.zh: 充斥光能时，使用你的手雷进行攻击可获得超能能量，消耗全部光之充能层数。你拥有的层数越多，你获得的能量越多，最高可获得50%的超能能量。

desc.en: Blight generated increases the longer this weapon remains on a target. Blighted Seekers burrow into targets and explode.
desc.zh: 此武器持续瞄准目标的时间越长，生成的凋零阴影就越多。凋零追踪弹会钻入目标体内并爆炸。

desc.en: Sidearms that use Special ammo get bonus reserves when you pick up Special ammo.
desc.zh: 使用特殊子弹的手枪在拾取特殊弹药时获得额外弹药储量。

desc.en: Increase the amount of Machine Gun ammo you can carry.
desc.zh: 提高可携带的机枪弹药储量。

desc.en:
Defeating targets or dealing damage with this weapon gradually increases range, stability, handling, and reload speed for an improved amount.

Swords gain improved charge rate and guard resistance.
desc.zh:
使用此武器击败目标或造成伤害会逐渐提升其射程、稳定性、操控性、填装速度，提升量更多。

刀剑会获得进一步提升的充能速度和防御抗性。

desc.en: Increases your chances of finding Special ammo while you have a Hand Cannon that uses Special ammo equipped.
desc.zh: 装备使用特殊弹药的手炮后，提高你找到特殊弹药的机会。

desc.en: Freezing or slowing a target grants this weapon faster draw speed for a short period of time.
desc.zh: 冻结或减速目标可在短时间内为此武器提供更快的拉弓速度。

desc.en: +10 Range
desc.zh: +10 射程

desc.en: Spark of Strength
desc.zh: 力量火花

desc.en: [Light Attack]  : Landing three light-attack hits within a short time grants Sword ammo.
desc.zh: [轻攻击]  ：短时间内进行三次轻攻击可提供刀剑的弹药。

desc.en:
Cast your Super to grant Overshield to nearby allies. 

Casting your Barricade grants Overshield to yourself and nearby allies and empowers it, enabling it to slowly regenerate the Overshield of allies bunkering behind it and extend their Overshield duration.
desc.zh:
施放超能来赋予附近盟友覆盖护盾。

施放屏障可赋予自己和附近盟友覆盖护盾，并为其赋能，使其缓慢恢复躲在后面的盟友的覆盖护盾，并延长他们的覆盖护盾持续时间。

desc.en: Greatly increases reload speed of Sidearms.
desc.zh: 大幅提高手枪的填装速度。

desc.en: Improved target acquisition, accuracy, and aim-down-sights speed for Arc weapons.
desc.zh: 改善电弧武器的目标捕获能力、精度和瞄准速度。

desc.en: Weapon kills while in a rift extend the rift's duration.
desc.zh: 在裂痕中的武器击杀延长裂痕的持续时间。

desc.en: Increases reload speed of Linear Fusion Rifles.
desc.zh: 提高线性融合步枪的填装速度。

n.zh: 线性融合步枪装弹装置

desc.en: Powerful combatant final blows with Solar weapons grants Radiant. Must have a Solar subclass equipped.
desc.zh: 使用烈日武器对强力战斗人员造成最后一击可获得焕光效果。必须装备烈日分支职业。

desc.en: Adds beam elements to your transmat effects.
desc.zh: 为你的传送效果添加光束元素。

desc.en: Reviving allies or defeating combatants with finishers reloads this weapon and readies an emergency ammo refill for the next time this weapon runs out of ammo. Handling is improved.
desc.zh: 复活盟友或使用终结技击败战斗人员可填装此武器，并为下次此武器耗尽弹药时储备一次紧急弹药填充。提升操控性。

desc.en: Picking up Special or Heavy ammo loads this weapon even further beyond normal capacity.
desc.zh: 拾取特殊或重型弹药可填装武器至超出正常弹药储存量，储存量进一步提高。

desc.en: [Aim Down Sights]  : Raise shield
desc.zh: [瞄准]  ：举起护盾

desc.en: Heavy attacks surge lightning from the user.
desc.zh: 重攻击会从使用者发出闪电。

desc.en: Charges to fire a high-powered laser. Strong against [Stagger] Unstoppable Champions.
desc.zh: 充能以发射一道高能激光。

desc.en: Aiming this weapon for an improved short period without firing grants bonus range and precision damage that resets after firing or exiting zoom.
desc.zh: 在更短的一小段时间内瞄准此武器而不射击可提高射程和精准伤害，射击或退出瞄准后重置。

desc.en: Hitting an enemy with every pellet in a shot increases melee damage for a short duration.
desc.zh: 一发弹药的所有弹片均命中同一敌人可在短时间内提高近战伤害。

desc.en: Arc and Stasis modal weapon.
desc.zh: 电弧和冰影模型武器。

desc.en: Sprinting increases vent or reload speed for a short time. While at low heat or full magazine, gain increased handling and movement speed when aiming down sights.
desc.zh: 冲刺可在短时间内提升排气或填装速度。处于低热量或满弹匣时，瞄准可获得更高的操控性和移动速度。

desc.en: Melee hits inflict potent corruption that deals increasing damage over time.
desc.zh: 近战命中会施加随时间造成递增伤害的强效腐化。

desc.en: Armor pieces with random stats you acquire will have a guaranteed minimum of 10 Strength, and are more likely to drop with higher Strength.
desc.zh: 你所获得的带有随机属性的护甲保底有10点力量，且很可能掉落时带有更多的力量。

desc.en: By aligning with the Festival Flame, you do a ludicrous amount of damage with Solar power.
desc.zh: 通过与节日之焰结盟，使用烈日能量可造成恐怖程度的伤害。

desc.en: By aligning with the Festival Flame, you do tons of damage with Solar power.
desc.zh: 通过与节日之焰结盟，使用烈日能量可造成惨重的伤害。

desc.en: By aligning with the Festival Flame, you do significantly more damage with Solar power.
desc.zh: 通过与节日之焰结盟，使用烈日能量可造成极多的伤害。

desc.en: By aligning with the Festival Flame, you do a lot more damage with Solar power.
desc.zh: 通过与节日之焰结盟，使用烈日能量可造成更多的伤害。

desc.en: By aligning with the Festival Flame, you do more damage with Solar power.
desc.zh: 通过与节日之焰结盟，使用烈日能量可造成很多的伤害。

desc.en: Increases reload speed of Scout Rifles.

desc.en: Nearby critically wounded allies take reduced damage from combatants. Nearby Aeon Cult allies who do not have the Sect of Vigor role equipped also gain class ability energy while critically wounded.
desc.zh: 战斗人员对附近受重伤的盟友所造成的伤害减少。附近未装备活力学派角色的永劫邪教盟友还会在受重伤时获得职业技能能量。

desc.en: -30 Class ▼
Your Super final blows create extra Orbs of Power for your allies.
desc.zh: 你的超能最后一击会为你的盟友创造出额外的能量球。

desc.en: Reloading this weapon after dealing damage grants the weapon an improved stacking reload speed and handling bonus until stowed.
desc.zh: 造成伤害后填装此武器，可为其叠加更多填装速度并提供操控性加成，直到收起武器。

desc.en: Final blows increase this weapon's damage until it is stowed or reloaded. Improves magazine size.
desc.zh: 完成最后一击可提高此武器的伤害，效果持续至切换或填装武器。提高弹匣容量。

desc.en: Dealing splash damage grants an improved bonus to Grenade stat.
desc.zh: 造成溅射伤害会赋予更多的手雷属性加成。

desc.en:
While sliding, activate your charged melee ability to unleash a devastating uppercut attack that travels along the ground in front of you, damaging and jolting targets it hits.

Defeating jolted targets grants a stack of Bolt Charge.
desc.zh:
在滑行时，激活你的充能近战技能，沿着你前方的地面施展一次毁灭性的上挑攻击，对命中的目标造成伤害并使其震颤。

击败被震颤的目标可提供一层电光充能。

desc.en: Defeating targets with your Stasis Super refunds Super energy.
desc.zh: 使用你的冰影超能击败目标可返还超能能量。

desc.en: Adds a Black Garden appearance to your transmat effects.
desc.zh: 为你的传送效果添加一个黑暗花园外观。

desc.en: Adds Vex effects to your transmat effects.
desc.zh: 为你的传送效果添加一个Vex效果。

desc.en: Gain further increased Sword lunge distance immediately after switching to this weapon.
desc.zh: 切换到此武器后立即大幅提高刀剑前冲距离。

desc.en: This weapon gains increased damage and handling from final blows with grenades or this weapon for an improved duration.
desc.zh: 使用手雷或此武器获得最后一击可提高此武器的伤害和操控性，持续时间延长。

desc.en: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
desc.zh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

desc.en: Your [Arc] Arc, [Solar] Solar, and [Void] Void abilities deal increased damage to targets afflicted with Darkness debuffs.
desc.zh: 你的电弧、烈日和虚空技能会对受到暗影减益效果影响的目标造成更多伤害。

desc.en: Gain damage resistance against combatants while sprinting.
desc.zh: 在冲刺时获得对战斗人员的伤害减免。

desc.en: This weapon is more effective against combatant shields. Destroying a shield with this weapon grants bonus Special ammo progress if it uses Primary or Heavy ammo, or Heavy ammo progress if it uses Special ammo.
desc.zh: 此武器对战斗人员护盾更有效。使用此武器摧毁护盾时，若使用的是主武器或重型弹药，则提供额外的特殊弹药进度；若使用的是特殊弹药，则提供重型弹药进度。

desc.en: Improves reload speed for equipped Kinetic weapon.
desc.zh: 提高已装备动能武器的填装速度。

desc.en: Gradually reloads your stowed Void weapons over time.
desc.zh: 逐渐填装你已收起的虚空武器。

desc.en: Fires self-propelled micro-missiles that explode on impact for high damage.
desc.zh: 发射自推进微型导弹。命中时会爆炸，造成高额伤害。

desc.en: Gain Super energy on Machine Gun final blows.
desc.zh: 机枪最后一击获得超能能量。

desc.en: Rockets attach on impact and detonate after a delay. Increases blast radius and damage.
desc.zh: 火箭会在碰撞时粘附，延迟一定时间后引爆。爆炸范围扩大且伤害提高。

desc.en: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
desc.zh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

desc.en: Damage type matches your grenade.
desc.zh: 伤害类型与你的手雷相匹配。

desc.en: +5 Grenade ▲ / -5 Super ▼
Increases the damage bonus of Honed Edge when four bullets are consumed.
desc.zh: 消耗四颗子弹时，砥砺刀锋会造成更多伤害。

desc.en:
Void melee abilities [Stagger] stun unshielded combatants.

Strong against [Stagger] Unstoppable Champions.
desc.zh:
虚空近战技能会眩晕没有护盾的战斗人员。

克制势不可挡勇士。

desc.en: Adds an Osiris theme to your transmat effects.
desc.zh: 为你的传送效果添加一个奥斯里斯主题。

desc.en: Improves Hellion.
desc.zh: 提升地狱火。

desc.en: Increases reload speed and stability. While Release the Wolves is active, damaging targets with this weapon applies Scorch. When aiming down sights, defeating a target spreads Scorch to those nearby.
desc.zh: 提升填装速度和稳定性。狼群出动生效时，使用此武器对目标造成伤害会施加灼烧。瞄准时，击败目标会将灼烧扩散至附近目标。

desc.en: Grants additional damage against shields created by Nightmare Hunt bosses. This benefit does not stack with other mods that provide the same or greater benefit.
desc.zh: 在攻击梦魇狩猎首领制造的护盾时可造成额外伤害。此增益无法与其他提供同样或更高效果的模组叠加。

desc.en: Grants additional damage against shields created by Nightmare Hunt bosses. This benefit does not stack with other mods that provide the same or greater benefit.
desc.zh: 在攻击梦魇狩猎首领制造的护盾时可造成额外伤害。此增益无法与其他提供同样或更高效果的模组叠加。

desc.en: A member of your match has used a Fireteam Medallion, granting all players in the match increased XP gains and loot from match completion.
desc.zh: 比赛中的一位成员使用了火力战队大勋章，将增加所有玩家在比赛中获得的经验值和赛后战利品。

desc.en: The Relocator Launcher deals Void damage and applies a weakening effect.
desc.zh: 重定位发射器造成虚空伤害并施加削弱效果。

n.en: The Relocator Launcher deals Void damage and applies a weakening effect.
n.zh: 重定位发射器造成虚空伤害并施加削弱效果。

desc.en: Reloading after a precision final blow or after rapidly defeating targets increases your rate of fire for an improved duration.
desc.zh: 造成精准最后一击或快速击败目标后进行填装可提升你的射速，持续时间延长。

desc.en: Being in combat for an extended time increases damage, handling, and reload for this weapon until you are out of combat.
desc.zh: 长时间处于战斗状态会提升此武器的伤害、操控性和填装速度，持续直到脱离战斗。

desc.en: When empowerment ends, you gain a Void Overshield, the strength of which depends on how long you were empowered.
desc.zh: 赋能结束时，你会获得一个虚空覆盖护盾，其力量取决于你获得赋能的时间。

desc.en: Grenade final blows grant grenade energy. Multiple copies of this mod increase the amount of energy gained.
desc.zh: 手雷最后一击奖励手雷能量。多个此模组可以增加奖励的能量。

desc.en: Insectoid robot grenades quickly repopulate the magazine from reserves while the Colony is unequipped.
desc.zh: 在未装备群居者的情况下，机器人榴弹可快速从储备弹药转移到弹匣中。

desc.en:
When you deal damage with this weapon, it gains increased handling, takes reduced flinch, and movement speed is increased for a short time.

When you are at reduced health, this weapon deals additional damage.
desc.zh:
使用此武器造成伤害时，它的操控性会提升，抖动会减少。短时间内移动速度会提高。

当你的生命值减少时，此武器会造成额外伤害。

desc.en: Fires slugs that cause massive damage to combatant shields. Strong against [Shield-Piercing] Barrier Champions.
desc.zh: 发射的弹药会对战斗人员元素护盾造成巨大的伤害。克制屏障勇士。

desc.en:
Your grapple, Shackle Grenade, Threadling Grenade, and Slicewire Grenade have enhanced functionality.

Your grapple melee spawns three Threadlings.

[Grenade]  : Hold to consume your Shackle Grenade and activate Weaver's Trance. Final blows while Weaver's Trance is active create a suspending detonation.

[Grenade]  : Hold to charge your Threadling Grenade, causing it to weave a Threadling Nest at the impact location that repeatedly spawns Threadlings. 

[Grenade]  : Hold to charge your Slicewire Grenade. The grenade's final detonation will launch submunitions and leave a Tangle in its wake.
desc.zh:
你的抓取、束缚手雷、线虫手雷和切线手雷拥有强化性能。

你的抓取近战会生成三个线虫。

[手雷]  ：按住消耗你的束缚手雷并激活编织者之境。编织者之境激活时造成最后一击可生成一次悬停爆炸。

[手雷]  ：按住以充能你的线虫手雷，使其在命中地点编织一个不断生成线虫的线虫巢穴。

[手雷]  ：按住以充能你的切线手雷。该手雷最终爆炸时将发射子弹药并在其路径上留下一个缠结。

desc.en: After a final blow with this weapon, [Alternate Weapon Action]  to return ammo to the magazine and swap to a tighter spread that deals increased damage.
desc.zh: 使用此武器造成最后一击后，[替换武器动作]来将弹药返回弹匣并切换到更紧密的扩散范围，以造成更大的伤害。

desc.en: Receiving or discharging Bolt Charge partially loads the magazine from reserves.
desc.zh: 接收或释放电光充能会从备弹中填装弹匣的一部分。

desc.en: Detect caches or resources within a 30-meter range while on Titan.
desc.zh: 在土卫六上探测30米范围内的缓存箱或资源。

desc.en: Reduce duration of the Drained of Light debuff by 2 seconds. Multiple copies of this mod stack to increase this benefit.
desc.zh: 光能耗尽减益的持续时间减少2秒。此模组可叠加以增强效果。

desc.en: Well-rounded, reliable, 3-round burst.
desc.zh: 全面，可靠，3发点射。

desc.en:
Solar ability final blows, Hammer of Sol impacts, and defeating scorched targets creates Sunspots. Your abilities regenerate faster, and your Super drains more slowly while standing in a Sunspot.

Sunspots apply scorch and deal damage to targets inside. Entering a Sunspot applies restoration.
desc.zh:
烈日技能最后一击、烈焰战锤击中以及消灭灼烧目标可生成太阳黑子。站在太阳黑子中时你的技能恢复速度将加快，超能消耗速度将减缓。

太阳黑子可对其内部的目标施加灼烧效果并造成伤害。进入太阳黑子可施加恢复效果。

desc.en: When an ally dies or you reach critical health, this weapon's magazine refills, and it gains bonus range, charge rate, and handling.
desc.zh: 当盟友死亡或你生命危急时，此武器的弹匣会重新填充，并获得额外的射程、充能速度和操控性。

desc.en: Gain extra damage resistance against rank-and-file combatants.
desc.zh: 获得对抗来自普通敌人的额外伤害抗性。

desc.en: If you have not gone flawless this week, losses after three wins reset you to back to three wins.
desc.zh: 如果你本周未达到无瑕，那么三胜后的负场会将你重置为三胜。

desc.en: [Super] : With full charge, create a blast of energy, disabling shields on some combatants and objects.
desc.zh: [超能] ：充能完毕后，释放能量爆破，可解除部分战斗人员和物体的护盾。

n.en: [Super] : With full charge, create a blast of energy, disabling shields on some combatants and objects.
n.zh: [超能] ：充能完毕后，释放能量爆破，可解除部分战斗人员和物体的护盾。

desc.en: Defeating targets with other weapons before drawing this one transfers additional ammo to the magazine from reserves. This effect can overflow the magazine based on the number of targets defeated.
desc.zh: 拿出此武器前使用其他武器击败目标，可从储备弹药中转移额外弹药至弹匣。此效果可基于击败目标的数量溢出弹匣。

desc.en: Generate Gunsmith telemetry data on Void weapon kills.
desc.zh: 在虚空武器击杀时生成枪匠遥测数据。

desc.en: Improved target acquisition, accuracy, and aim-down-sights speed for Submachine Guns.
desc.zh: 改善微型冲锋枪的目标捕获能力、精度和瞄准速度。

desc.en: More Orbs from Supers. Casting Barricade heals.
desc.zh: 超能产生更多光球。施放屏障产生治疗脉冲。

desc.en: Steadily reloads your equipped Auto Rifle's or Machine Gun's mag.
desc.zh: 稳步填装已装备的自动步枪或机枪弹匣。

desc.en: Enhanced abilities with a charged Solar Super.
desc.zh: 拥有已充能的烈日超能时强化技能。

desc.en:
Dealing repeated damage with this weapon inflicts Jolt. 

While amplified, Jolt is applied faster.
desc.zh:
使用此武器造成重复伤害会施加震颤。

增幅状态下震颤施加速度更快。

desc.en: Earn an extra score with a score multiplier in Ops activities.
desc.zh: 在行动活动中借助得分系数获得额外得分。

desc.en: Collecting an Ionic Trace partially reloads the magazine from reserves.
desc.zh: 收集离子轨迹可使储存弹药填装部分弹匣。

desc.en: Fires high-damage Arc blast.
desc.zh: 发射高伤害电弧冲击。

desc.en: Adds a highly commendable appearance to your transmat effects.
desc.zh: 为你的传送效果添加一个难能可贵外观。

desc.en: Adds a crystalline breakout appearance to your transmat effects.
desc.zh: 为你的传送效果添加一个冰晶爆发外观。

desc.en: Equip multiple pieces from this set to unlock Gambit Prime set perks.
desc.zh: 装备多件此套装中的护甲以解锁全盛智谋套装特性。

desc.en: Equip multiple pieces from this set to unlock Gambit Prime set perks.
desc.zh: 装备多件此套装中的护甲以解锁全盛智谋套装特性。

desc.en: Equip multiple pieces from this set to unlock Gambit Prime set perks.
desc.zh: 装备多件此套装中的护甲以解锁全盛智谋套装特性。

desc.en: Precision final blows create an elemental damage explosion. Improves reload.
desc.zh: 精准最后一击可产生元素伤害爆炸。提高填装速度。

desc.en: Increases reload speed of Fusion Rifles.
desc.zh: 提高融合步枪的填装速度。

desc.en: Detect caches within a 40-meter range while on Io.
desc.zh: 在木卫一上探测40米范围内的缓存箱。

n.zh: 增强版木卫一缓存箱探测器

desc.en: Primary ammo weapons deal increased damage to disoriented combatants.
desc.zh: 主弹药武器对迷失方向的战斗人员造成更高伤害。

desc.en: Your grenade abilities release an additional disorienting pulse shortly after detonating.
desc.zh: 你的手雷技能在爆炸不久后额外释放一次扰乱脉冲。

desc.en: Greatly reduces flinching from incoming fire while aiming Submachine Guns.
desc.zh: 大幅降低使用微型冲锋枪瞄准时因受到伤害而产生的画面颤动。

n.zh: 强化型稳定微型冲锋枪瞄准

desc.en: Increases ability damage to Taken and Scorn combatants.
desc.zh: 提升对傀儡军团和嗤魅战斗人员的技能伤害。

desc.en:
Improves the benefits provided by the Sundering, Nano-Munitions, and Nanotech Tracer Rockets Origin Traits.

Additionally, weapons with these traits are always overcharged.
desc.zh:
提升分离、纳米弹药和纳米技术追踪火箭原始特性提供的增益。

此外，拥有这些特性的武器会始终过充。

desc.en: Combines the Solar/Strand and Solar/Stasis Siphon mods into one.
desc.zh: 将烈日/缚丝和烈日/冰影虹吸模组合二为一。

desc.en: Rapid final blows with Rocket Launchers and Grenade Launchers grant Armor Charge.
desc.zh: 火箭发射器和榴弹发射器快速最后一击会提供护甲充能。

desc.en: Radiant causes Solar weapons to apply scorch to unscorched combatants.
desc.zh: 焕光会使烈日武器获得灼烧未被灼烧的战斗人员的能力。

desc.en: Increases magazine.
desc.zh: 提高弹匣容量。

desc.en: Reaching seven wins rewards the weekly Adept weapon. When you are not in a full fireteam, losses following a win remove the win from the card. Reaching seven wins without losing a match grants access to the Lighthouse.
desc.zh: 赢得七场胜利会奖励每周专家武器。若你处于未满员的火力战队，则获胜后的负场会从卡片上移除该胜场。没有负场的情况下赢得七场胜利，则可进入灯塔。

desc.en: While you are Charged with Light, grenade final blows heal you and consume one stack of Charged with Light.
desc.zh: 当你 充斥光能的时候，手雷最后一击将治疗你并 消耗一层 光之充能。

desc.en: While Charged with Light, regain a portion of your grenade energy when you use your grenade, consuming one stack of Charged with Light.
desc.zh: 当充斥光能的时候， 当你使用手雷技能时重新获得一部分的手雷能量， 消耗一层 光之充能。

desc.en: Become Charged with Light by rapidly defeating multiple combatants with Grenade Launchers or Rocket Launchers.
desc.zh: 使用榴弹发射器或火箭发射器快速击败多名战斗人员来变得充斥光能。

desc.en: Allows for 1 additional stack of Charged with Light.
desc.zh: 提高一层光之充能积累上限。

desc.en: This weapon's rockets have tracking.
desc.zh: 这款武器的火箭有追踪能力。

desc.en: Stasis weapons get bonus reserves when picking up ammo used by that weapon.
desc.zh: 拾取该冰影武器所用弹药时，获得额外弹药储量。

desc.en: Gain increased Sword lunge distance immediately after switching to this weapon.
desc.zh: 切换到此武器后立即提高刀剑前冲距离。

desc.en: Adds a competitive appearance to your transmat effects.
desc.zh: 为你的传送效果添加一个竞技外观。

desc.en: Adds a record-shattering appearance to your transmat effects.
desc.zh: 为你的传送效果添加一个破纪录外观。

desc.en: Improved mobility.
desc.zh: 更高的敏捷度。

desc.en: Dodging leaves behind an explosive that detonates after a short delay, damaging targets around it.
desc.zh: 闪身会在原地留下一个延时引爆的爆炸装置，对周围目标造成伤害。

desc.en: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
desc.zh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

desc.en: Reduces flinching from incoming fire while aiming a Stasis weapon.
desc.zh: 降低用冰影武器瞄准时因受到伤害而产生的画面颤动。

desc.en: Final blows and rapid direct hits with this weapon create a loyal moth. The moth will seek out nearby targets and detonate, damaging and blinding them.
desc.zh: 使用此武器造成最后一击和快速直接命中会产生一只忠诚飞蛾。这只飞蛾会寻找附近的目标并引爆，对目标造成伤害和致盲效果。

desc.en:
Dealing melee damage gives this weapon greatly improved target acquisition and range for a short period of time.
Dealing melee damage again extends the effect.
desc.zh:
造成近战伤害会在短时间内大幅提升此武器的目标捕获能力和射程。
再次造成近战伤害可延长此效果。

desc.en: Direct hits with charged shots scorch the target. This weapon deals more damage against scorched targets.
desc.zh: 充能射击直接命中会灼烧目标。此武器对被灼烧的目标造成更多伤害。

desc.en: Final blows from Kinetic weapons create an explosion in the element of your equipped Super.
desc.zh: 来自动能武器的最后一击会根据你已装备超能的元素产生爆炸。

desc.en: Gain Super energy for kills and assists inside Well of Radiance.
desc.zh: 身处光焰之井中时完成击杀或助攻可获得超能能量。

desc.en: Increases the effect of all contributions towards the Heavy ammo meter.
desc.zh: 提升对重型弹药量表的所有计入效果。

desc.en: Increases reload speed of Trace Rifles.
desc.zh: 提高追踪步枪的填装速度。

desc.en: Move faster with this weapon.
desc.zh: 装备时移动速度提高。

desc.en: The air buzzes with anticipation. You feel an itch in your mind as the Witness bends the Light to its will, reshaping reality. Soon its power will be beyond your reckoning. It must be stopped.
desc.zh: 空气中弥漫着期待的嗡嗡声。当见证者让光能屈服于它的意志，重塑现实时，你心痒难耐。很快，它的力量将超出你的理解范围。你必须阻止它。

desc.en: Rapid precision hits slow targets. Strong against [Disruption] Overload Champions.
desc.zh: 快速精准命中会减速目标。克制过载勇士。

desc.en: Picking up an Orb of Power grants a temporary strong bonus to weapon damage of the same elemental type as your subclass.
desc.zh: 拾取能量球会暂时大幅提升与你分支职业相同元素类型的武器伤害。

desc.en: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
desc.zh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

desc.en: Higher base damage. High heat generated, [Reload]  to vent heat from the weapon. Overheating forces a sustained vent. Weapon cools down more rapidly between shots.
desc.zh: 高基础伤害，高热量积累。[填装]  以释放武器热量。过热将强制持续排气。武器在射击间隙冷却得更快。

desc.en: Final blows on tougher combatants create insectoid robots that chase combatants and create greater explosions.
desc.zh: 对强力战斗人员造成最后一击会产生追击战斗人员并猛烈爆炸的类虫机器人。

desc.en: This visual effect is suppressed while in combat.
desc.zh: 此视觉效果在战斗中会被抑制。

desc.en: Reduces incoming area-of-effect damage from combatants.
desc.zh: 减少来自敌方战斗人员的范围伤害。

desc.en: After activating your class ability, your next weapon final blow on a combatant spawns a Void elemental well.
desc.zh: 在启用职业技能之后，你下一次对战斗人员的武器最后一击将产生一个虚空元素井。

desc.en:
Landing sustained hits on combatants with any Auto Rifle you are wielding disrupts combatants, stunning them, delaying ability energy regeneration and lowering combatant damage output. Strong against [Disruption] Overload Champions. 

After any member of your fireteam stuns a Champion, your Auto Rifles gain a temporary bonus to damage against Champions.
desc.zh:
使用任意自动步枪对战斗人员的连续命中可扰乱敌人并使其眩晕，延缓其技能回复速度并降低伤害输出。克制过载勇士。

任意火力战队成员眩晕勇士后，你的自动步枪获得对勇士的临时伤害加成。

desc.en: Void ability final blows cause targets to explode.
desc.zh: 虚空技能最后一击将造成目标爆炸。

desc.en: Form a staff of pure Arc energy and acrobatically take out your foes.
desc.zh: 生成一支充斥着纯粹电弧能量的法杖，华丽地击杀你的敌人。

desc.en: Lightweight. Final blows grant modification progress to MIDA Multi-Tool.
desc.zh: 轻质。最后一击会为米达多功能提供改造进度。

desc.en: Arc Flux, Magnetic, and Fusion Grenades deal more damage when attached to combatants; on final blows, they release several micro-missiles that seek nearby combatants.
desc.zh: 电弧粘性电浆手雷、磁性手雷和融合手雷在黏附到战斗人员时会造成更多伤害；造成最后一击时，释放几枚自动追踪附近战斗人员的微型导弹。

desc.en: Arc-powered melee hits jolt combatants and deal further damage for a short duration.
desc.zh: 电弧充能近战命中会震颤战斗人员，并在短时间内造成额外伤害。

desc.en: Defeating a weakened target spawns a tracking projectile that weakens other targets.
desc.zh: 击败被削弱目标会生成削弱其他目标的追踪射弹。

desc.en: Performing three Sword light attacks followed by a heavy attack summons penumbral blades that surround you to damage and disorient combatants. Sword final blows extend the duration of these penumbral blades.
desc.zh: 施展三次刀剑轻攻击后跟进一次重攻击，会召唤出环绕自己的半影利刃，伤害战斗人员并使其迷失。刀剑最后一击可延长半影利刃的持续时间。

desc.en: Sniper Rifle hits grant stacking Sniper Rifle damage, stability, and reload bonuses for a short time. Heavy ammo Sniper Rifle hits count as more than one hit.
desc.zh: 狙击步枪命中会在短时间内提供可叠加的狙击步枪伤害、稳定性和填装加成。重型弹药狙击步枪命中被视为多次命中。

desc.en: Kinetic weapon damage against a powerful combatant has a chance to create a Kinetic Rupture. Targeting this Rupture causes a damaging explosion that staggers combatants. Strong against [Stagger] Unstoppable Champions.
desc.zh: 对强力战斗人员造成动能武器伤害有几率生成一个动能裂口。以此裂口为目标会造成眩晕战斗人员的伤害性爆炸，克制势不可挡勇士。

desc.en: [Arc]Arc weapon final blows have a chance to spawn an Arc Elemental Orb. Arc Orbs can be thrown or shot to create an Arc explosion that jolts targets it damages.
desc.zh: 电弧武器最后一击有几率生成一个电弧元素能量球。电弧能量球可被投掷出去或射击造成一次电弧爆炸，对造成伤害的目标施加震颤效果。

desc.en: Final blows with grenades grant Heat weapons bonus stability and vent speed and grant Primary ammo weapons bonus stability and reload speed.
desc.zh: 使用手雷造成最后一击会为热量武器提供稳定性和排气速度加成，并为主弹药武器提供稳定性和填装速度加成。

desc.en: Multiple final blows with Heat weapons or Primary ammo weapons grant bonuses to weapon and grenade stats and increased ammo generation for Heat weapons and Primary ammo weapons.
desc.zh: 使用热量武器或主弹药武器造成多次最后一击，会为武器和手雷属性提供加成，并提升热量武器和主弹药武器的弹药生成。

desc.en: Increases rate of fire after kill.
desc.zh: 提高击杀后的射速。

desc.en: Adds a banner appearance to your transmat effects.
desc.zh: 为你的传送效果添加一个旗帜的外观。

desc.en: Faster sprinting and chain melee damage.
desc.zh: 更快的冲刺速度和连锁近战伤害。

desc.en: Buffs maneuverability, hip firing, and firing in Lift.
desc.zh: 强化机动能力、腰射以及跃升时射击。

desc.en: Reloads stowed SMGs and allows instant ready.
desc.zh: 使用微型冲锋枪可增强填装、稳定性、移动和操控性。

desc.en: Equip multiple pieces from this set to unlock Gambit Prime set perks.
desc.zh: 装备多件此套装中的护甲以解锁全盛智谋套装特性。

desc.en: Equip multiple pieces from this set to unlock Gambit Prime set perks.
desc.zh: 装备多件此套装中的护甲以解锁全盛智谋套装特性。

desc.en: Equip multiple pieces from this set to unlock Gambit Prime set perks.
desc.zh: 装备多件此套装中的护甲以解锁全盛智谋套装特性。

desc.en: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
desc.zh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

desc.en: Upon interaction with a Traveler's Flower, gain a temporary buff that provides increased melee ability regeneration.
desc.zh: 与旅行者之花互动后，获得可增强近战技能回复的临时增益。

desc.en: Upon interaction with a Traveler's Flower, gain a temporary buff that randomly provides the effects of one of the other Pale Blessing mods.
desc.zh: 与旅行者之花互动后，获得可随机提供另一项苍白祝福模组效果的临时增益。

desc.en: Upon interaction with a Traveler's Flower, gain a temporary buff that provides increased health regeneration.
desc.zh: 与旅行者之花互动后，获得可增强生命值回复的临时增益。

desc.en: Upon interaction with a Traveler's Flower, gain a temporary buff that provides increased grenade ability regeneration.
desc.zh: 与旅行者之花互动后，获得可增强手雷技能回复的临时增益。

desc.en: Upon interaction with a Traveler's Flower, gain a temporary buff that provides increased class ability regeneration.
desc.zh: 与旅行者之花互动后，获得可增强职业技能回复的临时增益。

desc.en: Upon interaction with a Traveler's Flower, gain a temporary buff that provides a regenerating overshield.
desc.zh: 与旅行者之花互动后，获得可提供再生覆盖护盾的临时增益。

desc.en: Upon interaction with a Traveler's Flower, gain a temporary buff that provides increased Super ability regeneration.
desc.zh: 与旅行者之花互动后，获得可增强超能技能回复的临时增益。

desc.en: +10 Blast Radius
desc.zh: +10 爆炸范围

desc.en: Final blows or sustained precision hits with another weapon increase this weapon's rate of fire for an improved duration.
desc.zh: 使用其他武器造成最后一击或持续精准命中，会在更长时间内增加此武器的射速。

desc.en: Build a charge by collecting blast cores and stunning combatants.
desc.zh: 收集爆破核心和眩晕战斗人员来积累充能。

n.en: Build a charge by collecting blast cores and stunning combatants.
n.zh: 收集爆破核心和眩晕战斗人员来积累充能。

desc.en: While you have Radiant, Restoration, or Cure, your melee hits release a burst that will scorch the target.
desc.zh: 拥有焕光、恢复或治愈时，你的近战命中会释放灼烧目标的冲击波。

desc.en: Performing a finisher stores power. The next time your shields are broken, consume stored power to immediately heal and start health regeneration.
desc.zh: 施展终结技会存储能量。下一次你的护盾被击破时，消耗储备的能量立即获得治疗并开启生命值回复。

desc.en: Adds an aurora borealis appearance to your transmat effects.
desc.zh: 为你的传送效果添加一个北极光的外观。

desc.en: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
desc.zh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

desc.en: Reduces flinching from incoming fire while aiming Fusion Rifles.
desc.zh: 降低使用融合步枪瞄准时因受到伤害而产生的画面颤动。

desc.en: Dealing Arc damage from any source aligns the battery's coils. When alignment is complete, [Alternate Weapon Action]  to disengage the safety and enable hip-fired Starlight Beam to apply Jolt to any targets damaged for a short time.  Aim down sights to slow the rate at which the battery drains.
desc.zh: 造成任何来源的电弧伤害可校准电池线圈。校准完成时，按下[替换武器动作] 来解除保险装置，并使腰射的星光光束在短时间内对任何受到其伤害的目标施加震颤效果。瞄准会减缓电池耗尽的速率。

desc.en: Increases the amount of ammo you can carry for any rifle-class weapon.
desc.zh: 提高你可以携带的所有步枪武器的弹药数量。

desc.en: While you have Stable Resonance, continued weapon damage occasionally generates a resonance burst that damages and exhausts targets.
desc.zh: 拥有稳定共振时，持续造成武器伤害偶尔会产生共振爆发，伤害目标并使其疲惫。

desc.en: Defeating a powerful combatant generates Stable Resonance, which grants damage resistance and increased weapon damage for the duration.
desc.zh: 击败强力战斗人员会生成稳定共振，在持续时间内提供伤害抗性和提升武器伤害。

desc.en: Chained Arc Staff hits buff damage and duration.
desc.zh: 连续电弧法杖攻击可提高伤害和持续时间。

desc.en: Improves Arcbolt Grenades.
desc.zh: 改善电光手雷。

desc.en: Your weapons ready quicker and are more stable. Dodging increases this benefit.
desc.zh: 闪身可装填武器，并提高速度和操控性。

desc.en: Detect resources within a 30-meter range while on Io.
desc.zh: 在木卫一上探测30米范围内的资源。

desc.en: Missing a shot has an improved chance to return ammo directly to the magazine.
desc.zh: 子弹未命中时有更高几率直接向弹匣返还弹药。

desc.en: Customized frame with dramatically increased accuracy, stability, and targeting while hip firing.
desc.zh: 大幅提高精准度、稳定性和腰射瞄准性能的定制型。

desc.en:
Defeating targets or dealing damage with this weapon gradually increases range, stability, handling, and reload speed.

Swords gain increased charge rate and guard resistance.
desc.zh:
使用此武器击败目标或造成伤害会逐渐增加其射程、稳定性、操控性、填装速度。

刀剑会获得提升的充能速度和防御抗性。

desc.en: Improves range, handling, and damage against combatants during the opening moments of an engagement.
desc.zh: 在刚开始交火时，提升对战斗人员的射程、操控性和伤害。

desc.en: Grants bonus rewards from Flawless Chest.
desc.zh: 从无暇宝箱中获得额外奖励。

desc.en: Greatly improved stability and accuracy as the magazine gets lower.
desc.zh: 弹匣中的弹药减少时，稳定性和精度随之大幅提高。

desc.en: Double fires tracking bolts that leech health.
desc.zh: 发射两发可吸取生命值的追踪射弹。

desc.en: Chain precision shots to increase non-critical hit damage.
desc.zh: 连续精准射击可提升非暴击命中伤害。

desc.en: When you use a finisher on an Elite, you generate Special ammo for your fireteam; when you use a finisher on a boss or miniboss, you generate Heavy ammo for your fireteam. Nearby Aeon Cult allies who do not have the Sect of Insight role equipped also gain a burst of Super energy.
desc.zh: 当你对精英敌人使用终结技时，会为你的火力战队生成特殊弹药；当你对首领或初级首领使用终结技时，会为你的火力战队生成重型弹药。附近未装备洞察学派角色的永劫邪教盟友会获得大量超能能量。

desc.en: Successive precision weapon takedowns have a chance to drop an Orb of Power for your allies.
desc.zh: 取得连续精准武器击杀有几率为你的队友生成一个能量球。

desc.en: Adds a cauldron of bats appearance to your transmat effects.
desc.zh: 为你的传送效果添加一个蝙蝠熔炉外观。

desc.en: Adds a webbed escape appearance to your transmat effects.
desc.zh: 为你的传送效果添加一个蛛网外观。

desc.en: Chance to receive a powerful Prime Engram by defeating challenging enemies or completing Crucible matches.
desc.zh: 在击败具有挑战性的敌人或完成熔炉竞技场比赛时，有机会获得一个强大的至高记忆水晶。

desc.en: Precision hits improve weapon performance.
desc.zh: 精准命中会提升武器性能。

desc.en: Reduces hit flinch from incoming fire while aiming Machine Guns.
desc.zh: 降低使用机枪瞄准时因受到伤害而产生的画面颤动。

desc.en: Adds a cherry blossom petal appearance to your transmat effects.
desc.zh: 为你的传送添加一个樱花花瓣出现效果。

desc.en: Adds bright neon class logo to your transmat effects.
desc.zh: 为你的传送添加一个明亮霓虹职业标志效果。

desc.en: Healing grenades spawn a Restorative Turret.
desc.zh: 治愈手雷会生成一个恢复炮台。

desc.en: You can have 2 additional stacks of Charged with Light, up to a maximum of 5.
desc.zh: 你可以拥有2层额外的光之充能，最高可拥有5层。

desc.en: Tapping the trigger gives this weapon less recoil and improves accuracy.
desc.zh: 轻扣扳机可以减少此武器的后坐力并提高精度。

desc.en:
Tangles you throw attach to targets and detonate into a suspending burst. Destroying a Tangle creates a suspending burst after a short delay.

Threadling final blows create Tangles or reduce your current Tangle cooldown.
desc.zh:
你投掷的缠结会附着在目标身上，并引爆成一个悬停爆发。摧毁一个缠结会在短暂延迟后生成一个悬停爆发。

线虫最后一击会生成一个缠结或减少你当前的缠结冷却时间。

desc.en: Picking up an Orb of Power grants a small amount of energy to your ability with the least energy.
desc.zh: 拾取能量球会为当前能量最少的技能填充少量能量。

desc.en: Become Charged with Light by rapidly defeating combatants with precision kills from Bows, Hand Cannons, and Scout Rifles.
desc.zh: 使用弓箭、手炮和斥候步枪的精准击杀快速消灭战斗人员来充斥光能。

desc.en: Increases reload, range, and accuracy when no targets are in close proximity.
desc.zh: 若附近无目标，提升填装、射程和精度。

desc.en: [Melee] : control morphable objects to create new pathways
desc.zh: [近战] ：控制可变形物体，开辟全新通路

n.en: [Melee] : control morphable objects to create new pathways
n.zh: [近战] ：控制可变形物体，开辟全新通路

desc.en:
While you're on the Leviathan, your Solar abilities deal 25% more damage.

This mod's abilities cannot stack across multiple copies.
desc.zh:
在利维坦上时，你的烈日技能可造成25%额外伤害。

这个模组的能力无法重复叠加。

desc.en: Sword final blows grant greatly increased charge rate and defense until this weapon is stowed.
desc.zh: 刀剑最后一击可大幅提高充能速度和防御，效果持续至收起此武器。

desc.en: Improved target acquisition, accuracy, and aim-down-sights speed for Trace Rifles.
desc.zh: 改善追踪步枪的目标捕获能力、精度和瞄准速度。

desc.en: Collecting or destroying a Warmind Cell creates a concussive blast that pushes enemies away.
desc.zh: 收集或摧毁一个战争思维电池会制造一场击退敌人的震荡冲击波。

desc.en: Increases reload speed of Bows.
desc.zh: 提高弓箭的搭箭速度。

desc.en: Increases your base movement speed and jump height.
desc.zh: 提升你的基础移动速度和跳跃高度。

desc.en: [###DestinyNamedSubstitutions.ui_player_action_jump_button###] : Jump
desc.zh: [###DestinyNamedSubstitutions.ui_player_action_jump_button###] ：跳跃

desc.en: Defeating combatants with any source of Strand damage produces Threadlings. Defeating powerful combatants produces more Threadlings.
desc.zh: 使用任意缚丝伤害源击败战斗人员可生成线虫。击败强力战斗人员会生成更多线虫。

desc.en: Grants additional damage to your melee and grenade abilities against Nightmare Hunt bosses. This benefit does not stack with other mods that provide the same or greater benefit.
desc.zh: 在对抗梦魇狩猎首领时，你的近战和手雷技能可造成额外伤害。此增益无法与其他提供同样或更高效果的模组叠加。

desc.en: Grants additional damage to your Super against Nightmare Hunt bosses. This benefit does not stack with other mods that provide the same or greater benefit.
desc.zh: 在对抗梦魇狩猎首领时，你的超能可造成额外伤害。此增益无法与其他提供同样或更高效果的模组叠加。

desc.en: Reduces the damage you take from Nightmare Hunt bosses. Multiple copies of this mod stack for greater effect.
desc.zh: 降低你从梦魇狩猎首领的攻击受到的伤害。多个此模组可叠加以增强效果。

desc.en: Grants additional damage against shields created by Nightmare Hunt bosses. This benefit does not stack with other mods that provide the same or greater benefit.
desc.zh: 在攻击梦魇狩猎首领制造的护盾时可造成额外伤害。此增益无法与其他提供同样或更高效果的模组叠加。

desc.en: When targets are nearby, final blows grant bonus Melee stat.
desc.zh: 当目标在附近时，最后一击会赋予近战属性加成。

desc.en: Final blows with Together Forever weapons reload this weapon and overflow bonus damage rounds into the magazine. Final blows with bonus damage rounds increase the magazine capacity of Together Forever weapons.
desc.zh: 使用永不分离武器造成最后一击会填装此武器，并为弹匣溢装额外伤害弹药。使用额外伤害弹药造成最后一击会提升永不分离武器的弹匣容量。

desc.en: Final blows with this weapon have a chance to create an Elemental pickup matching its damage type, or an Orb of Power for weapons that deal Kinetic damage.
desc.zh: 用此武器造成最后一击，有几率生成与其伤害类型匹配的元素拾取物，或为造成动能伤害的武器生成一个能量球。

desc.en: Damage by fully drawn arrows disrupts combatants, stunning them, delaying ability energy regeneration and lowering combatant damage output. Strong against [Disruption] Overload Champions.
desc.zh: 拉满弓所射出的箭会扰乱战斗人员并将其眩晕，延缓技能能量回复并降低输出。克制过载勇士。

desc.en: Reduces flinching from incoming fire while aiming a Void weapon.
desc.zh: 降低用虚空武器瞄准时因受到伤害而产生的画面颤动。

desc.en: Final blows with weapons or abilities while this weapon is stowed increase its handling, stability, and reload speed for a short duration.
desc.zh: 在此武器收起时使用武器或技能完成最后一击可在短时间内提高其操控性、稳定性和填装速度。

desc.en: Gradually reloads your stowed Hand Cannons over time. Multiple copies of this perk stack to reduce the time taken to fully reload.
desc.zh: 随着时间推移，逐渐为已收起的手炮装填弹药。此特性的效果可以叠加，以缩短完全重新装弹的耗时。

desc.en: Melee final blows with this weapon grant it bonus energy and provide increased movement speed while blocking.
desc.zh: 使用此武器造成近战最后一击可为其提供额外能量，并在格挡时提供更高的移动速度。

desc.en: Projectiles attached to enemies explode after a short delay.
desc.zh: 弹药可粘附在目标上，并在短暂延迟后爆炸。

desc.en: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
desc.zh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

desc.en: For a short time after your shields break, your next several Threadling hits restore health.
desc.zh: 你的护盾被击破后的短时间内，你接下来的几次线虫命中会回复生命值。

desc.en: Taking damage from combatants sometimes spawns a Threadling.
desc.zh: 受到来自战斗人员的伤害时可能生成一只线虫。

desc.en: Hits against marked targets deal increased damage and have a chance to refund ammo to the magazine.
desc.zh: 命中标记的目标会造成更多伤害，并有几率将弹药返还至弹匣。

desc.en:
Bolts attached to targets deal damage over time.
[###DestinyNamedSubstitutions.ui_player_action_interact_button###][###DestinyNamedSubstitutions.ui_player_action_interact_verb###] with the bolt to retrieve it.

desc.zh: 冲刺后滑行期间可获得额外伤害和充能速度加成，持续时间延长。

desc.en: Repeatedly missing targets increases this weapon's stability for a short time. This buff lasts for a longer duration after a target is hit.
desc.zh: 重复偏离目标可在短时间内提高此武器的稳定性。此增益效果在命中目标后会持续较长时间。

desc.en: Aiming this weapon for a short period without firing grants bonus range and precision damage that resets after firing or exiting zoom.
desc.zh: 未射击下瞄准一小段时间可提高在射击或退出瞄准后重置的射程和精准伤害。

desc.en: [Shoot] : Stun nearby combatants with Arc energy; also affects some objects.
desc.zh: [射击] ：使用电弧能量眩晕附近的战斗人员；同时影响部分物体。

n.en: [Shoot] : Stun nearby combatants with Arc energy; also affects some objects.
n.zh: [射击] ：使用电弧能量眩晕附近的战斗人员；同时影响部分物体。

desc.en: Massively increases projectile velocity, substantially increases reload speed.
desc.zh: 大幅提高射弹速度，大幅提升填装速度。

desc.en: Boosting while riding Dawning Cheer will occasionally spawn a Glimmer present until the boost ends. This perk is available only during the Dawning.
desc.zh: 乘坐曙光喜悦时加速，会偶尔在加速结束时生成一个微光礼物。此特性仅可在曙光节期间使用。

desc.en: Crucible wins have a chance to drop an additional piece of Legendary gear.
desc.zh: 在熔炉竞技场取胜有几率掉落一件额外的传说装备。

desc.en: While amplified, this weapon gains greatly increased reload speed, aim assist, and movement while aiming down sights.
desc.zh: 处于增幅状态时，此武器的填装速度、瞄准辅助和瞄准时的移动速度会大幅提升。

desc.en: After dodging, each Arc Staff hit creates a damaging lightning aftershock.
desc.zh: 进行闪身后，电弧法杖每次命中都能产生可造成伤害的闪电余震。

desc.en: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
desc.zh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

desc.en: After three rapid light melee attacks, quickly [Heavy Attack]  to execute a heavy melee combo.
desc.zh: 在三次快速近战轻攻击后，迅速使用 [重攻击]  施展一次近战重攻击连击。

desc.en: For several seconds after a final blow, [Alternate Weapon Action]  to consume part of your ammo reserves, converting your next thrown grenade into a fragmentation grenade.
desc.zh: 最后一击后的几秒钟内，[替换武器动作]来消耗部分备弹，将你下一颗投掷的手雷转化为碎片手雷。

desc.en: Defeating a target creates a Void burst; hitting other targets with this burst makes them volatile and grants you Volatile Rounds for an improved duration.
desc.zh: 击败一个目标会产生虚空爆发；用此爆发击中其他目标会使其不稳定，并为你提供不稳定弹药，持续时间延长。

desc.en: Increases your chances of finding ammo while you have a Glaive equipped.
desc.zh: 装备偃月后，提高你找到弹药的机会。

desc.en: Melee final blows start health regeneration. While transcendent, melee final blows start health regeneration for you and nearby allies.
desc.zh: 近战最后一击会带来生命值回复效果。处于超凡状态时，近战最后一击会为你和你附近的盟友带来生命值回复效果。

desc.en: Final blows with other weapons improve this weapon's damage and performance for a short duration.
desc.zh: 使用其他武器达成最后一击将在短时间内提高此武器的伤害和性能。

desc.en: Your vehicles take less time to summon and reload your weapons while you ride.
desc.zh: 缩短载具召唤时间，骑乘的同时填装武器。

desc.en: Rapidly healing allies grants this weapon a period of increased damage.
desc.zh: 快速治疗盟友可提升此武器在一段时间内的伤害。

desc.en: Adds a cocoon appearance to your transmat effects.
desc.zh: 为你的传送效果添加一个茧外观。

desc.en: Adds a pyramid appearance to your transmat effects.
desc.zh: 为你的传送效果添加一个金字塔外观。

desc.en: While sprinting, you have greatly increased health stat.
desc.zh: 在冲刺时，生命值属性大幅提升。

desc.en: Reloading this weapon after defeating a target causes the next hit to launch a Kinetic projectile that detonates into a longer-lasting disorienting blast.
desc.zh: 击败目标后填装此武器，会使下次命中发射一枚引爆造成更持久迷失效果的动能射弹。

desc.en: Damaging a Glyphkeeper with a grenade causes your equipped Hand Cannons, Shotguns, Grenade Launchers, and Rocket Launchers to deal additional damage.
desc.zh: 使用手雷对雕文守护者造成伤害，可使你装备的手炮、霰弹枪、榴弹发射器和火箭发射器造成额外伤害。

desc.en: Greatly improved target acquisition, accuracy, and aim-down-sights speed for Hand Cannons.
desc.zh: 大幅改善手炮的目标捕获能力、精度和瞄准速度。

desc.en: Final blows with this weapon grant bonus damage. The strength and duration of the bonus increases when more powerful targets are defeated.
desc.zh: 使用此武器造成最后一击可提供额外伤害。击败更强力的目标可提高此加成的强度和持续时间。

desc.en: Fires a projectile that freezes. Strong against [Stagger] Unstoppable Champions.
desc.zh: 发射一枚可冻结的射弹。克制势不可挡勇士。

desc.en: Detect caches within a 30-meter range while on Titan.
desc.zh: 在土卫六上探测30米范围内的缓存箱。

desc.en: Greatly increases reload speed of Fusion Rifles.
desc.zh: 大幅提高融合步枪的填装速度。

n.zh: 强化型融合步枪装填装置

desc.en: Increases this armor's mobility, allowing you to move faster.
desc.zh: 提高这件护甲的敏捷度，以提高移动速度。

desc.en: +3 Super
desc.zh: +3 超能

desc.en: Increases your chance of finding Primary ammo while you have an Auto Rifle equipped.
desc.zh: 装备自动步枪后，提高你找到主武器弹药的机会。

desc.en: Defeating targets will award a Dawning gift at a faster rate. Defeated powerful targets count as more than one.
desc.zh: 击败目标会更快地奖励一个曙光节礼物。击败强力目标算作多次击败。

desc.en: Aiming this weapon increases its effective range and zoom magnification. Increased projectile velocity while aiming Rocket Launchers, Grenade Launchers, and Bows.
desc.zh: 使用这款武器瞄准可提高有效射程和变焦倍率。提高使用火箭发射器、榴弹发射器、弓箭瞄准时的射弹速度。

desc.en: This weapon has more improved accuracy and handling as your health gets lower.
desc.zh: 你的生命值越低，此武器的精度和操控性提升越大。

desc.en: Greatly increases ready and stow speed for Linear Fusion Rifles.
desc.zh: 大幅提高线性融合步枪的收举速度。

n.zh: 强化型线性融合步枪灵巧

desc.en: This weapon gains bonus stability, handling, and reload speed while the wielder is in motion for a short duration.
desc.zh: 此武器可在持用者保持移动时获得短时间的稳定性、操控性和填装速度加成。

desc.en: Breaking a combatant's shield—or the shield of a Guardian using a Super—with the matched damage type refills the magazine from reserves and grants bonus damage rounds. Breaking a combatant's shield with a matched damage type Ionic Return round refreshes the perk.
desc.zh: 使用匹配的伤害类型击碎战斗人员的护盾 ，或击碎超能状态下的守护者护盾，则可从储备弹药中转移弹药至弹匣，并提供额外伤害弹药。使用匹配伤害类型的离子回归弹药击碎战斗人员的护盾，可刷新特性。

desc.en: Collecting an Orb of Power grants a period of maximum power that starts with an automatic reload. Sustained fire in this mode suppresses targets.
desc.zh: 收集一颗能量球会在一段时间内给予最大能量，并进行自动填装。在此模式中持续开火可压制目标。

desc.en: +5 Class ▲ / -5 Melee ▼

Substantially increases weapon handling and reload speed. Gain the following effects while you are the last living member of your fireteam:
• Increased target acquisition
• Increased handling and reload speed
• Reduced flinch from incoming fire
desc.zh:
大幅提高武器操控性和装填速度。当你作为火力战队最后一名存活的成员时获得以下效果：
• 提高目标捕获能力
• 提高操控性和填装速度
• 减少受到伤害时的抖动

desc.en: When an ally dies or you reach critical health, this weapon's magazine refills and it gains improved range, charge rate, and handling.
desc.zh: 当盟友死亡或你生命危急时，此武器的弹匣会重新填充，并获得更多额外的射程、充能速度和操控性。

desc.en: The inert radiolaria courses through you with a strange resonance. Follow where it leads.
desc.zh: 惰性放射体液在你体内流动，产生奇怪的共鸣。跟随它的引导行动吧。

desc.en: +10 Draw Time
desc.zh: +10 拔枪速度

desc.en: Improves weapon handling for equipped Energy weapon.
desc.zh: 改善已装备能量武器的操控性。

desc.zh: 使用烈日点燃消灭目标可获得手雷能量。

desc.en: Gain bonus Super energy on grenade kills.
desc.zh: 手雷击杀可提供额外超能能量。

desc.en: +3 Class ▲
desc.zh: +3 职业 ▲

desc.en: +5 Class ▲
desc.zh: +5 职业 ▲

desc.en: Acquired armor pieces with randomized stats are more likely to drop with the Reaver archetype, which has Class as its primary stat and Melee as its secondary.
desc.zh: 获取的随机属性护甲更有可能掉落掠夺者框架：职业为主要属性，近战为次要属性。

desc.en: Picking up a Solar elemental well grants you additional grenade energy. Multiple copies of this mod increase this effect.
desc.zh: 拾取一个烈日元素井会赋予你额外手雷能量。多个此模组会增强此效果。

desc.en: Elemental well mods that cause you to spawn elemental wells can now stack, spawning additional wells for each additional copy of the mod you have equipped.
desc.zh: 使你生成元素井的元素井模组现在可以叠加效果了。每多装备一块同款模组，生成的元素井也会多一个。

desc.en: Trace Rifles get bonus reserves when you pick up Special ammo.
desc.zh: 拾取特殊弹药时追踪步枪获得额外弹药储量。

desc.en: Each successive shot has more damage and more spread.
desc.zh: 连续的每次射击的伤害和扩散范围都有所增加。

desc.en: Damaging targets while firing from the hip increases handling, reload speed, and movement speed while aiming down sights.
desc.zh: 腰射时伤害目标会提升瞄准时的操控性、填装速度和移动速度。

desc.en: Adds a snowman to your transmat effects.
desc.zh: 为你的传送效果添加一个雪人效果。

desc.en: Adds a gingerbread house with a peppermint swirl to your transmat effects.
desc.zh: 为你的传送效果添加一个薄荷漩涡姜饼屋效果。

desc.en:
Well-rounded.
[Heavy Attack]  : Uppercut.
desc.zh:
全能型。
[重攻击] ：上挑。

desc.en:
While you're on the Leviathan, activating a Void Super recharges your grenade.

This mod's abilities cannot stack across multiple copies.
desc.zh:
在利维坦上时，激活虚空超能可充能手雷。

这个模组的能力无法重复叠加。

desc.en: Increased movement speed and target acquisition when moving while aiming down sights.
desc.zh: 移动时瞄准会提高移动速度和目标获取速度。

desc.en: +20 Class ▲
This visual effect is suppressed while in combat.
desc.zh: 此视觉效果在战斗中会被抑制。

desc.en: After a successful melee hit, this weapon gains increased damage, improved handling, and improved reload speed for a short duration—or until three shots are fired.
desc.zh: 在进行一次成功的近战打击后，在一小段时间内——或直到发射完三枚子弹前——提高武器的伤害、操控性和填装速度。

desc.en: Final blows with this weapon while your Super is full grant an improved bonus to Melee and Grenade stats for a moderate duration.
desc.zh: 超能能量全满时使用此武器造成最后一击可在一定时间内提供更多近战和手雷属性加成。

desc.en:
The detonations from Warmind Cells you destroy cause disruption, stunning combatants, delaying ability energy regeneration and lowering combatant damage output.

Strong against [Disruption]  Overload Champions  and [Stagger]  Unstoppable Champions.
desc.zh:
你摧毁的战争思维电池所引发的爆炸会造成干扰，眩晕战斗人员，延缓其技能能量回复并降低伤害输出。

克制过载勇士和势不可挡勇士。

desc.en: Greatly increases blast radius and projectile speed.
desc.zh: 大幅提升爆炸范围和射弹速度。

desc.en: Sword Guard has balanced defenses and maximized endurance.
desc.zh: 刀剑格挡拥有平衡的防御以及最大化的持久。

desc.en: The number of precision final blows before reloading affects the total rounds granted with increased range and damage. Precision final blows with Magnificent Howl active extend the effect for additional rounds.
desc.zh: 填装前精准最后一击的次数会影响射程和伤害增加的子弹总数。激活宏伟之嚎时，精准最后一击会延长额外子弹效果。

desc.en: High damage, high recoil.
desc.zh: 高伤害，高后坐力。

desc.en: Forgives one loss per run. Forgives a second loss if you have not yet been flawless this week.
desc.zh: 每轮尝试允许有一场失利。如果本周尚未完成无瑕可允许有第二场失利。

desc.en: Glaives get bonus reserves when picking up ammo used by that Glaive.
desc.zh: 拾取该偃月所用弹药时，偃月获得额外储存弹药。

desc.en: Slow that you apply to targets lasts longer. For those abilities that linger, their duration will also increase.
desc.zh: 你对目标施加的减速效果持续时间更长。所有持续技能的持续时间也会加长。

desc.en: Adds the Jade Rabbit crest to your transmat effects.
desc.zh: 为你的传送效果添加一个玉兔纹章。

desc.en: Loyal moths damage targets and aid your allies.
desc.zh: 忠诚飞蛾会对目标造成伤害并治疗你的盟友。

desc.en: Gain a powerful overshield while performing your finisher.
desc.zh: 在使用终结技时获得一个强大的力场护盾。

desc.en:
[Air Dodge]  : Dodge while airborne to consume your melee energy and enter the weave, gaining damage resistance from combatants and players. Reactivate your air dodge or cast your Rift to exit the weave, generating Woven Mail for you and nearby allies.

While in the weave, your melee energy is drained and you generate perched Threadlings over time. Threadling hits generate ability energy.
desc.zh:
[空中闪身]  ：在空中时闪身将消耗你的近战能量并进入编织状态，获得来自战斗人员和玩家的伤害抗性。重新激活空中闪身或投掷裂痕来退出编织，为你和附近盟友生成织造铠甲。

在编织状态中，你的近战能量会耗尽并会慢慢产生息停线虫。线虫命中会产生技能能量。

desc.en: Increases this armor's recovery, allowing you to recover health faster.
desc.zh: 提高这件护甲的恢复值，以提高你的生命值恢复速度。

desc.en:
With full class ability energy and after sprinting for a short time, you gain a frontal shield that blocks incoming damage. When the frontal shield breaks, your class ability energy is depleted. When the frontal shield takes damage, you gain a stack of Bolt Charge.

While amplified, the shield blocks significantly more damage before breaking.
desc.zh:
在职业技能能量已满并短时间冲刺后，你会得到一面抵挡来袭伤害的正面护盾。在护盾被打破后，你会耗尽所有职业技能能量。当正面护盾受到伤害时，你会获得一层电光充能。

在增幅状态下，护盾可抵挡的伤害显著增加。

desc.en: Become Charged with Light by rapidly defeating combatants with Auto Rifles, Trace Rifles, or Machine Guns. Additional copies of this mod increase the time allowed between combatants that are defeated.
desc.zh: 使用自动步枪、追踪步枪或机枪快速消灭战斗人员来充斥光能。此模组的额外副本可增加消灭战斗人员之间的时间间隔。

desc.en:
While this weapon is equipped, taking damage greatly increases handling and aim assist until the weapon is stowed.

Taking more damage increases the effect.
desc.zh:
装备此武器时，受到伤害可大幅提升操控性与瞄准辅助，直到武器被收起。

受到更多伤害可提升此效果。

desc.en: Breaking a combatant's shield with this weapon makes them more vulnerable to Kinetic damage for an improved duration.
desc.zh: 使用武器破坏战斗人员的护盾，使他们对动能伤害的承受力更低，持续时间延长。

desc.en:
Sustained damage from this weapon exhausts the target for an improved duration.

Exhausted targets deal reduced outgoing damage.
desc.zh:
此武器的持续伤害会在更长时间内使目标疲惫。

疲惫的目标造成的伤害会减少。

desc.en: The inert radiolaria courses through you with a strange resonance. Follow where it leads.
desc.zh: 惰性放射体液在你体内流动，产生奇怪的共鸣。跟随它的引导行动吧。

desc.en: While a Ruinscribe Turret is deployed, this weapon can paint targets with its laser projectiles. The turret prioritizes painted targets and fires more powerful munitions at them. [Alternate Weapon Action]  to swap between normal fire and laser fire modes.
desc.zh: 毁灭铭刻炮台部署时，此武器可使用其激光射弹标记目标。炮台会优先攻击被标记的目标，向其发射更强力的弹药。按下[替换武器动作] 切换普通射击或激光射击模式。

desc.en: Slightly improved target acquisition, accuracy, and aim-down-sights speed for Kinetic weapons.
desc.zh: 略微改善动能武器的目标捕获能力、精度和瞄准速度。

desc.en: Gain stacks of Siphoning Touch for weapon or Glaive melee hits. Switching weapons heals you and consumes all stacks.
desc.zh: 使用武器或偃月造成近战命中获得虹吸之触层数。切换武器会消耗所有层数来治疗你自己。

desc.en: Your health begins regenerating immediately after taking melee damage from a powerful combatant.
desc.zh: 受到强力战斗人员的近战伤害后立即开始回复生命值。

desc.en: Increased experience gains provided by a fireteam member.
desc.zh: 增加了火力战队成员提供的经验值。

desc.en: Grants slightly increased persistence and projectile speed.
desc.zh: 小幅提升坚韧和射弹速度。

desc.en: Sword ammo granted for every other powered sword kill.
desc.zh: 每隔一次的赋能刀剑击杀都可提供刀剑弹药。

desc.en: This weapon can be drawn unbelievably fast. Reload is improved.
desc.zh: 此武器的拉弓速度快得难以置信。提高填装速度。

desc.en: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
desc.zh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

desc.en:
Defeating combatants or opponents with Auto Rifles or Submachine Guns grants a small amount of Glimmer.

Mod does not stack.
desc.zh:
使用 自动步枪 或 微型冲锋枪 击败战斗人员或对手可获得少量微光。

模组无法叠加。

desc.en: While in the Dreaming City, you deal more damage to all targets.
desc.zh: 身处幽梦之城时，对所有目标造成的伤害提高。

desc.en: [Alternate Weapon Action]  : Drain Super energy, overflowing the magazine and empowering the beam with bonus damage and the ability to slow and freeze targets until the magazine or Super energy runs out, or the weapon is stowed. Can only be activated when Super energy is full.
desc.zh: [替换武器动作] ：消耗超能能量，使弹匣满溢并赋予光束额外伤害，并在超能能量或弹匣耗光或收起武器之前赋予减缓和冰冻敌人的能力。只能在超能能量全满时启动。

desc.en: Increases damage and weakens while invisible.
desc.zh: 隐形时提升伤害和虚弱效果。

desc.en: Landing a trick while riding Dawning Cheer will spawn multiple Glimmer presents. This perk is available only during the Dawning.
desc.zh: 在乘坐曙光喜悦时耍个把戏可生成多个微光礼物。此特性仅可在曙光节期间使用。

desc.en: Picking up an ammo brick heals you.
desc.zh: 拾取弹药盒会治疗你。

desc.en: Final blows with Primary ammo weapons grant you briefly increased radar resolution.
desc.zh: 使用主弹药武器造成最后一击会暂时提升你雷达的分辨率。

desc.en: Defeating combatants with Void damage has a chance to create Void seekers that track nearby targets and suppress them.
desc.zh: 使用虚空伤害击败战斗人员有一定几率生成虚空追踪弹，它能追踪并压制附近的目标。

Improves Diamond Lances.
desc.zh: 提升钻石长矛。

Combining with other Episodic bonuses cannot exceed 100%.

desc.zh:
增加印记石的掉落率，每装备一件护甲增加10%（最多4件）。

与其他篇章奖励叠加时不会超过100%。
