desc.en: Reduces flinching from incoming fire while aiming Scout Rifles.
desc.zh: 降低使用斥候步枪瞄准时因受到伤害而产生的画面颤动。

desc.en: Recharge your melee ability whenever you or a member of your fireteam staggers a Champion.
desc.zh: 你或你的火力战队成员眩晕敌方勇士时可为你充能近战技能。

desc.en: Grants increased ammo generation.
desc.zh: 提升弹药生成速度。

desc.en:
Class abilities recharge faster when using a Void subclass.
  •  Stacks up to 3 times
desc.zh:
使用虚空分支职业时职业技能的充能速度提高。
  •  最高可叠加3次

desc.en: Weapon damage reduces melee ability cooldown.
desc.zh: 武器伤害可缩短近战技能冷却时间。

desc.en:
Collecting an Elemental pickup or destroying a Tangle has an escalating chance to give you Armor Charge.

Elemental pickups include [Solar]Firesprites, [Void]Void Breaches, [Arc]Ionic Traces, [Stasis]Stasis Shards, and [Strand]Strand Tangles.
desc.zh:
收集元素拾取物或摧毁缠结有递增的几率提供护甲充能。

元素拾取物包括焰灵、虚空裂口、离子轨迹、冰影碎片和缚丝缠结。

desc.en: Kills provide improved handling for all weapons for a longer duration.
desc.zh: 击杀可为所有武器提供更高的操控性，持续时间延长。

desc.en: Damaging a combatant with this weapon has a small chance to reload the magazine and increase movement speed while aiming down sights by an improved amount. Bows receive improved draw speed, and Swords receive improved charge rate while this perk is active.
desc.zh: 使用此武器对战斗人员造成伤害有较小几率填装弹匣并提升更多瞄准时的移动速度。当此特性生效时，弓箭获得更多拉弓速度，刀剑获得更多充能速度。

desc.en: Your equipped Sidearms fire shield-piercing rounds and stun [Shield-Piercing] Barrier Champions.
desc.zh: 你装备的手枪会发射护盾穿透子弹并眩晕屏障勇士。

desc.en: Damaging combatants with your Glaive suppresses them, preventing them from using abilities for a short time.
desc.zh: 使用偃月对战斗人员造成伤害可压制他们，使其在短时间内无法使用技能。

desc.en: Rounds from this weapon shatter into submunitions on impact. Strong against [Disruption] Overload Champions.
desc.zh: 此武器发射的子弹在命中时会碎裂成子弹药。克制过载勇士。

desc.en: The first Bonus Focus awarded per day drops a second time.
desc.zh: 每天获得的第一个加成专注会再次掉落。

desc.en: Deal increased Matterspark damage.
desc.zh: 造成更高的物质火花伤害。

n.zh: 造成更高的物质火花伤害。

desc.en: Defeating a Vex with a precision hit has a chance to spawn an Orb of Power. Multiple copies of this mod increase the Super energy granted when those Orbs are picked up.
desc.zh: 使用精准命中消灭Vex有机会刷出能量球。多个此模组可以增加拾起能量球时的超能能量。

desc.en: Your equipped Bows, Hand Cannons, Linear Fusion Rifles, Scout Rifles, and Sniper Rifles deal additional damage to Oracles in the Vault of Glass.
desc.zh: 你装备的弓箭、手炮、线性融合步枪、斥候步枪和狙击步枪会对玻璃拱顶中的神谕造成额外伤害。

desc.en: While you are standing on a sync plate or are near a conflux, weapon attacks that hit powerful Vex combatants have a high chance to weaken those combatants.
desc.zh: 当你站在同步板上或汇流附近时，击中强力Vex战斗人员的武器攻击有高几率削弱战斗人员。

desc.en: Aiming this weapon without firing for a brief moment grants bonus range and precision damage while it remains zoomed.
desc.zh: 未射击下瞄准一小段时间可使瞄准状态下射程和精准伤害提高。

desc.en: Gain increased handling and reload speed when standing near allies. Firing this weapon also grants Wolfpack Rounds to nearby allies wielding non-Exotic Rocket Launchers.
desc.zh: 站在友军附近时，提高操控性和填装速度。使用此武器也能让附近使用非异域火箭发射器的友军获得狼群弹药。

desc.en: Adaptive. Final blows with this weapon reload and overflow Sturm.
desc.zh: 适配。使用此武器造成最后一击会填装并溢装狂飙。

desc.en: Reduces grenade cooldown when using your class ability.
desc.zh: 使用职业技能时缩短手雷的冷却时间。

desc.en: Improved mobility.
desc.zh: 更高的敏捷度。

desc.en: Reloading this weapon after defeating a target causes the next hit to launch a Kinetic projectile that detonates into a disorienting blast.
desc.zh: 击败目标后填装此武器，会使下次命中发射一枚引爆造成迷失效果的动能射弹。

desc.en: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
desc.zh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

desc.en: While this weapon is at high stacks of Master, new rounds are continually loaded into the magazine, and the benefits from Bullseye Bolster last longer.
desc.zh: 当这件武器处于高层数大师状态时，新弹药将持续装入弹匣，且靶心加固的效果持续时间更长。

desc.en: Gradually reloads your stowed Machine Guns over time. Multiple copies of this perk stack to reduce the time taken to fully reload.
desc.zh: 随着时间推移，逐渐为已收起的机枪装填弹药。此特性的效果可以叠加，以缩短完全重新装弹的耗时。

desc.en: Improves the effect of the Right Hook and Runneth Over weapon Origin perks.
desc.zh: 强化“右勾拳”和“火力满溢”武器原有特性的效果。

desc.en: Gain Super energy on Sword final blows.
desc.zh: 刀剑最后一击获得超能能量。

desc.en: Reloading after defeating targets grants an increased amount of energy to your lowest charged ability.
desc.zh: 击败目标后填装，会提供更多能量给当前充能最低的技能。

desc.en: Health regeneration begins immediately upon activating Matterspark.
desc.zh: 启动物质火花后立即开始生命值回复。

n.en: Health regeneration begins immediately upon activating Matterspark.
n.zh: 启动物质火花后立即开始生命值回复。

desc.en: Increases accuracy and ready speed while firing from the hip.
desc.zh: 提高腰际射击时的命中率和准备速度。

desc.en: Each stack of Gathering Light improves this weapon's reload, handling, and target acquisition.
desc.zh: 每层“光能聚集”均可提升此武器的填装、操控性和目标获取能力。

desc.en: Your health begins to regenerate immediately after picking up an Orb of Power.
desc.zh: 拾取能量球后立即开始恢复生命值。

desc.en: Gain 10% more XP while on Io.
desc.zh: 在木卫一上获取10%的额外经验值。

desc.en: Being near allies grants increased cooling or charge rate, and increased damage while at high heat or low guard energy.
desc.zh: 靠近盟友时，提升冷却或充能速度；高热量或低格挡能量时，提升伤害。

desc.en: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
desc.zh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

desc.en: Increased chance for kills to regen health.
desc.zh: 提高击杀即可恢复生命值的几率。

desc.en: Reduces recoil for the equipped Energy weapon.
desc.zh: 降低已装备能量武器的后坐力。

desc.en: Faster ready and stow speed for Sniper Rifles.
desc.zh: 提高狙击步枪的收举速度。

desc.en: Adds a green Ghost ring to your transmat effects.
desc.zh: 为你的传送效果添加一个绿色机灵环。

desc.en:
Whenever you gain, lose, or spend an Armor Charge, heal and gain damage reduction for a short time.

This effect scales with the amount of Armor Charge gained, lost, or spent.
desc.zh:
获得、失去或消耗护甲充能时，在短时间内获得治疗和伤害减免。

此效果根据获得、失去和消耗的护甲充能数量而调整。

desc.en: When your shields become broken, collect all nearby Orbs of Power and ammo bricks.
desc.zh: 你的护盾被击破时，自动收集附近所有的能量球与弹药盒。

desc.en: Increased magazine size. Grants increased handling, reload speed, and weapon range based on the number of stacks of Paracausal Charge.
desc.zh: 弹匣容量提高。根据“超因果充能”层数提高操控性、填装速度和武器射程。

desc.en:
The detonations from Warmind Cells you destroy cause disruption, stunning combatants, delaying ability energy regeneration and lowering combatant damage output.

Strong against [Disruption]  Overload Champions  and [Stagger]  Unstoppable Champions.
desc.zh:
你摧毁的战争思维电池所引发的爆炸会造成干扰，眩晕战斗人员，延缓其技能能量回复并降低伤害输出。

克制过载勇士和势不可挡勇士。

desc.en: This visual effect is suppressed while in combat.
desc.zh: 此视觉效果在战斗中会被抑制。

desc.en: Detect resources within a 30-meter range while on Nessus.
desc.zh: 在涅索斯上探测30米范围内的资源。

desc.en: Adds a white Ghost ring to your transmat effects.
desc.zh: 为你的传送效果添加一个白色机灵环。

desc.en: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
desc.zh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

desc.en: You and your allies can shoot through your Towering Barricade.
desc.zh: 你和你的盟友可以穿过你的巍峨屏障进行射击。

desc.en: Automatically reloads the magazine and improves weapon handling when lightly wounded—even when this weapon is stowed.
desc.zh: 轻伤时自动填装弹匣并提升武器操控性，此武器收起时也有效。

desc.en: Greatly reduces flinching from incoming fire while aiming Shotguns.
desc.zh: 大幅降低使用霰弹枪瞄准时因受到伤害而产生的画面颤动。

n.zh: 强化型稳定霰弹枪瞄准

desc.en: Enemies are less aggressive toward you while you are riding this Sparrow.
desc.zh: 敌人对你在使用快雀时的攻击减少。

desc.en: Gambit wins have a chance to drop an additional piece of Legendary gear.
desc.zh: 在智谋中取胜有几率掉落一件额外的传说装备。

desc.en: Faster charge time or draw time when surrounded by combatants.
desc.zh: 缩短被战斗人员包围时的充能时间或蓄力时间。

desc.en: Increases the amount of Rocket Launcher ammo you can carry.
desc.zh: 提高可携带的火箭发射器弹药数量。

desc.en: Raid rotator challenges grant Spoils of Conquest. Trials wins grant additional Trials reputation.
desc.zh: 突袭轮转挑战可奖励征服战利品。试炼胜场可奖励额外的试炼声望。

desc.en: This weapon's melee attacks deal increased damage and slow targets when loaded with ammo.
desc.zh: 此武器的近战攻击在武器装填有弹药的情况下可造成更高的伤害并让目标减速。

desc.en: Greatly increases ready and stow speed for Machine Guns.
desc.zh: 大幅提高机枪的收举速度。

desc.en: Detonation has a brief disorienting effect.
desc.zh: 引爆后拥有短暂的迷失效果。

desc.en: Picking up Special or Heavy ammo automatically loads this weapon beyond normal capacity.
desc.zh: 拾取特殊或重型弹药可自动填装武器至超出正常弹药储存量。

desc.en: Your equipped Scout Rifles fire shield-piercing rounds and stun [Shield-Piercing] Barrier Champions.
desc.zh: 你装备的斥候步枪会发射护盾穿透子弹并眩晕屏障勇士。

desc.en: Causing damage with a Solar ability weakens Champions and bosses for a short duration.
desc.zh: 使用烈日技能造成伤害会在短时间内削弱勇士和首领。

desc.en: Defeating a frozen target spawns Stasis crystals.
desc.zh: 击败被冻结目标会生成冰影水晶。

desc.en: Picking up an Orb of Power grants Strand weapons Unraveling Rounds.
desc.zh: 拾取能量球会使缚丝武器获得瓦解弹药。

desc.en: Breaking a combatant's shield with a Strand or Stasis weapon has a chance to suspend or freeze that combatant.
desc.zh: 使用缚丝或冰影武器打破战斗人员的护盾有几率悬停或冻结该战斗人员。

desc.en: Rocket Launchers deal increased damage to Champions.
desc.zh: 火箭发射器对勇士造成更高伤害。

desc.en: Lobs explosive slugs.
desc.zh: 发射爆炸弹头。

desc.en:
Improves the benefits provided by the Sundering, Nano-Munitions, and Nanotech Tracer Rockets Origin Traits.

Additionally, weapons with these traits are always overcharged.
desc.zh:
提升分离、纳米弹药和纳米技术追踪火箭原始特性提供的增益。

此外，拥有这些特性的武器会始终过充。

desc.en: Increases ability damage to Taken and Scorn combatants.
desc.zh: 提升对傀儡军团和嗤魅战斗人员的技能伤害。

desc.en: Combines the Solar/Strand and Solar/Stasis Siphon mods into one.
desc.zh: 将烈日/缚丝和烈日/冰影虹吸模组合二为一。

desc.en: Radiant causes Solar weapons to apply scorch to unscorched combatants.
desc.zh: 焕光会使烈日武器获得灼烧未被灼烧的战斗人员的能力。

desc.en: Rapid final blows with Rocket Launchers and Grenade Launchers grant Armor Charge.
desc.zh: 火箭发射器和榴弹发射器快速最后一击会提供护甲充能。

desc.en: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
desc.zh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

desc.en: Even faster grenade cooldown when using your class ability.
desc.zh: 使用职业技能时大幅缩短手雷的冷却时间。

desc.en: Sliding over ammo bricks reloads your equipped weapon and grants you a small amount of Bolt Charge.
desc.zh: 滑行经过弹药盒会填装你当前装备的武器，并为你提供少量电光充能。

desc.en: Using your grenade ability partially refills the magazine and changes this weapon's damage type to match your grenade until you stow it.
desc.zh: 使用你的手雷技能会填装一部分弹匣，并更改此武器的伤害类型，使其匹配你手雷的属性，直到你收起此武器。

desc.en: You deal significantly increased Kinetic damage to combatant shields, overshields, vehicles, and constructs. Constructs include barricades, turrets, Stasis crystals, and other objects created in the field.
desc.zh: 你对战斗人员护盾、覆盖护盾、载具和构造体造成的动能伤害显著提升。构造体包括屏障、炮台、冰影水晶以及其他在战场上生成的物体。

desc.en: Defeating powerful combatants or breaking a combatant shield with Kinetic damage releases a disorienting Kinetic shockwave.
desc.zh: 使用动能伤害击败强力战斗人员或破坏战斗人员护盾会释放具有迷失效果的动能冲击波。

desc.en:
Activating your class ability leaves behind a decoy woven from [Strand] Strand matter that draws the attention of nearby combatants.

After taking significant damage or when combatants approach, the decoy detonates, dealing damage and releasing Threadlings that seek out and attack nearby foes.

This ability's damage increases with your Class stat when your Class stat is 100 or higher.
desc.zh:
激活你的职业技能将留下一个由缚丝物质编织的诱饵，吸引附近战斗人员的注意。

在受到高额伤害或战斗人员接近时，诱饵会自动引爆，造成伤害并释放出能追寻并攻击附近敌人的线虫。

当你的职业属性达到100或更高时，此技能伤害会根据职业属性而增加。

desc.en:
[Shoot]  : Hold to charge; release to fire.
Charged projectiles have a delayed Solar payload.
desc.zh:
[射击]  ：长按充能；松开时射击。
充能射弹具有延迟的烈日载荷。

desc.en: Temporarily increases reload speed and handling after sprinting or while amplified; increased reload speed and handling have a longer duration. This effect is significantly improved when you are amplified.
desc.zh: 在冲刺后或处于增幅状态时暂时提高填装速度和操控性；填装速度和操控性的提升将持续更长时间。此效果在你处于增幅状态时会得到显著提升。

desc.en: Weave Solar Light into blades and smite your foes from the skies.
desc.zh: 将烈日之光化作利刃，从空中轰击敌人。

desc.en: The first Vanguard Armory quest completed each week grants an Ascendant Shard.
desc.zh: 每周完成的第一个先锋军械库任务会奖励一个上维碎片。

desc.en: Damaging a Glyphkeeper with a grenade causes your equipped Auto Rifles, Linear Fusion Rifles, Scout Rifles, and Sniper Rifles to deal additional damage.
desc.zh: 使用手雷对雕文守护者造成伤害，可使你装备的自动步枪、线性融合步枪、斥候步枪和狙击步枪造成额外伤害。

desc.en:
[Heavy Attack]  : Launch a heavy spin attack.
Heavy attacks are stronger with full energy.
desc.zh:
[重攻击]  ：发动一次重旋转攻击。
完全充能的重攻击更加猛烈。

desc.en: Improves aim assist, aim down sights speed, and airborne effectiveness. Increases these effects when there are no nearby allies.
desc.zh: 提升瞄准辅助、瞄准速度和空中效率。附近没有盟友时这些效果将提升。

desc.en: Damaging a Warmind Cell creates a burst of suppressing Void energy. Additionally, you deal less damage to Warmind Cells.
desc.zh: 对战争思维电池造成伤害会引爆一股压制性虚空能量。另外，你对战争思维电池造成的伤害减少。

desc.en: Earn bonus Enhancement Cores when completing ritual activities.
desc.zh: 完成仪式活动时获得额外的强化核心。

desc.en: Earn bonus Enhancement Prisms when completing ritual activities.
desc.zh: 完成仪式活动时获得额外的增强棱镜。

desc.en: Armor pieces with random stats you acquire will have a guaranteed minimum of 10 Discipline, and are more likely to drop with higher Discipline.
desc.zh: 你所获得的带有随机属性的护甲保底有10点纪律，且很可能掉落时带有更多的纪律。

desc.en: Rockets spawn cluster bombs upon detonation. Blast radius is increased.
desc.zh: 引爆火箭时会释放出集束炸弹。扩大爆炸范围。

desc.en: High-power draw with over-penetrating arrows.
desc.zh: 高能量拉弓可射出贯穿箭矢。

desc.en: Detect caches within a 30-meter range while on the Tangled Shore.
desc.zh: 在纷争海岸上探测30米范围内的缓存箱。

n.zh: 纷争海岸缓存箱探测器

desc.en: Rev to empower; bypasses shields. Strong against [Shield-Piercing] Barrier Champions.
desc.zh: 旋转以赋能；无视护盾。克制屏障勇士。

desc.en: Picking up an Arc elemental well causes your next melee to deal increased damage.
desc.zh: 拾取电弧元素井可使你的下一次近战造成更高的伤害。

desc.en:
While you have an Overshield or are inside Ward of Dawn, final blows grant grenade and melee energy, you have increased melee range and damage, and melee final blows restore a small portion of your Overshield and extend its duration.

You gain an additional Shield Throw while in Sentinel Shield.
desc.zh:
拥有覆盖护盾或位于黎明护罩内时，进行最后一击提供手雷与近战能量，你的近战距离和伤害获得提升，近战最后一击可恢复小部分覆盖护盾并延长其持续时间。

在哨兵圣盾中时可进行一次额外的圣盾投掷。

desc.en: Gain ability energy when you are damaged. While you have a Void Super equipped, final blows grant Devour.
desc.zh: 受到伤害时获得技能能量。装备虚空超能时，最后一击会提供吞食。

desc.en: Arc melee kills grant health and melee energy.
desc.zh: 电弧近战击杀补充生命值和近战能量。

desc.en: Adds a purple class sigil to your transmat effects.
desc.zh: 为你的传送效果添加一个紫色职业印记。

desc.en: Fusion Rifles get bonus reserves when picking up ammo used by that Fusion Rifle.
desc.zh: 拾取该融合步枪所用弹药时，融合步枪获得额外储存弹药。

desc.en: Bonus damage when aiming down sights on the opening shot of an attack. This bonus is preserved if the shot deals precision damage or strikes an elemental shield.
desc.zh: 举枪瞄准时的第一发子弹造成额外伤害。如果射击造成精准伤害或击中元素护盾，此加成保持不变。

desc.en: Grants a chance for Heroic public events on Mars to reward an additional Mars token.
desc.zh: 有几率在火星上进行英雄公共事件时获得一枚额外的火星代币。

desc.en:
Increases weapon handling and reload speed. Gain the following effects while you are the last living member of your fireteam:
• Increased target acquisition
• Increased handling and reload speed
• Reduced flinch from incoming fire
desc.zh:
提高武器操控性和装填速度。当你作为你的火力战队最后一名存活的队员时获得以下效果：
·增强目标锁定
·增强操控性和装填速度
·减少收到伤害时的屏幕抖动

desc.en:
Aiming down Pulse Rifle sights loads a high-impact burst that stuns unshielded combatants.

Strong against [Stagger] Unstoppable Champions.
desc.zh:
举枪瞄准脉冲步枪会装载一梭强力爆破弹药，可眩晕无护盾的战斗人员。

克制势不可挡勇士。

desc.zh: 你所获得的带有随机属性的护甲保底有10点韧性，且很可能掉落时带有更多的韧性。

desc.en: Gain charges by assisting your allies with revives, healing, overshields, and subclass buffs. Consume charges by defeating combatants. While charged, this weapon is granted improved bonus handling, reload speed, and Sword charge rate.
desc.zh: 通过使用复活、治疗、覆盖护盾和分支职业增益协助盟友来获得充能。击败战斗人员会消耗充能。充能时，此武器可获得更多的操控性、填装速度和刀剑充能速度加成。

desc.en:
While Solar empowered:
- Solar Supers have extended durations.
- You radiate damaging Solar energy.
- Damage resistance increases.
- You heal passively.

On PRISM Day, Solar empowerment is applied while using a Solar subclass.
desc.zh:
在烈日赋能期间：
-延长烈日超能的持续时间。
-你会散发出具有伤害性的烈日能量。
-提高伤害抗性。
-你会被动治疗。

在棱镜日，使用烈日分支职业时会应用烈日赋能。

desc.en: Increases reload speed of Pulse Rifles.
desc.zh: 提高脉冲步枪的填装速度。

desc.en: Damaging rank-and-file combatants increases damage against more powerful ones.
desc.zh: 对普通敌人造成伤害会提升对高阶敌人的伤害。

desc.en: Hitting three separate targets increases weapon handling, stability, reload, and range for an improved duration.
desc.zh: 命中三个不同目标可提高武器操控性、稳定性、填装和射程，持续时间延长。

desc.en: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
desc.zh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

desc.en:
Increased handling, reload speed, and stability when no abilities are fully charged.

Swords gain increased guard resistance and charge rate instead.
desc.zh:
在没有技能处于完全充能状态时提高操控性、填装速度和稳定性。

而刀剑则可提高防御抗性和充能速度。

desc.en: Performing a finisher on powerful combatants heals you and generates loyal Void moths.
desc.zh: 对强力战斗人员执行终结技会获得治疗并生成忠于你的虚空飞蛾。

desc.en: Performing a finisher on a combatant, or landing successive powered melee final blows, generates an Elemental pickup based on your Light subclass.
desc.zh: 对战斗人员执行终结技，或造成连续充能近战最后一击，会根据你的光能分支职业生成一个元素拾取物。

desc.en: Proximity evaluation systems enable handling and stability when enemies are close.
desc.zh: 在敌人接近时提供操控性和稳定性的近接评估系统。

desc.en: Improved target acquisition, accuracy, and aim-down-sights speed for Solar weapons.
desc.zh: 改善烈日武器的目标捕获能力、精度和瞄准速度。

desc.en: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
desc.zh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

desc.en: Enhanced Tripmines.
desc.zh: 技能伤害可强化感应手雷。

desc.en: Boosts Sidearms, especially when you're wounded.
desc.zh: 大幅增强手枪伤害，尤其在身受重伤时。

desc.en: While sliding, activate your charged melee ability to blink forward, calling down lightning strikes that jolt targets as you rematerialize. This ability also makes you amplified and grants Bolt Charge.
desc.zh: 在滑铲时，启动你的已充能近战技能来向前瞬移，在重新物质化的同时降下闪电打击震颤目标。此技能还能让你获得增幅状态，并提供电光充能。

desc.en: Dealing continuous damage extends the duration of Ravenous Beast.
desc.zh: 造成持续伤害会延长贪食野兽的持续时间。

desc.en: Fires Stasis and Solar pellets quickly. Strong against [Stagger] Unstoppable Champions.
desc.zh: 快速发射冰影和烈日弹片。克制势不可挡勇士。

desc.en: Rounds at the end of the magazine deal more damage.
desc.zh: 弹匣中最后的几发弹药可造成更高伤害。

desc.en: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
desc.zh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

desc.en: Hitting three separate targets increases damage for a moderate duration.
desc.zh: 命中三个不同目标可在一定时间内提高伤害。

desc.en: You gain a bonus to your weapons stat while you have any Armor Charge. Your Armor Charge decays over time.
desc.zh: 在拥有任何护甲充能时，你会获得额外武器属性。你的护甲充能会逐渐衰减。

desc.en: Compound. Optimized for damage.
desc.zh: 复合弓。优化伤害。

desc.en: This weapon is Full Auto, does extra damage to Cabal, and penetrates Phalanx shields.
desc.zh: 全自动武器，可对卡巴尔造成额外伤害，可穿透方阵士兵护盾。

desc.en: Increases the amount of Shotgun ammo you can carry.
desc.zh: 提高可携带的霰弹枪弹药储量。

desc.en: Consuming your Arc grenade grants an Arc Soul and amplifies you.
desc.zh: 消耗你的电弧手雷可提供电弧之魂并使你进入增幅状态。

desc.en: Final blows with this weapon grant increased health and additional damage resistance from combatants.
desc.zh: 使用此武器造成最后一击可提供更高的生命值以及对战斗人员的额外伤害抗性。

desc.en: Shotgun and melee final blows start health regeneration and extend defensive buffs.
desc.zh: 霰弹枪和近战最后一击会开启生命值回复并延长防御性增益。

desc.en:
Your Healing, Solar, Firebolt, and Fusion Grenades have enhanced functionality.

Healing Grenade: Improves the strength of cure and restoration effects applied. Consuming a Healing Grenade with Heat Rises also applies restoration to nearby allies.

Solar Grenade: Increases linger duration. Periodically emits blobs of lava around its perimeter.

Firebolt Grenade: Increases target search radius and maximum target count.

Fusion Grenade: Explodes twice.
desc.zh:
你的治愈、烈日、烈焰和融合手雷功能增强。

治愈手雷：提高所施加的治愈和恢复效果的强度。 炙热升腾时消耗治愈手雷还会对附近的盟友提供恢复效果。

烈日手雷：提升持续时间。在其周围周期性地发射熔岩团块。

烈焰手雷：提升目标搜寻范围和最大目标数。

融合手雷：可爆炸两次。

desc.en: Bonuses to guarding with Swords.
desc.zh: 刀剑格挡加成。

desc.en:
Hurl an explosive bolt of Void Light at a target, disintegrating those caught within its blast.

Nova Bomb creates a singularity that pulls targets inward and continually damages those trapped inside.
desc.zh:
向目标抛出可发生爆炸的虚空光束，裂解爆炸范围内的敌人。

新星炸弹可产生一个奇点，将目标拉入其中，并对困在其中的敌人造成持续性伤害。

desc.en:
Step between dimensions to subvert the laws of physics.

[Super Secondary]  : Teleport a short distance and release weakening seekers.

[Super Primary]  : Unleash a deadly Void eruption. A fully charged attack makes targets volatile.
desc.zh:
穿梭于位面之间以颠覆物理定律。

[超能附技能]  ：传送一小段距离并放出削弱追踪弹。

[超能主技能]  ：释放一次致命虚空爆发。完全充能的攻击可对目标施加不稳定效果。

desc.en:
Hurl an explosive bolt of Void Light at a target, disintegrating those caught within its blast.

Nova Bomb travels slowly and seeks targets. Detonations shatter into smaller seeker projectiles.
desc.zh:
向目标抛出虚空光能爆炸光束，裂解爆炸范围内的敌人。

新星炸弹会缓慢移动并追踪目标。发生爆炸时会碎裂成较小的追踪性射弹。

desc.en: Charge weapon to enable special projectile attack.
desc.zh: 充能武器来启用特殊射弹攻击。

desc.en: Final blows with this weapon grant a small amount of Super energy. Equipping multiple weapons from the Pale Heart increases this effect.
desc.zh: 使用此武器造成最后一击可恢复少量超能能量。装备苍白之心的多件武器会增加这一效果。

desc.en: Chance to obtain additional faction consumables in the Crucible.
desc.zh: 有机会在熔炉竞技场中获得额外的阵营消耗品。

desc.en:
Unleash a long-range channeled beam of concentrated Arc energy. Sustained damage on a single target creates a jolting lightning strike at their position.

 [Super]  while active to deactivate your Super early, saving Super energy.
desc.zh:
释放一道由浓缩电弧能量组成的远距离引导光束。对单体目标造成持续伤害可在其位置生成一道震颤闪电打击。激活时

 [超能] 可以提前终止超能，保留部分超能能量。

desc.en:
Chain Arc Lightning from your hands to electrify targets with devastating streams of Arc Light that intensify over time. Casting Stormtrance creates a jolting shockwave underneath you.

[Sprint]  : Teleport forward, consuming a small amount of Super energy.
desc.zh:
从你的手中释放电弧闪电，用极具破坏力且随着时间增强的电弧光能流来电击目标。施放雷霆万钧会在你脚下产成一道震颤冲击波。

[冲刺]  ：向前传送，消耗少量超能能量。

desc.en: Kills with this weapon reload Sturm. Consecutive kills overflow Sturm's magazine with bonus damage rounds.
desc.zh: 使用武器击杀可填装狂飙。连续击杀可向狂飙弹匣中多加入具有额外伤害的弹药。

desc.en: Gradually reloads your stowed Sniper Rifles over time. Multiple copies of this perk stack to reduce the time taken to fully reload.
desc.zh: 随着时间推移，逐渐为已收起的狙击步枪装填弹药。此特性的效果可以叠加，以缩短完全重新装弹的耗时。

desc.en: Double tracking rockets, Void and Solar. Strong against [Disruption] Overload Champions.
desc.zh: 双发追踪火箭，虚空和烈日。克制过载勇士。

desc.en: Picking up a Void Breach or an Orb of Power grants Devour.
desc.zh: 拾取虚空裂口或能量球会赋予吞食。

desc.en: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
desc.zh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

desc.en: Final blows with weapons that have the Featherweight Origin Trait grant further increased movement speed while equipped.
desc.zh: 装备时，使用有羽量原始特性的武器造成最后一击会进一步提升移动速度。

desc.en: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
desc.zh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

desc.en: Blocking damage partially reloads this weapon from reserves. Shortens delay between activations.
desc.zh: 阻挡伤害可从储备弹药中部分填装此武器。减少启动延迟。

desc.en: Faster ready and stow speed for Grenade Launchers.
desc.zh: 提高榴弹发射器的收举速度。

desc.en: When healing projectiles from this weapon strike allies, you also receive a small amount of healing.
desc.zh: 此武器的治疗射弹击中盟友时，你也会获得少量治疗。

desc.en: Receiving damage while guarding temporarily increases Sword lunge distance.
desc.zh: 防御时受到伤害会暂时增加刀剑前冲距离。

desc.en: Increases the Health stat.
desc.zh: 提升生命值属性。

desc.en: Final loss has been forgiven.
desc.zh: 最后一场失利已被宽恕。

desc.en: Blocking damage with your shield increases movement speed for an improved duration while you are shielding.
desc.zh: 使用护盾阻挡伤害可在更长时间内提高举盾时的移动速度。

desc.en: This vehicle has a shorter cooldown between summonings.
desc.zh: 使两次召唤载具的间隔时间减少。

desc.en: Increases the ammo generation of Solar weapons.
desc.zh: 提升烈日武器的弹药生成速度。

desc.en: Power levels fluctuate over time.
desc.zh: 功率级会逐渐波动。

desc.en: Boosts movement speed. Radar stays active while aiming.
desc.zh: 提升移动速度。瞄准时将始终显示雷达。

desc.en: Adds a circular Vex Gate to your transmat effects.
desc.zh: 为你的传送效果添加一个Vex传送门形态。

desc.en: Adds fire and smoke to your transmat effects.
desc.zh: 为你的传送效果添加一个烟火余烬形态。

desc.en: Adds a Cabal shield to your transmat effects.
desc.zh: 为你的传送效果添加一个卡巴尔护盾形态。

desc.en: Adds the illusion of a steamer trunk to your transmat effects.
desc.zh: 为你的传送效果添加一个蒸汽车行李箱形态。

desc.en: A member of your fireteam has used a scout report, which highlights nearby loot catches on Mercury for all members of the fireteam.
desc.zh: 你所在火力战队的一名成员使用了侦察报告，为火力战队的所有成员在水星上标记出位于附近的战利品缓存箱。

desc.en: Increased Vanguard token drops for you and your fireteam in this strike.
desc.zh: 在此次打击中增加你和你所在火力战队的先锋代币掉落几率。

desc.en: Gain 10% more XP while in Gambit.
desc.zh: 在智谋中获取10%的额外经验值。

desc.en:
While you're on the Leviathan, defeating normal enemies with an Energy weapon boosts Energy weapon damage by 15% for a short time.

This mod's abilities cannot stack across multiple copies.
desc.zh:
当你在利维坦上使用能量武器消灭普通敌人时，短时间内能量武器的伤害将提高15%。

这个模组的能力无法重复叠加。

desc.en: This weapon gains bonus range and deals more flinch at the start of combat for an improved duration. Strong against [Stagger] Unstoppable Champions.
desc.zh: 战斗开始时，此武器会暂时获得射程加成并造成更多的抖动，效果持续时间延长。克制势不可挡勇士。

desc.en: Opens your mind to the secrets of the Dreaming City.
desc.zh: 向幽梦之城的秘密敞开心扉吧。

desc.en: Receiving or discharging Bolt Charge partially loads an improved quantity of the magazine from reserves.
desc.zh: 接收或释放电光充能会从备弹中填装弹匣的一部分，填装量更多。

desc.en: Improves Scorch, Ignitions, and Daybreak projectiles.
desc.zh: 增强灼烧、点燃和黎明射弹。

desc.en:
Finishers restore class abilities. 

Consumes 3 or more stacks of Armor Charge, granting additional energy for each charge consumed.
desc.zh:
终结技会恢复职业技能。

消耗3层或更多护甲充能。每消耗一层会提供额外能量。

desc.en: Increases Glimmer gains by 5%.
desc.zh: 微光获取量提高5%。

desc.en: Increases Glimmer gains by 10%.
desc.zh: 微光获取量提高10%。

desc.en: Increases Glimmer gains by 20%.
desc.zh: 微光获取量提高20%。

desc.en: Increases Glimmer gains by 35%.
desc.zh: 微光获取量提高35%。

desc.en: Increases Glimmer gains by 50%.
desc.zh: 微光获取量提高50%。

desc.en: Increases Glimmer gains by 65%.
desc.zh: 微光获取量提高65%。

desc.en: Increases the effect of all contributions towards the Special ammo meter.
desc.zh: 提升对特殊弹药量表的所有计入效果。

desc.en: Greatly increases magazine.
desc.zh: 大幅提高弹匣容量。

desc.en: Applying an elemental debuff to a target increases this weapon's reload speed, aim assist, and movement while aiming down sights for a short duration.
desc.zh: 对一个目标造成元素减益会在较短时间内提升此武器的填装速度、瞄准辅助和瞄准时的移动速度。

desc.en: Adds a swirl of team color to your transmat effects.
desc.zh: 为你的传送效果添加一抹团队色彩。

desc.en: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
desc.zh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

desc.en: Improved target acquisition, accuracy, and aim-down-sights speed for Scout Rifles.
desc.zh: 改善斥候步枪的目标捕获能力、精度和瞄准速度。

desc.en: Final blows with this weapon while your Super is full grant a bonus to melee and grenade stat for a moderate duration.
desc.zh: 超能能量全满时使用此武器造成最后一击可在一定时间内提供近战和手雷属性加成。

desc.en: The further a Void orb falls, the more powerful its detonation becomes.
desc.zh: 虚空能量球下落的距离越长，它的爆炸威力就越强大。

desc.en: Gradually reloads your stowed Power Grenade Launchers over time. Multiple copies of this perk stack to reduce the time taken to fully reload.
desc.zh: 随着时间推移，逐渐为已收起的威能榴弹发射器装填弹药。此特性的效果可以叠加，以缩短完全重新装弹的耗时。

desc.en: Final blows grant an improved stacking bonus to airborne effectiveness. Final blows while airborne grant increased stacks.
desc.zh: 最后一击可为空中效率提供更多叠加加成。在空中时最后一击可提供更多层数。

desc.en: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
desc.zh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

desc.en: Access Matterspark shortcuts across Kepler.
desc.zh: 可使用开普勒各处的物质火花捷径。

n.zh: 可使用开普勒各处的物质火花捷径。

desc.en: Shattering a frozen target refills this weapon's magazine from reserves.
desc.zh: 击碎被冻住的目标会使此武器从备弹中补充弹匣。

desc.en: Adds a blue Ghost ring to your transmat effects.
desc.zh: 为你的传送效果添加一个蓝色机灵环。

desc.en: When an ally dies or you reach critical health, this weapon's magazine refills, and it gains bonus range, charge rate, and handling.
desc.zh: 当盟友死亡或你生命危急时，此武器的弹匣会重新填充，并获得额外的射程、充能速度和操控性。

desc.en: Adds a Fallen Servitor appearance to your transmat effects.
desc.zh: 为你的传送效果添加一个堕落魔眼外观。

desc.en: Detect caches within a 40-meter range while on Mercury.
desc.zh: 在水星上探测40米范围内的缓存箱。

n.zh: 增强版水星缓存箱探测器

desc.en: Improved accuracy and range on the opening shot of attack.
desc.zh: 第一发弹药的精度和射程提高。

desc.en:
Collecting an Elemental pickup or destroying a Tangle grants this weapon a stacking period of melee energy generation on hit. Throwing a Tangle provides additional time.

Elemental pickups include [Solar]Firesprites, [Void]Void Breaches, [Arc]Ionic Traces, [Stasis]Stasis Shards, and [Strand]Strand Tangles.
desc.zh:
收集一个元素拾取物或摧毁缠结会赋予此武器一段叠加期，期间命中时生成近战能量。投掷缠结会延长持续时间。

元素拾取物包括焰灵、虚空裂口、离子轨迹、冰影碎片和缚丝缠结。

desc.en: Spark of Strength
desc.zh: 力量火花

desc.en: Collecting ammo loads an explosive round that adheres to surfaces, detonates shortly after impact, and applies exhaust.
desc.zh: 拾取弹药会装填一枚可粘附于各种表面的高爆弹药，命中后不久引爆并施加疲惫。

desc.en: Swords get larger bonus reserves when you pick up ammo.
desc.zh: 拾取弹药时刀剑获得额外弹药储量。

desc.en: Breaking a target's shield partially reloads this weapon's magazine.
desc.zh: 击破目标的护盾会部分填装此武器的弹匣。

desc.en: Igniting nearby targets partially replenishes fuel. This weapon refills itself from reserves upon gaining maximum fuel.
desc.zh: 点燃附近的目标可部分补充燃料。该武器在获得最大燃料后会从储备中重新填充。

desc.en: Rapid Kinetic weapon final blows create an Orb of Power.
desc.zh: 快速动能武器最后一击可生成能量球。

desc.en: [Grenade]  : Hold to convert your grenade into a [Stasis] Stasis turret that fires slowing projectiles at nearby targets.
desc.zh: [手雷]  ：长按将你的手雷转换成一个冰影炮台，向附近的目标发射减速射弹。

desc.en: Defeating a blinded target with precision damage creates a blinding explosion.
desc.zh: 用精准伤害击败一个被致盲的目标会造成一个致盲爆炸。

desc.en: Sustained kinetic damage to a target emits a shockwave that damages any nearby targets. Perk activates more quickly.
desc.zh: 对目标造成持续的动能伤害会发射出一道冲击波，对任何附近的目标造成伤害。特性启动速度更快。

desc.en: When this weapon is fully spun up, the flinch from incoming damage is greatly reduced.
desc.zh: 当枪管完全旋转起来时，来袭伤害产生的抖动大幅减少。

desc.en: Increase Glimmer gains by 10% on the moon of Titan.
desc.zh: 在土卫六上的微光获取量提升10%。

desc.en: Charge weapon to enable special projectile attack.
desc.zh: 充能武器来启用特殊射弹攻击。

desc.en: Dealing damage grants an improved stacking bonus to magazine size, target acquisition, and range until your next final blow with this weapon.
desc.zh: 造成伤害会为弹匣容量、目标捕获能力和射程提供更多可叠加的加成，直至你下一次使用此武器造成最后一击。

desc.en: Significantly increased rate of fire. Defeating targets auto loads from reserves.
desc.zh: 显著提高射速。击败目标会从弹药储备中自动填装。

desc.en: Increases reload speed of Sniper Rifles.
desc.zh: 提高狙击步枪的填装速度。

desc.en: Adds Void elements to your transmat effects.
desc.zh: 为你的传送效果添加虚空元素。

desc.en: Gambit wins have a chance to award destination materials.
desc.zh: 在智谋中取胜有几率奖励目的地材料。

desc.en: Gradually reloads your stowed Fusion Rifles over time. Multiple copies of this perk stack to reduce the time taken to fully reload.
desc.zh: 随着时间推移，逐渐为已收起的融合步枪装填弹药。此特性的效果可以叠加，以缩短完全重新装弹的耗时。

desc.en: Powered Sword hits slow targets. Improves ammo capacity.
desc.zh: 充能刀剑命中可让目标减速，提高弹药容量。

desc.en: Dealing damage with both other weapons before readying this weapon refills it from reserves.
desc.zh: 在此武器准备就绪前，使用其他两件武器造成伤害可从弹药储备中填装弹药。

desc.en: Your powered melee final blows create Orbs of Power.
desc.zh: 你的充能近战最后一击可生成能量球。

desc.en: Dealing damage with a Transcendent grenade grants Ergo Sum ammo.
desc.zh: 使用超凡手雷造成伤害可获得故我在弹药。

desc.en: Shift instead of dodge.
desc.zh: 用位移替换闪身。

desc.en: Shield-piercing rounds designed to bypass combatant defenses. Strong against [Shield-Piercing] Barrier Champions.
desc.zh: 用于击穿敌方战斗人员防具的护盾穿透子弹。克制屏障勇士。

desc.en: While radiant, deal increased weapon damage to combatants affected by Strand and Stasis debuffs.
desc.zh: 处于焕光状态时，对受缚丝和冰影减益影响的战斗人员造成更多武器伤害。

desc.en: Casting your Solar Super grants nearby allies radiant and increases the damage of your Super for each nearby ally.
desc.zh: 施放烈日超能会使附近盟友进入焕光状态，而且附近的盟友越多，超能的伤害就越高。

desc.en: Rapid Solar weapon precision hits and rapid Solar weapon final blows grant Radiant.
desc.zh: 快速烈日武器精准命中和快速烈日武器最后一击会提供焕光效果。

desc.en:
Improves the benefits provided by the Noble Deeds, Unsated Hunger, Head Rush, and Dragon's Vengeance Origin Traits.

Additionally, weapons with these traits are always overcharged.
desc.zh:
提升高尚事迹、未足之饥、热血上头和龙之复仇原始特性提供的增益。

此外，拥有这些特性的武器会始终过充。

desc.en: While your Super is nearly fully-charged, ability final blows spawn Orbs of Power.
desc.zh: 当你的超能几乎完全充满时，技能最后一击会生成能量球。

desc.en: Overcharging both Arc and Stasis modes grants a period of increased damage.
desc.zh: 同时过充电弧与冰影模式可在一段时间内提升伤害。

desc.en: Reduces melee cooldown when using your class ability.
desc.zh: 使用职业技能时缩短近战技能的冷却时间。

desc.en: Defeating 4 or more combatants in a single volley increases the damage of the next volley and refunds ammunition.
desc.zh: 一次连射击败4个或以上战斗人员会提升下一次连射的伤害并退返弹药。

desc.en: Gain 10% more XP while on the Moon.
desc.zh: 在月球上获取10%的额外经验值。

desc.en:
Finisher final blows create a burst of Void damage that causes nearby combatants to become volatile.

Defeating volatile targets creates a Void Breach.
desc.zh:
终结技最后一击会制造一次虚空伤害爆发，使附近战斗人员获得不稳定效果。

击败不稳定目标会制造一个虚空裂口。

desc.en: Adds a cheerful appearance to your transmat effects.
desc.zh: 为你的传送效果添加一个欢快外观。

desc.en: Adds a phantasmagorical appearance to your transmat effects.
desc.zh: 为你的传送效果添加一个幻影外观。

desc.en: Grants weapon shield-piercing, bypassing combatant defenses. Strong against [Shield-Piercing] Barrier Champions.
desc.zh: 赐予武器 护盾穿透特性，击穿敌人的防御。克制屏障勇士。

desc.en: Gain Super energy on Linear Fusion Rifle final blows.
desc.zh: 线性融合步枪最后一击获得超能能量。

desc.en: Defeating frozen targets generates an Orb of Power.
desc.zh: 击败冻结的目标会生成一个能量球。

desc.en: Improved Primary weapon performance; final blows refund dodges.
desc.zh: 改良主武器性能；最后一击返还闪身。

desc.en: Detect resources within a 30-meter range.
desc.zh: 探测30米范围内的资源。

desc.en: Detect resources within a 20-meter range.
desc.zh: 探测20米范围内的资源。

desc.en: Detect resources within a 50-meter range.
desc.zh: 探测50米范围内的资源。

desc.en: Detect resources within a 40-meter range.
desc.zh: 探测40米范围内的资源。

desc.en: Detect resources within a 75-meter range.
desc.zh: 探测75米范围内的资源。

desc.en: Massively increases projectile velocity, increases reload speed.
desc.zh: 大幅提高弹头速度，提升填装速度。

desc.en: This weapon gains better target acquisition.
desc.zh: 武器具有更好的目标获取能力。

desc.en:
Sustained damage from this weapon exhausts the target for an improved duration.

Exhausted targets deal reduced outgoing damage.
desc.zh:
此武器的持续伤害会在更长时间内使目标疲惫。

疲惫的目标造成的伤害会减少。

desc.en: Become Charged with Light by picking up an elemental well. If the elemental well's element type matches your subclass element, you gain 2 stacks of Charged with Light.
desc.zh: 拾取元素井也会使你充斥光能。如果元素井的元素类型与你的分支职业元素相同，你会获得2层光之充能。

desc.en: Reloading after a final blow grants a period of increased damage. Additional final blows before reloading further increases the duration of the damage period.
desc.zh: 在最后一击后填装会获得一段时间的伤害提升。填装前额外造成最后一击会进一步延长伤害提升持续时间。

desc.en:
While you're on the Leviathan, your Arc abilities deal 25% more damage.

This mod's abilities cannot stack across multiple copies.
desc.zh:
在利维坦上时，你的电弧技能可造成25%额外伤害。

这个模组的能力无法重复叠加。

desc.en: Sword Guard has high resistance, but low endurance.
desc.zh: 刀剑格挡拥有高抗性和低持久。

desc.en: Improved target acquisition, accuracy, and aim-down-sights speed for Linear Fusion Rifles.
desc.zh: 改善线性融合步枪的目标捕获能力、精度和瞄准速度。

n.zh: 线性融合步枪瞄准性能

desc.en: After throwing an Arc grenade, gain increased grenade recharge for a short time. Arc final blows extend the duration of this benefit.
desc.zh: 投掷电弧手雷后，短时间内手雷充能速度加快。电弧最后一击会延长此增益的持续时间。

desc.en: +5 Melee ▲ / -5 Class ▼
Increases damage against bosses and vehicles.
desc.zh: 提高对首领和载具的伤害。

desc.en: Long range, slow firing, and high damage.
desc.zh: 高射程，低射速，高伤害。

desc.en: Arc weapons get bonus reserves when picking up ammo used by that weapon.
desc.zh: 拾取该电弧武器所用弹药时，获得额外弹药储量。

desc.en: Fires a three-round burst.
desc.zh: 可进行三发连射。

desc.en: This weapon gains bonus handling and reload speed based on your longest chain of rapid final blows from any source. After achieving an impressive record, final blows with this weapon create an elemental damage explosion.
desc.zh: 此武器会根据你通过任意来源达成的快速最后一击最高多杀数，获得额外操控性和填装速度。达成高多杀记录后，此武器的最后一击会造成元素伤害爆炸。

desc.en: Combines the Arc and Strand Siphon mods into one.
desc.zh: 将电弧和缚丝虹吸模组合二为一。

desc.en: Combines the Void and Strand Siphon mods into one.
desc.zh: 将虚空和缚丝虹吸模组合二为一。

desc.en: Combines the Solar and Strand Siphon mods into one.
desc.zh: 将烈日和缚丝虹吸模组合二为一。

desc.en: All Scavenger mods are discounted.
desc.zh: 所有回收器模组均享有折扣。

desc.en: Greatly improves the benefits provided by the Head Rush, Nanotech Tracer Rockets, Unsated Hunger, and Cursed Thrall Origin Traits.
desc.zh: 大幅提升热血上头、纳米技术追踪火箭、未足之饥和诅咒怨魂原始特性提供的增益。

desc.en:
This buff commemorates a Gold Tier score in the Guardian Games Rushdown activity on Expert mode.

Weapons and abilities empower each other. Defeating combatants with abilities grants increased weapon damage. Defeating combatants with weapons grants increased ability recharge speed.

Empowerment stacks 5 times.

While at maximum empowerment, defeat combatants to gain a boost to mobility, accuracy, handling, and reload.

Active only in Guardian Games Rushdown activities. This buff will expire on weekly reset.
desc.zh:
此增益用于纪念在专家模式的守护者游戏急速强攻活动的黄金阶得分。

武器与技能可互相赋能。使用技能击败战斗人员可增加武器伤害。使用武器击败战斗人员可提高技能充能速度。

赋能可叠加5次。

当达到最大赋能次数时，击败战斗人员可获得敏捷、精度、操控性和填装的提升。

仅在守护者游戏急速强攻活动中有效。此增益将在周重置时过期。

desc.en: Increases the amount of Glaive ammo you can carry.
desc.zh: 提高可携带的偃月弹药数量。

desc.en: When Personal Assistant is active, this weapon has better target acquisition and deals significantly more precision damage.
desc.zh: 当启用私人助手时，此武器拥有更好的目标捕获能力，显著造成更高的精准伤害。

desc.en: When this weapon's magazine is empty, it more effectively refills from reserves based on the number of hits.
desc.zh: 射空此武器的弹匣时，会根据命中次数更有效地从储存弹药中填装。

desc.en: Grants grenade energy on final blows with shield-piercing weapons or when a member of your fireteam shuts down a Barrier Champion's ability.
desc.zh: 使用 护盾穿透 武器打出最后一击或你的火力战队成员终结屏障勇士的技能时获得手雷能量。

desc.en:
Summon a [Stasis] Stasis staff. While your Super is active:

[Super Primary]  : Cast out a barrage of [Stasis] Stasis shards that freeze targets.

[Super Secondary]  : Cast out a shockwave that shatters all frozen targets.
desc.zh:
召唤一根冰影法杖。当超能激活时：

[超能主技能] ：施放由冰影碎片组成的弹幕，冻结敌人。

[超能附技能] ：施放一个震荡波，粉碎所有被冻结的敌人。

desc.en: Improved resilience.
desc.zh: 更强的韧性。

desc.en: Final blows with this weapon grant bonus damage for an improved duration. While this buff is active, grenade or melee final blows of the same damage type greatly increase its damage for an improved duration.
desc.zh: 使用此武器对敌人造成最后一击可提供额外伤害，持续时间延长。此增益生效期间，相同伤害类型的手雷或近战最后一击会大幅提高其伤害输出，持续时间延长。

desc.en: -10 Intellect
desc.zh: -10 智慧

desc.en: Adds Hive Knight miasma to your transmat effects.
desc.zh: 为你的传送效果添加邪魔族骑士瘴气。

desc.en: Adds eldritch energy to your transmat effects.
desc.zh: 为你的传送效果添加怪异能量。

desc.en: Adds Vex Minotaur data to your transmat effects.
desc.zh: 为你的传送效果添加Vex米诺陶数据。

desc.en: Adds the illusion of a treasure chest to your transmat effects.
desc.zh: 为你的传送效果添加宝箱的幻象。

desc.en: Adds the illusion of a tiger to your transmat effects.
desc.zh: 为你的传送效果添加老虎的幻象。

desc.en: Hipfire precision hits grant a massive draw speed bonus for an improved duration. Further precision hits extend the duration.
desc.zh: 腰射精准命中会提供大量拉弓速度加成，效果持续时间延长。更多精准命中可延长持续时间。

desc.en: Threadlings travel farther and deal additional damage.
desc.zh: 线虫可移动得更远并造成额外伤害。

desc.en:
XP gains increased by 2x for your first {var:429946734} Rewards Pass ranks this week.

XP is primarily earned from completing Orders, finishing Ops, and defeating combatants.
desc.zh:
你在本周的前{var:429946734}个奖励通票等级所获得的经验值会是常规情况下的2倍。

经验值主要通过完成命令、参与行动及击败战斗人员获取。

desc.en:
You will earn increased XP while Returner's Boon is active.

Fireteam members who do not have the Boon will be granted the Returner's Blessing buff.
desc.zh:
回归者恩惠生效时，你获得的经验值将增加。

未持有恩惠的火力战队成员将获得回归者祝福增益。

desc.en: Achieving victory in ritual activities grants a chance to award an Upgrade Module.
desc.zh: 在仪式活动中取胜有几率获得一个升级模块。

desc.en: Increases the amount of Trace Rifle ammo you can carry.
desc.zh: 提高可携带的追踪步枪弹药数量。

desc.en: Defeating scorched targets grants melee energy and creates a Firesprite.
desc.zh: 击败灼烧的目标可获得近战能量并生成一个焰灵。

desc.en: Acquired armor pieces with randomized stats are more likely to drop with the Skirmisher archetype, which has Melee as its primary stat and Weapons as its secondary.
desc.zh: 获取的随机属性护甲更有可能掉落突击手框架：近战为主要属性，武器为次要属性。

desc.en: XP gains have increased.
desc.zh: 经验值获取已提升。

desc.en: Precision final blows cause nearby targets to become severed.
desc.zh: 精准最后一击会使附近目标变得割裂。

desc.en: Increases the Weapons stat.
desc.zh: 提升武器属性。

desc.en: +20 Mobility
desc.zh: +20 敏捷

desc.en: Reloading immediately after a kill grants a brief period of invisibility.
desc.zh: 完成击杀后立即填装可在短时间内隐身。

desc.en: Detects caches within a 50-meter range and increases Glimmer gain.
desc.zh: 可探测50米范围内的缓存箱并提高微光获取量。

desc.en: If you have fewer than 2 stacks of Armor Charge, rapid precision shots with Bows, Snipers, and Scout Rifles generate an Armor Charge.
desc.zh: 如果你拥有的护甲充能少于2层，使用弓箭、狙击步枪和斥候步枪快速精准命中会生成一层护甲充能。

desc.en: Picking up a Tangle or Elemental Orb grants energy to your least-powered ability.
desc.zh: 拾取缠结或元素能量球会为你充能最少的技能提供能量。

desc.en: When an ally destroys or picks up your Tangle or Elemental Orb, the Tangle cooldown is reduced by 5 seconds and you gain bonus damage with weapons matching your subclass for 10 seconds.
desc.zh: 当盟友摧毁或拾取你的缠结或元素能量球时，缠结冷却减少5秒，你使用与分支职业相匹配的武器会获得额外伤害，持续10秒。

desc.en: While stunned, Champions take bonus damage from your abilities and Elemental Orb damage.
desc.zh: 处于眩晕状态时，勇士会受到来自你技能和元素能量球的额外伤害。

desc.en:
Uninterrupted fire from your equipped Machine Gun stuns unshielded combatants, delaying ability energy regeneration and lowering combatant damage output.

Strong against [Disruption] Overload Champions.
desc.zh:
使用装备的机枪不间断开火可眩晕无护盾的战斗人员，延缓其技能能量回复并降低其伤害输出。

克制过载勇士。

desc.en: Greatly improved target acquisition, accuracy, and aim-down-sights speed for Sniper Rifles.
desc.zh: 大幅改善狙击步枪的目标捕获能力、精度和瞄准速度。

n.zh: 强化型狙击步枪瞄准性能

desc.en: Arcane Needle causes suspending detonations.
desc.zh: 神秘织针会造成悬停爆炸。

desc.en:
Defeated bosses have a chance of dropping an Enhancement Core.

Effect lasts until an Enhancement Core is found. Only one Finest Matterweave can be active at a time.
desc.zh:
击败首领有几率掉落一个强化核心。

效果持续至找到强化核心。同一时间只能激活一个精良物织。

desc.en: While Engulfed in Light, dying or having the Chalice of Light taken from you creates a burst of healing around you. Multiple copies of this mod stack to increase the radius and potency of healing.
desc.zh: 被光能包围时，死亡或被夺走光能圣杯会使你周围爆发出治疗效果。此模组可叠加，以提升治疗的范围和效力。

desc.en: Picking up Heavy ammo also grants ammo to this weapon.
desc.zh: 捡取重型弹药会为此武器提供弹药。

desc.en: Melee kills overload the magazine to double its capacity.
desc.zh: 近战击杀多为弹匣添加一倍的弹药。

desc.en:
Freezing or suppressing a target reloads your equipped weapons and increases weapon stability, aim assist, and airborne effectiveness.

Defeating frozen or suppressed targets creates a Stasis Shard or Void Breach.
desc.zh:
冻结或压制目标会填装你已装备的武器并提升武器稳定性、瞄准辅助和空中效率。

击败被冻结或压制的目标会生成一个冰影碎片或虚空裂口。

desc.en: Breaking a target's shield partially reloads this weapon's magazine an improved amount.
desc.zh: 击破目标的护盾会部分填装此武器的弹匣，填装量提升。

desc.en: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
desc.zh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

desc.en: Final blows grant bonus stats based on the weapon's damage type alignment. Light elements grant stability and handling. Dark elements grant range and aim assist. While Transcendent, this weapon gets both bonuses.
desc.zh: 最后一击会根据武器伤害类型的分类赋予属性加成。光能元素赋予稳定性和操控性。暗影元素赋予射程和瞄准辅助。处于超凡状态时，这件武器同时获得两类加成。

desc.en: Single-slug precision round.
desc.zh: 单发精准弹药。

desc.en:
Bows gain shield-piercing arrows, which bypass combatant defenses.

Strong against [Shield-Piercing] Barrier Champions.
desc.zh:
弓箭射出护盾穿透箭矢，击穿战斗人员的防御。

克制屏障勇士。

desc.en: Increased reputation from match wins on a ticket.
desc.zh: 提升通过入场券比赛胜场获得的声望。

desc.zh: 探测30米范围内的缓存箱。

desc.en: Detects caches within a 20-meter range.
desc.zh: 探测20米范围内的缓存箱。

desc.zh: 探测50米范围内的缓存箱。

desc.zh: 探测40米范围内的缓存箱。

desc.en: Detects caches within a 75-meter range.
desc.zh: 探测75米范围内的缓存箱。

desc.en: Increases detonation damage as the projectile travels further before exploding.
desc.zh: 随着射弹在爆炸前飞得越远，造成的爆炸伤害就越高。

desc.en: Melee hits inflict potent corruption.
desc.zh: 近战命中会施加强效腐化。

desc.en: Improves grenades.
desc.zh: 提升手雷。

desc.en: Weapon final blows grant Super energy.
desc.zh: 武器最后一击会提供超能能量。

desc.en: Empowering Rifts grant you Devour. Defeating a target while Devour is active grants class ability energy.
desc.zh: 强能裂痕会赋予你吞食效果。吞食生效时击败目标会提供职业技能能量。

desc.en: Rifts provides damage reduction.
desc.zh: 裂痕会提供伤害减免。

desc.en: Empowered weapon damage recharges grenades.
desc.zh: 赋能武器伤害为手雷充能。

desc.en: Gain melee and grenade regeneration after your Super ends.
desc.zh: 超能结束后获得近战和手雷回复。

desc.en: Rifts periodically release Arc shockwaves.
desc.zh: 裂痕定期释放电弧冲击波。

desc.en: Tangles spawn Threadlings.
desc.zh: 缠结会生成线虫。

desc.en: Gain an additional melee charge.
desc.zh: 获得额外一次近战充能。

desc.en: Trace Rifles do more damage to targets afflicted by elemental debuffs matching their element type.
desc.zh: 追踪步枪对受到与其元素类型相匹配的元素减益影响的目标造成更多伤害。

desc.en: Picking up Special ammo has the chance to grant Heavy ammo.
desc.zh: 拾取特殊弹药有机会获得重型弹药。

desc.en: Damaging unraveled targets with a weapon occasionally spawns a Threadling. Threadlings sever targets that they damage.
desc.zh: 用武器伤害被瓦解的目标有时会产生一个线虫。线虫会对其伤害到的目标施加割裂。

desc.en: Rapid Glaive melee final blows grant Special ammo Glaives additional ammo. Blocking damage with Glaives increases their melee damage to targets.
desc.zh: 快速偃月近战最后一击会为特殊弹药偃月提供额外弹药。用偃月阻挡伤害会增加它们对目标的近战伤害。

desc.en: Rapidly applying Volatile causes your next instance of [Void]Void weapon damage to create a weakening burst. Applying Weaken provides a small Void Overshield.

desc.en: When you gain maximum Bolt Charge, you also become amplified. Lightning bolts deal more damage.
desc.zh: 获得最大电光充能时，你也会获得增幅。闪电造成更多伤害。

desc.en: Defeating powerful combatants with your finisher spawns Special ammo for you and your allies; defeated Subjugators, Tormentors, or Champions spawn more ammo.
desc.zh: 使用终结技击败强力战斗人员会为你和你的盟友生成特殊弹药；击败镇压者、折磨者或勇士会生成更多弹药。

desc.en:
Solar and Stasis grenades disrupt combatants, stunning them, delaying ability regeneration and lowering combatant damage output.

Strong against [Disruption] Overload Champions.
desc.zh:
烈日和冰影手雷会扰乱战斗人员并使其眩晕，延缓其技能回复速度并降低伤害输出。

克制过载勇士。

desc.en: [Alternate Weapon Action]  : Swap fire mode.
desc.zh: [替换武器动作]：切换开火模式。

desc.en: Fully charged shots over-penetrate weaker combatants and cause a delayed Solar detonation with a brief scorching field.
desc.zh: 完全充能的射击可穿透较弱的战斗人员，并造成延迟烈日引爆，产生一个短暂的灼烧场。

desc.en: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
desc.zh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

desc.en: In addition to their normal rewards, encounters in the raids "Leviathan" and "Leviathan, Eater of Worlds" can award Bright Engrams.
desc.zh: 除一般奖励外，“利维坦”和“世界吞噬者，利维坦”突袭中的遭遇战还将奖励光明记忆水晶。

desc.en: Increases the size and damage of the burst when you shatter a Stasis crystal or frozen target, and increases the area of effect of Solar ignitions.
desc.zh: 当你击碎一个冰影水晶或被冻结的目标时，提升爆发的规模和伤害，并扩大烈日点燃的效果范围。

desc.en: Landing consecutive hits with any Submachine Gun you are wielding disrupts combatants, stunning them, delaying ability energy regeneration and lowering combatant damage output. Strong against [Disruption] Overload Champions. Additionally, Submachine Guns are always overcharged when that modifier is active.
desc.zh: 使用任意微型冲锋枪连续命中可扰乱战斗人员并使其眩晕，延缓其技能能量回复速度并降低战斗人员伤害输出。克制过载勇士。此外，该修改器生效期间微型冲锋枪将始终过充。

desc.en: Aiming down the sights of a Pulse Rifle for a short time loads a powerful explosive payload that stuns unshielded combatants. Strong against [Stagger] Unstoppable Champions. Additionally, Pulse Rifles are always overcharged when that modifier is active.
desc.zh: 脉冲步枪举枪瞄准一小段时间可装填高爆载荷，眩晕没有护盾的战斗人员。克制势不可挡勇士。此外，该修改器生效期间脉冲步枪将始终过充。

desc.en: Scout Rifles you are wielding fire shield-piercing rounds and stun [Shield-Piercing] Barrier Champions. Additionally, Scout Rifles are always overcharged when that modifier is active.
desc.zh: 你使用的斥候步枪可发射护盾穿透子弹，眩晕屏障勇士。此外，该修改器生效期间斥候步枪将始终过充。

desc.en: The armor energy costs of all armor mods affecting your melee are significantly discounted.
desc.zh: 影响近战所有护甲模组的护甲能量花费均享有大量折扣。

desc.en: The armor energy costs of all armor mods affecting your grenades are significantly discounted.
desc.zh: 影响手雷的所有护甲模组的护甲能量花费均享有大量折扣。

desc.en: Shotguns you are wielding fire shield-piercing rounds and stun [Shield-Piercing] Barrier Champions. Additionally, Shotguns are always overcharged when that modifier is active.
desc.zh: 你使用的霰弹枪可发射护盾穿透子弹，眩晕屏障勇士。此外，该修改器生效期间霰弹枪将始终过充。

desc.en: Damaging a combatant with Primary or Special ammo Grenade Launchers disrupts combatants, stunning them, delaying ability energy regeneration and lowering combatant damage output. Strong against [Disruption] Overload Champions. Additionally, Primary and Special ammo Grenade Launchers are always overcharged when that modifier is active.
desc.zh: 使用主武器或特殊弹药榴弹发射器对战斗人员造成伤害可扰乱战斗人员并使其眩晕，延缓其技能能量回复速度并降低战斗人员伤害输出。克制过载勇士。此外，该修改器生效期间主武器和特殊弹药榴弹发射器将始终过充。

n.zh: 过载后膛填装榴弹发射器

desc.zh: 使用此武器对目标造成伤害会额外提升操控性和敏捷。此特性生效时刀剑可获得更高充能速度。

desc.en: Adds a fluttering appearance to your transmat effects.
desc.zh: 为你的传送效果添加一个飞舞外观。

desc.en: Adds a bladed appearance to your transmat effects.
desc.zh: 为你的传送效果添加一个刀锋外观。

desc.zh: 对受到分支职业减益影响的目标造成最后一击有递增的几率生成能量球。

desc.en: Performing a finisher versus a powerful combatant grants Devour. While you have Devour, gain damage resistance versus combatants.
desc.zh: 对强力战斗人员施展终结技可提供吞食。拥有吞食时，获得对战斗人员的伤害抗性。

desc.en: After being out of combat for a moderate duration, this weapon gains stability, reload speed, and handling. These benefits decay over time after reentering combat.
desc.zh: 脱离战斗一定时间后，此武器的稳定性、填装速度和操控性获得提升。这些加成会在你重新进入战斗后逐渐衰减。

desc.en: Aiming this weapon for a very short period of time reduces flinch.
desc.zh: 使用此武器进行极短时间的瞄准可减少抖动。

desc.en: Your Void grenades weaken targets.
desc.zh: 你的虚空手雷会削弱目标。

desc.zh: 造成多次命中来发射制导微型导弹。

desc.zh: 提供额外射程和稳定性。造成最后一击或吸收残余会提供额外的武器射程，并在短时间内提升敏捷和操控性。

desc.en: Your grenades recharge quicker and deal more damage when you are not under the effects of Pervading Darkness.
desc.zh: 不在弥漫暗影效果下时，手雷的充能速度更快并且造成更多伤害。

desc.en: Slightly increases the three lowest stats on this armor at no cost.
desc.zh: 免费对此护甲的三个最低属性进行小幅提升。

desc.en: Casting Nova Bomb grants a free cast of a Nova Bomb: Lance.
desc.zh: 施放新星炸弹时获得一次免费施放新星炸弹：长矛的机会。

desc.en: Arc ability or Jolt final blows restore ability energy.
desc.zh: 电弧技能或震颤最后一击可恢复技能能量。

desc.en: Marks priority targets and buffs ability regen.
desc.zh: 标记首要目标，加快技能充能速度。

desc.en: Void kills increase ability regen.
desc.zh: 虚空击杀提高技能充能速度。

Picking up an Orb of Power grants you 1 additional stack of Armor Charge.
desc.zh: 拾取一个能量球会赋予1层额外的护甲充能。

desc.en: Hold down the trigger to charge up a tracking shot that explodes and burns on impact.
desc.zh: 按住扳机充能成为一次追踪射击，可在击中目标时爆炸并燃烧。

desc.en: Adds a Vex storm appearance to your transmat effects.
desc.zh: 为你的传送效果添加一个Vex风暴外观。

desc.en: Detonating a large number of rounds embedded in a single target suspends them.
desc.zh: 引爆单个目标体内大量嵌入的弹药会施加悬停。

desc.en: Each final blow with this weapon creates an improved elemental damage explosion.
desc.zh: 此武器的每次最后一击都会造成一次更强的元素伤害爆炸。

desc.en: Laser overpenetrates and refracts.
desc.zh: 激光可穿射敌人并在击中坚硬表面时折射。

desc.en: Adds a silver beam to your transmat effects.
desc.zh: 为你的传送效果添加一束银色光束。

desc.en: Powered melee combatant final blows spawn elemental wells matching your subclass energy type.
desc.zh: 充能近战造成的战斗人员最后一击会生成与你的分支职业能量类型匹配的元素井。

desc.zh: 脉冲步枪的持续射击会扰乱战斗人员并使其眩晕，延缓其技能能量回复速度并降低战斗人员伤害输出。克制过载勇士。此外，该修改器生效期间脉冲步枪将始终过充。

desc.zh: 自动步枪的持续射击会扰乱战斗人员并使其眩晕，延缓其技能能量回复速度并降低战斗人员伤害输出。克制过载勇士。此外，该修改器生效期间自动步枪将始终过充。

desc.en: Your equipped Sidearms fire shield-piercing rounds and stun [Shield-Piercing] Barrier Champions. Additionally, Sidearms are always overcharged when that modifier is active.

desc.zh: 使用此武器造成最后一击会获得额外的超能能量。你的超能结束时，此武器的弹匣容量在较长持续时间内翻倍，并从弹药储备中填装。

desc.zh: 拾取虚空裂口可让你获得一个覆盖护盾或刷新你现有的覆盖护盾。

desc.zh: 带有未足之饥、纳米技术追踪火箭、和谐回声和高尚事迹特性的武器在该修改器激活时将始终过充。

desc.en: Gain damage resistance while amplified.
desc.zh: 处于增幅时获得伤害抗性。

desc.en: Gain a stack of Armor Charge when you stun a Champion.
desc.zh: 当你眩晕一名勇士时，可获得一层护甲充能。

desc.zh: 击碎一个被冻结的目标会生成追踪弹，追踪并冻结附近的其他目标。

desc.en: Destroying a Stasis crystal or defeating a frozen target with this weapon grants you an improved amount of Frost Armor.
desc.zh: 使用此武器摧毁冰影水晶或击败被冻结的目标可获得更多的冰霜护甲。

desc.en: [Brake]  : Use while airborne to release roll stabilizers, and move [Movement] to roll.
desc.zh: [刹车]  ：在空中使用以松开翻滚稳定装置，使用[移动]进行翻滚。

desc.en: Increases this weapon's ready and stow speed.
desc.zh: 提高此武器的准备和收起速度。

desc.zh: 提高可携带的榴弹发射器弹药数量。

desc.zh: 恢复火花

desc.en: Weapons with the Head Rush, Nanotech Tracer Rockets, Unsated Hunger, and Cursed Thrall Origin Traits are always overcharged when that modifier is active.
desc.zh: 在该修改器生效时，带有热血上头、纳米技术追踪火箭、未足之饥和诅咒怨魂原始特性的武器将始终过充。

desc.en: Strand weapon final blows have a chance to generate a Tangle.
desc.zh: 缚丝武器最后一击有几率生成一个缠结。

desc.en: While using an Arc subclass, Arc weapon final blows have a chance to spawn an Arc Elemental Orb. Arc Orbs can be thrown to create an Arc explosion that jolts targets it damages.

desc.zh: 眩晕一名勇士可装填弹匣，触发生命值回复并在短时间内提高恢复效果。

desc.zh: 获得空中移动并强化瞬移。

desc.en: Improves accuracy and stability while continuously holding down the trigger.
desc.zh: 持续按住扳机可提升命中率和稳定性。

desc.zh: 提高你可以携带的火箭发射器、榴弹发射器、机枪和霰弹枪的弹药数量。

desc.zh: 装备霰弹枪后，提高你找到弹药的机会。

desc.zh: 多次同时造成最后一击会积累可叠加的伤害增益。持续时间更长的计时器在下次武器射击时开始；造成最后一击会延长此计时器。

desc.en:
Critically wounding a target or breaking their shield infuses your melee attacks with Arc energy and increases your melee range against combatants and melee damage against combatants and Guardians for a short time.

Defeating targets with melee attacks makes you amplified and restores a portion of your health. Defeating more powerful combatants increases the amount of health restored.
desc.zh:
重伤目标或打破其护盾可在短时间内给你的近战攻击赋予电弧能量，增加你对战斗人员的近战范围和对战斗人员及守护者的近战伤害。

用近战攻击打败目标会使你进入增幅状态，并恢复一部分生命值。击败强力战斗人员会恢复更多生命值。

desc.en: Aiming down sights increases body shot damage, decreases target acquisition.
desc.zh: 瞄准可提升身体射击伤害，减少目标捕获能力。

desc.en: Hitting a target with a Void ability or Volatile explosion makes them volatile. Further damage to a volatile target causes them to explode. Grants you and nearby allies health when volatile targets explode near you.
desc.zh: 使用虚空技能或不稳定爆炸击中目标会使其不稳定。对不稳定的目标造成进一步的伤害会使其爆炸。不稳定的目标在你附近爆炸时向你和附近的盟友提供生命值。

desc.en: Increases reload speed of Auto Rifles.
desc.zh: 提高自动步枪的填装速度。

desc.zh: 全自动射击。提高附近鼠王的力量。

desc.zh: 此武器的每个快速最后一击将在短时间内累积大幅增加填装速度。

desc.zh: 在电弧武器击杀时生成枪匠遥测数据。

desc.en: Increases the duration of the Land Tank Origin Trait and the effect of the Häkke Breach Armaments Origin Trait.

desc.en: Reduces incoming damage from combatants that are at long range.
desc.zh: 减少来自远距离敌人的伤害。

desc.en: Increases experience gains for your Subclass, Weapons, and Armor.
desc.zh: 提高分支职业、武器和护甲的经验值获取。

desc.en: Rapidly defeating targets with Light or Darkness damage or Super final blows generates an Elemental pickup of the matching damage type.
desc.zh: 使用光能或暗影伤害或超能最后一击快速击败目标，会生成一个匹配该伤害类型的元素拾取物。

desc.en: Grants a chance to obtain additional faction consumables in Vanguard Ops.
desc.zh: 有机会在先锋行动中获得额外的阵营消耗品。

desc.en:
Casting your Rift generates a shockwave that freezes nearby targets, granting you Frost Armor when it does so.

Freezing combatants generates class ability energy.
desc.zh:
施放裂痕会产生震荡波，冻结附近的目标，如冻结目标则为你提供冰霜护甲。

冻结战斗人员会生成职业技能能量。

desc.en: While Charged with Light, reloading or readying a Sidearm will consume all stacks of Charged with Light and convert them into stacks of a major damage buff, which are depleted as you damage combatants with that Sidearm.
desc.zh: 充斥光能时，填装或就绪手枪将消耗全部光之充能层数并将其转换为高额伤害加成，此加成将随着你使用该手枪对战斗人员造成伤害而衰减。

desc.en: Precision final blows cause nearby targets to become severed. Cooldown between activations reduced.
desc.zh: 精准最后一击会使附近目标变得割裂。减少启动冷却时间。

desc.en:
Defeating weakened targets with a [Void] Void weapon applies Volatile to nearby targets.
Powerful targets increase the radius of the explosion.
desc.zh:
使用虚空武器击败被削弱的目标会对附近目标施加不稳定。
强力目标增加爆炸半径。

desc.en: Stunning a Champion grants maximum stacks of Bolt Charge. Damaging targets with Bolt Charge bolts jolts them and heals you.
desc.zh: 眩晕勇士会提供最大层数的电光充能。用电光充能的弩弹对目标造成伤害会震颤他们并治疗你自己。

desc.en: Dealing sustained damage to severed targets unravels them. Defeating a severed target creates a hotspot of Strand energy, granting Woven Mail to nearby allies for a short duration.
desc.zh: 对被割裂的目标造成持续伤害会瓦解它们。击败被割裂的目标会生成一个缚丝能量热点，为附近的盟友在短时间内提供织造铠甲。

desc.en: Casting a Super while you are critically wounded or have a elemental buff matching your Super element grants a period of increased Super damage.
desc.zh: 重伤或拥有与超能元素相匹配的元素增益时施放超能，会在一段时间内提升超能伤害。

desc.en: Dealing sustained damage with Fusion Rifles or Linear Fusion Rifles partially refills the magazine from reserves and grants them bonus damage for a short duration against that target.
desc.zh: 用融合步枪或线性融合步枪造成持续伤害会从弹药储备中部分填充弹匣，并在短时间内对该目标造成额外伤害。

desc.en: Dealing sustained damage to targets with a Heavy Machine Gun or Rocket Launcher grants damage resistance and increases grenade and melee regeneration for a short duration. While active, defeating powerful combatants disorients nearby rank-and-file combatants.
desc.zh: 使用重型机枪或火箭发射器对目标造成持续伤害会获得伤害抗性，并在短时间内增加手雷和近战回复。生效期间击败强力战斗人员会使附近的普通战斗人员迷失方向。

desc.en:
Defeating exhausted or severed targets with weapons that match your Super element grants Super energy.

Exhausted targets deal reduced outgoing damage.
desc.zh:
使用与超能元素匹配的武器击败疲惫或割裂的目标会获得超能能量。

疲惫的目标造成的伤害会减少。

desc.en: Elemental final blows increase the damage of this weapon's next shot.
desc.zh: 元素最后一击会提升此武器的下一击伤害。

desc.en: Increases the amount of Bow ammo you can carry.
desc.zh: 提高可携带的弓箭弹药数量。

desc.en: Reloading grants this weapon improved bonus handling and reduces incoming flinch for a short time.
desc.zh: 填装可在短时间内为此武器提供更高的操控性并减少受到伤害时的抖动。

desc.en: Faster ready and stow speed for Bows.
desc.zh: 提高弓箭的收举速度。

desc.en: [Light Attack]  : Landing three light-attack hits within an improved short time grants Sword ammo.
desc.zh: [轻攻击]  ：短时间内进行三次轻攻击可提供刀剑的弹药，持续时间延长。

desc.en: Equip multiple pieces from this set to unlock Gambit Prime set perks.
desc.zh: 装备多件此套装中的护甲以解锁全盛智谋套装特性。

desc.zh: 装备多件此套装中的护甲以解锁全盛智谋套装特性。

desc.en: Improved target acquisition, accuracy, and aim-down-sights speed for Kinetic weapons.
desc.zh: 改善动能武器的目标捕获能力、精度和瞄准速度。

desc.en: Collecting a Void Breach causes final blows to provide a Void Overshield.
desc.zh: 收集虚空裂口会使最后一击提供虚空覆盖护盾。

desc.en: Guarding while receiving damage generates class ability energy at an improved rate.
desc.zh: 在受到伤害时进行防御可生成职业技能能量，生成速度提高。

desc.en: The Vex were responding to a strange signal coming from Nexus…
desc.zh: Vex在对一个来自枢纽的奇怪信号作出回应……

desc.en: Increases the nocking speed of arrows.
desc.zh: 提高弓箭的搭弦速度。

desc.en: Playing Ops activities in a fireteam increases your damage; playing with a clanmate further increases the effect.
desc.zh: 火力战队玩行动活动可以增加你的伤害；与公会成员一起可以进一步提升此效果。

desc.en: While Charged with Light, gain a bonus to weapon damage. Each defeated combatant consumes one stack of Charged with Light.
desc.zh: 当充斥光能的时候，获得额外武器伤害。每个被击败的战斗人员消耗一层光之充能。

desc.en: Become Charged with Light by finishing a combatant, consuming one-tenth of your Super energy.
desc.zh: 消耗十分之一的超能能量，终结敌方战斗人员来变得充斥光能。

desc.en: Become Charged with Light by breaking a combatant shield with the matching energy type.
desc.zh: 通过以对应属性击破战斗人员的护盾来变得充斥光能。

desc.en: Become Charged with Light by picking up Orbs of Power.
desc.zh: 拾取能量球以变得充斥光能。

desc.en:
Activate Thruster to create an unstable knot of [Strand] Strand matter that detonates after a short delay, suspending and damaging targets.

Final blows on targets affected by elemental debuffs grant Thruster energy.
desc.zh:
启动推进器来生成一个不稳定的缚丝物质绳结，可在短暂延迟后引爆，悬停目标并对其造成伤害。

对受到元素减益影响的目标造成最后一击会提供悬停能量。

desc.en: Rapid or precision final blows release a larger Kinetic shockwave that exhausts targets.
desc.zh: 快速或精准最后一击会释放范围更大的动能冲击波，使目标疲惫。

desc.en: Powered Sword hits slow targets.
desc.zh: 充能刀剑命中可让目标减速。

desc.en:
This weapon collects less ammo. Final blows with this weapon accelerate Light and Darkness mastery.
Deals increased damage while Transcendent; defeating targets lengthens Transcendence.
desc.zh:
此武器收集的弹药较少。使用此武器造成最后一击可加速光能与暗影的掌控。
超凡状态下造成的伤害增加；击败目标可延长超凡状态。

desc.en: This vehicle gains increased agility while airborne.
desc.zh: 使载具在空中时灵活性增强。

desc.en: Adds a gift pile appearance to your transmat effects.
desc.zh: 为你的传送效果添加一个礼物堆外观。

desc.en: Absorbing Remnants allows you to fire ally-seeking Noble Rounds.
desc.zh: 吸收遗灵允许你发射寻找盟友的高尚弹药。

desc.en: [Heavy Attack]  : Fire a projectile.
desc.zh: [重攻击]  ：发射一枚射弹。

desc.en: Adds a ribbon of spectral energy to your transmat effects.
desc.zh: 为你的传送效果添加一个鬼灵能量色带。

desc.en: Adds a nest of spiders to your transmat effects.
desc.zh: 为你的传送特效添加一个蛛网效果。

desc.en: High power explosive bolts.
desc.zh: 高威力爆炸光弹。

desc.en:
Transmutation spheres you create can be picked up and wielded as weapons by you or your allies.
• [Light Attack]  : Light attack
• [Heavy Attack]  : Suppressing heavy attack
• [Block]  : Guard/drain nearby targets
desc.zh:
你制造的蜕变圆球可以被你和你的盟友拾取并作为武器使用。
• [轻攻击]  ：轻攻击
• [重攻击]  ：压制重攻击
• [格挡]  ：防御/吸取附近的目标

desc.en: Massively improves weapon stability at the cost of a reduced amount of reload speed.
desc.zh: 以牺牲较少量填装速度为代价，大幅提升武器的稳定性。

desc.en:
Defeat a target with a Void ability to activate Devour.

Your Devour effects are improved, restoring additional health and grenade energy.
desc.zh:
使用虚空技能击败目标来启动吞食。

你的吞食效果获得改善，恢复额外生命值和手雷能量。

desc.en: Fires a long-range precision energy bolt.
desc.zh: 发射精准的远程能量光束。

desc.zh: -5 武器 ▼

Weapon adapts to targets. When dealing damage:

• To weak targets: shots create an improved explosion
• To strong targets: targets become exhausted
• To Guardians: the weapon's flinch resistance increases for an improved duration

Exhausted targets deal reduced outgoing damage.
desc.zh:
武器可自适应目标。造成伤害时：

• 较弱目标：子弹产生强化爆炸
• 较强目标：使目标变得疲惫
• 守护者：武器的抖动抗性在更长时间内提升

疲惫的目标造成的伤害会减少。

desc.en: Adds a Crucible crest to your transmat effects.
desc.zh: 为你的传送效果添加一个熔炉纹章。

desc.en: Collecting a Warmind Cell grants you melee energy.
desc.zh: 收集战争思维电池会为你提供近战能量。

desc.en: Collecting a Warmind Cell creates a burst of chaining Arc energy around you.
desc.zh: 收集战争思维电池会在你周围制造一股连锁电弧能量。

desc.en: Collecting or destroying a Warmind Cell creates a concussive blast that pushes enemies away.
desc.zh: 收集或摧毁一个战争思维电池会制造一场击退敌人的震荡冲击波。

desc.en: Collecting a Warmind Cell grants you an overshield.
desc.zh: 收集战争思维电池会为你提供覆盖护盾。

desc.en: Sustained weapon damage or final blows versus powerful targets grant this weapon bonus reload, handling, and damage versus combatants. Gain this bonus immediately for a longer duration when you are revived.
desc.zh: 对强力目标造成持续武器伤害或最后一击会为此武器提供额外的填装、操控性以及对战斗人员的伤害。当你被复活时，立即获得此增益，且持续时间更长。

desc.en:
Bosses have a chance to drop an Upgrade Module when defeated.

Effect lasts until an Upgrade Module is found. Only one Concentrated Mattergem can be active at a time.
desc.zh:
击败首领有几率掉落一个升级模块。

效果持续至一个升级模块掉落。浓缩物质精粹一次只能激活一个。

desc.en: Grants slightly increased ammo generation and magazine size.
desc.zh: 小幅提升弹药生成速度和弹匣容量。

desc.en: Gain an additional melee charge.
desc.zh: 获得额外一次近战攻击。

desc.zh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

desc.zh: 提高微型冲锋枪的收举速度。

desc.en: Extended and more frequent Chaos Reach .
desc.zh: 延长和增加混沌之触的频率。

desc.en: A member of your fireteam has a high Nightfall score in this strike, which grants increased Vanguard token drops for the entire fireteam.
desc.zh: 你所在火力战队中的一名成员在此次打击中获得了非常高的日落分数，使全部火力战队成员的先锋代币掉落几率增加。

desc.en: Armor Set—Invader +3
desc.zh: 护甲套装——入侵者+3

desc.en:
Supercharge your fists and slam the ground with the force of a maelstrom. While active:

[Light Attack]  : Quickly dash forward, dealing damage to any impacted targets.

[Heavy Attack]  : Slam your fists to the ground, blinding targets and dealing damage in an area around you, leaving aftershocks in your wake. Performing a slam from the air or after a dash deals additional damage.
desc.zh:
对双拳进行超级充能，使用漩涡之力猛击地面。激活时：

[轻攻击]  ：快速向前冲刺，对任何被撞到的目标造成伤害。

[重攻击]  ：用双拳猛砸地面，致盲目标，对你周围造成伤害并产生余震。从空中砸向地面或冲刺后可造成额外伤害。

desc.en: Hurtle through the air like a missile and crash into targets to inflict meteoric damage.
desc.zh: 像导弹一样飞速穿过空中并撞进目标群中，造成流星伤害。

desc.en: Greatly reduces flinching from incoming fire while aiming Bows.
desc.zh: 大幅降低弓瞄时因受到伤害而产生的画面颤动。

desc.en: Adds a blue Crucible crest to your transmat effects.
desc.zh: 为你的传送效果添加一个蓝色熔炉纹章。

desc.en: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
desc.zh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

desc.en: Revives grant overshields.
desc.zh: 复活会生成覆盖护盾。

desc.en: Damaging an enemy with this weapon has a small chance to reload the magazine and increase movement speed while aiming down sights. Bows receive faster draw speed and swords receive faster charge rate while this perk is active.
desc.zh: 使用此武器对敌人造成伤害有较小几率填装弹匣并提高瞄准时的移速。此特性生效时弓箭可获得更快的拉弓速度，而刀剑可获得更快的充能速度。

desc.en: Final blows with this weapon reduce its projectile spread for a short duration.
desc.zh: 使用此武器造成最后一击会在短时间内降低其弹道分布。

desc.en: Body shots landed with this weapon increase precision damage and aim assist for a short time. Body shots landed while the perk is active refresh the time.
desc.zh: 使用此武器命中身体部位可在短时间内提高精准伤害和瞄准辅助。特性激活时命中身体射击可刷新时长。

desc.en: Rapid final blows with non-Exotic Rocket Launchers refund ammo and increase reload speed for a short duration.
desc.zh: 使用非异域火箭发射器造成快速最后一击，会返还弹药并在短时间内提升填装速度。

desc.zh: 使用动能武器或与已装备超能匹配的武器造成快速最后一击，可生成一个与已装备超能匹配的元素拾取物。收集元素拾取物时会获得匹配的超能能量。

Defeating an exhausted or severed target with [Arc]Arc damage releases a blinding burst.

Exhausted targets deal reduced outgoing damage.

使用电弧伤害击败疲惫或割裂的目标会释放致盲爆发。

疲惫的目标造成的伤害会减少。

desc.en:
Improves the effects of Exhaust and Sever, lowering a target's damage output even further.

提升疲惫和割裂的效果，进一步降低目标的伤害输出。

疲惫的目标造成的伤害会减少。

Defeating powerful Taken loads your weapon with Taken energy. The next time you fire, launch 3 Taken seeker rounds that [Disruption] disrupt and exhaust targets.

Exhausted targets deal reduced outgoing damage.

击败强力傀儡军团会为你的武器注入傀儡能量。下次开火时，发射3发可对目标施加扰乱和疲惫的傀儡追踪弹。

疲惫的目标造成的伤害会减少。

desc.en:
Defeating [Arc]Arc debuffed targets grants Bolt Charge.

Rapidly defeating Arc debuffed targets spawns an Orb of Power and heals a small portion of health.
desc.zh:
击败受到电弧减益的目标可获得电光充能。

快速击败受到电弧减益的目标会生成一个能量球并治疗一小部分生命值。

desc.en: While surrounded, Machine Guns and Glaives gain increased reload speed and stability; final blows heal you.
desc.zh: 被包围时，机枪和偃月获得更高的填装速度和稳定性；最后一击会治疗你。

desc.en: Adds a Lucent Hive Shrieker to your transmat effects.
desc.zh: 为你的传送效果添加一个光明邪魔族死灵。

desc.en: Kills with this weapon generate ability energy. This energy is divided between your uncharged abilities.
desc.zh: 使用此武器造成击杀会产生技能能量。此能量会平分至你未充能完毕的技能。

desc.en: Precision final blows or rapidly defeating targets with this weapon spawns a Threadling at the target's location. There's a chance to spawn an increased amount of Threadlings.
desc.zh: 精准最后一击或使用此武器快速击败目标，会在目标的位置生成一个线虫。有几率生成更多线虫。

desc.en: +10 Blast Radius
desc.zh: +10爆炸范围

desc.en: A member of your fireteam has used a Fireteam Medallion, granting all members of the fireteam increased XP gains and loot from strike completion.
desc.zh: 火力战队的一名成员使用了火力战队大勋章，将增加小组所有成员在打击中获得的经验值和战利品。

desc.en: Reloading this weapon after dealing damage grants the weapon a stacking reload speed and handling bonus until stowed.
desc.zh: 造成伤害后填装此武器，可为其叠加填装速度并提供操控性加成，直到收起武器。

desc.en: Celebrate your achievements with style and alacrity!
desc.zh: 时尚而轻快地庆祝你的成就吧！

desc.en:
Fashion Solar Light into blades and smite your foes from the sky.

Your Daybreak projectiles scorch targets on impact.
desc.zh:
将烈日之光化作利刃，从空中轰击敌人。

你的黎明射弹在命中时会灼烧目标。

desc.en: Thrust your Sword into the ground, damaging and scorching nearby targets. The sword projects a continuous aura, granting radiant effects and restoration to nearby allies, protecting them from the effects of Stasis.
desc.zh: 将你的刀剑刺入地面，对附近目标造成伤害和灼烧效果。刀剑会发出持续的光环，为附近盟友提供焕光和恢复效果，使其免受冰影效果的影响。

desc.en:
Unleash your inner fire, making your equipped weapons radiant and enhancing your abilities.

[Melee]  : Release a supercharged melee attack that launches additional projectiles.

[Grenade]  : Create a sentient flame wisp that seeks out targets and detonates in a scorching explosion, then seeks out other nearby targets.

While Song of Flame is active, you and nearby allies regenerate abilities more quickly, are more resistant to incoming damage, and your [Solar] Solar and Kinetic weapons scorch targets.
desc.zh:
释放你的内心炽焰，让你装备的武器进入焕光状态并强化你的技能。

[近战]  ：释放一记发射额外射弹的超级充能近战攻击。

[手雷]  ：创造一股灵性的烈焰火苗，自动追踪目标并造成一次灼烧爆炸，然后追踪附近的其他目标。

在烈焰之歌生效时，你和附近的盟友技能回复更快，且对伤害的抗性增加。你的烈日和动能武器会灼烧目标。

desc.en: Draw time decreases after every precision hit.
desc.zh: 每次精准射击命中后蓄力时间缩短。

desc.en:
Summon a [Stasis] Stasis gauntlet. While your Super is active:

[Heavy Attack]  : Slam your gauntlet down to create a shockwave that freezes targets and sends out [Stasis] Stasis crystals to freeze additional ones.

[Light Attack]  : Supercharge your Shiver Strike for bonus damage. Sprint through [Stasis] Stasis crystals or frozen targets to shatter them instantly.
desc.zh:
召唤一个冰影臂铠。当超能激活时：

[重攻击] ：用臂铠猛击地面，制造一次震荡波，冻结目标并射出冰影水晶来冻结其他敌人。

[轻攻击] ：对你的战栗打击进行超级充能以获得伤害加成。冲刺穿过冰影水晶或被冻结的目标会立即将其粉碎。

desc.en: Grants a chance to receive additional Etheric and Baryon resources when collecting them in the Reef.
desc.zh: 当在暗礁中收集乙太和重子资源时，有机会获得更多。

desc.en:
Class abilities recharge faster when using an Arc subclass.
  •  Stacks up to 3 times
desc.zh:
使用电弧分支职业时职业技能的充能速度提高。
  •  最高可叠加3次

desc.en: Auto Rifles get bonus reserves when you pick up ammo.
desc.zh: 拾取弹药时自动步枪获得额外弹药储量。

desc.en: Create combination Healing/Empowering Rifts.
desc.zh: 创造出治愈/强能裂痕的组合。

desc.en: Sustained kinetic damage to a target emits a shockwave that damages any nearby targets.
desc.zh: 对目标造成持续的动能伤害会发射出一道冲击波，对任何附近的目标造成伤害。

desc.en: While holding down the trigger, every fourth bullet becomes a heavy projectile that makes targets volatile on impact.
desc.zh: 按住扳机时，每四发子弹中有一发会变成重型射弹，命中时对目标施加不稳定效果。

desc.en: Weapons with the Dealer's Choice, Radiolaria Transposer, Collective Purpose, and Sundering Origin traits are always Overcharged weapons for you when that modifier is active.
desc.zh: 带有庄家之选、活性放射体液转换器、集体使命和分离原始特性的武器在该修改器生效时将始终过充。

desc.en: The energy cost of Elemental Charge mods are significantly discounted.
desc.zh: 元素充能模组的能量花费大幅减少。

desc.zh: 带有活性放射体液转换器原始特性的武器会对Vex造成更高伤害。延长由活性放射体液转换器生成的活性放射体液池的持续时间。

desc.en: The energy cost of Scavenger mods are significantly discounted.
desc.zh: 回收器模组的能量花费大幅减少。

desc.en: The energy cost of the Charged Up mod is significantly discounted.
desc.zh: 完全充能模组的能量花费大幅减少。

desc.zh: 由光照无影原始特性填装的弹药会溢出弹匣。

While using weapons with the Dealer's Choice origin trait, combatant precision final blows or rapidly defeating combatants cause the target to explode, dealing Solar damage to nearby combatants.

Having several equipped weapons with the Dealer's Choice origin trait increases the effect of the explosion.
desc.zh:
在使用带有庄家之选原始特性的武器时，战斗人员精准最后一击或快速击败战斗人员会让目标爆炸，对附近战斗人员造成烈日伤害。

装备多件带有庄家之选原始特性的武器可提升爆炸效果。

desc.en: Final blows with this weapon increase accuracy and stability while improving vertical recoil.
desc.zh: 使用此武器完成最后一击可提高精度和稳定性，同时改善垂直后坐力。

desc.en: Greatly increases the charge rate for your equipped Swords.
desc.zh: 大幅提升你装备的刀剑的充能速度。

desc.en:
Sustained damage from this weapon exhausts the target for an improved duration.

Exhausted targets deal reduced outgoing damage.
desc.zh:
此武器的持续伤害会在更长时间内使目标疲惫。

疲惫的目标造成的伤害会减少。

desc.en: Acquired armor pieces with randomized stats are more likely to drop with the Demolitionist archetype, which has Grenade as its primary stat and Class as its secondary.
desc.zh: 获取的随机属性护甲更有可能掉落爆破专家框架：手雷为主要属性，职业为次要属性。

desc.en: Rapid weapon final blows with damage matching your subclass type create an Orb of Power.
desc.zh: 使用伤害匹配你的分支职业类型的武器达成快速最后一击可生成能量球。

desc.en: This weapon creates SIVA nanite swarms on rapid hits and precision kills.
desc.zh: 武器会在快速命中和精准击杀时产生湿婆纳米蜂群。

desc.zh: 精准击杀可产生元素伤害爆炸。

desc.en: Reduces flinching from incoming fire while aiming Sidearms, Hand Cannons, Bows, and Submachine Guns.

desc.zh: 用弹片造成最后一击可获得可叠加的精准伤害和填装速度加成。用弹丸造成精准命中可延长持续时间。

desc.en: Increases the Grenade stat.
desc.zh: 提升手雷属性。

desc.zh: +5 超能 ▲

Pulse Rifles you are wielding fire shield-piercing rounds and stun [Shield-Piercing] Barrier Champions.

Pulse Rifles deal bonus damage against [Shield-Piercing] Barrier Champions.

你使用的脉冲步枪可发射屏障穿刺子弹，眩晕屏障勇士。

脉冲步枪对屏障勇士造成额外伤害。

desc.zh: 十字弓和弓箭完全开弓一小段时间后会发射一枚高爆载荷，可眩晕没有护盾的战斗人员。克制势不可挡勇士。

desc.en: Improves the effects of disruption, lowering combatants' damage output even further.
desc.zh: 提高 混乱 的效果，进一步降低敌方战斗人员的伤害输出。

desc.en: Sustained fire increases accuracy and range. Increases lunge distance for Swords, and projectile velocity for Launchers.

desc.zh: 大幅减少此武器受到的抖动。

When you revive an ally, you and other nearby allies gain restoration.

当你复活盟友时，你和其他附近盟友将获得恢复效果。

拾取焰灵可赋予恢复效果。

desc.zh: 一发弹药的几乎所有弹片均命中同一目标可在短时间内提高近战伤害。

When you use a finisher, you gain a portion of energy for your least-recharged ability.

在你打出终结技时，当前能量值最低的技能会获得一部分能量。

消耗2层护甲充能。

Constructs include barricades, turrets, Stasis crystals, and other objects created in the field.

此武器会对载具和构造体造成额外伤害。

构造体包括屏障、炮台、冰影水晶以及其他在战场上生成的物体。

desc.zh:
提高烈日近战技能充能速度。

desc.en: Grants a short period of increased stability and accuracy on initial trigger pull.
desc.zh: 初次扣动扳机时可在短时间内提高稳定性和精度。

desc.en: Weapon enrages faster while amplified. Final blows with this weapon make you amplified.
desc.zh: 武器在增幅状态下发怒更快。用此武器造成最后一击可获得增幅。

desc.zh: 使用此武器摧毁冰影水晶或击败被冻结的目标可获得冰霜护甲。

desc.en: Being in combat for a moderate time increases airborne effectiveness and reduces flinch until you are out of combat.

ASPECT OF INTERFERENCE

desc.zh:
干扰之星相
在完成凌光之刻战役后，从木卫二上的Exo陌客处购买此冰影星相。

desc.zh: 护甲充能会为你投掷出的缠结或元素能量球提供额外伤害。你的护甲充能现在会逐渐衰减。

desc.zh: 造成元素技能伤害会提升相匹配武器的伤害，元素武器伤害会提升相匹配技能的伤害。伤害加成为10%，持续5秒。

desc.en: Rapid precision hits made from long range weaken the target.
desc.zh: 长距离快速精准命中会削弱目标。

desc.zh: 分支职业元素增益可提供对相匹配元素类型战斗人员攻击的额外恢复和伤害抗性。

desc.en: Picking up a Solar elemental well grants increased regeneration for a short period of time.
desc.zh: 拾取烈日元素井可在短期内提高恢复速度。

Defeating Fallen Captains grants destination materials.

Mod does not stack.

消灭 堕落者队长 可获得目的地材料。

模组无法叠加。

desc.zh: 用此武器造成最后一击，将有几率在目标位置产生实验性子弹药。减少启动冷却时间。

desc.zh: 快速最后一击会在目标附近生成一块冰影水晶。

desc.zh: 此武器的动能弹药更容易令战斗人员眩晕，对更大范围内的低生命值目标的目标捕获能力和伤害更高。

desc.zh: 摧毁傀儡护盾可重新充满手雷技能。

desc.zh: 装备融合步枪后，提高你找到弹药的机会。

desc.en:
While you're on the Leviathan, activating an Arc Super recharges your grenade.

This mod's abilities cannot stack across multiple copies.
desc.zh:
在利维坦上时，激活电弧超能可充能手雷。

这个模组的能力无法重复叠加。

desc.zh: 在多个战斗人员或梦魇附近完成最后一击可恢复更多生命值。

desc.zh: 你的急冻手雷有一发额外充能且命中时充能更快。追踪弹移动得更远。

Powerful, heavy swings.

强力挥击。

desc.zh: 眩晕一名勇士或对强力战斗人员连续精准命中会标记他们。你的盟友会对被标记的敌人造成更多伤害。战斗人员首次被标记时，其附近未装备力量学派角色的永劫邪教盟友会获得手雷和近战能量。

desc.zh: 使用武器快速精准命中会暂时提高你的填装速度和武器切换速度。

desc.zh: 完成鬼灵利刃击杀后消失可获得更多超能能量。
