desc.en: Increased mobility when you're in a fireteam with clanmates.
desc.zh: 当你与公会队友同处一个火力战队时，敏捷度提高。

desc.en: Completing a clan vendor challenge awards an additional 5 Legendary shards.
desc.zh: 完成公会商人挑战将奖励额外5个传说碎片。

desc.en: Land hits with the Slug Launcher to load micro-missiles[Alternate Weapon Action]  and then fire to launch several micro-missiles in a volley.
desc.zh: 使用重弹发射器命中目标可装载微型导弹[替换武器动作] ，然后射击即可一次性发射几枚微型导弹。

desc.en: Damaging nearby combatants with melee abilities dramatically increases handling and damage. Expires after an improved short duration or the next shot.
desc.zh: 使用近战技能对附近战斗人员造成伤害可大幅提高操控性和伤害。持续短暂时间后或下次射击后过期，持续时间延长。

desc.en: Improved Primary weapon performance; final blows refund dodges.
desc.zh: 改良主武器性能；最后一击返还闪身。

desc.en: Precision hits load a scorching explosive round.
desc.zh: 精准命中将填装一枚有灼烧效果的高爆弹药。

desc.en: +10 Reload
desc.zh: +10 填装

desc.en: Hitting three different targets generates a large amount of blight. Blighted Seekers bore through targets.
desc.zh: 击中三个不同目标会生成大量凋零阴影。凋零追踪弹可穿透目标。

desc.en: Massively improves weapon range at the cost of a reduced amount of weapon stability.
desc.zh: 以牺牲较少武器稳定性为代价，大幅提升武器的射程。

desc.en: Taking damage increases the reload speed of your equipped weapon until it is stowed. Taking more damage increases the effect.
desc.zh: 受到伤害会提升你已装备武器的填装速度，直到收起该武器。受到更多伤害可提升此效果。

desc.en: When you stow a weapon, restore health based on the number of Built Bitter stacks lost.
desc.zh: 当你收起武器时，根据失去的苦涩锻造层数恢复生命值。

desc.en: [Alternate Weapon Action]  : When weapon is fully charged, consume charge before firing to make your next shot deploy a protective shield on impact. Passing through the protective shield provides a Void Overshield and improves weapon damage, reload speed, and handling.
desc.zh: [替换武器动作]  ：武器完全充能时，开火前消耗充能使你的下一次射击在命中后部署一个防御护盾。穿过它会提供一个虚空覆盖护盾，提升武器伤害、填装速度和操控性。

desc.en: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
desc.zh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

desc.en: Combatant weapon final blows with a damage type that matches your subclass element have an escalating chance to spawn an elemental well.
desc.zh: 用符合你的分支职业元素类型的伤害类型取得战斗人员武器最后一击有更高几率生成元素井。

desc.en: Rapidly healing allies grants the intrinsic elemental benefit to you.
desc.zh: 快速治疗盟友可为你提供固有特性元素增益。

desc.en: Defeating targets grants stacks of Gun and Run for a longer duration. Sprinting for a short time consumes a stack to partially reload this weapon's magazine from reserves; on Bows, this improves draw speed for longer.
desc.zh: 击败目标可在更长时间内获得边打边跑层数。短暂冲刺消耗一层效果并从储备弹药中部分填装此武器的弹匣。如为弓箭，则在更长时间内提升拉弓速度。

desc.en: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
desc.zh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

desc.en: Increases handling, reload speed, and stability for each fully charged ability.
desc.zh: 每个完全充能的技能都会提升操控性、填装速度和稳定性。

desc.en: Activate while midair to dodge twice.
desc.zh: 可在空中激活进行 两次闪避 。

desc.en:
Bolts deal increased damage, but are slower and more affected by gravity.
[###DestinyNamedSubstitutions.ui_player_action_interact_button###][###DestinyNamedSubstitutions.ui_player_action_interact_verb###] with the bolt to retrieve it.
desc.zh:
弩弹造成更高伤害，但速度变慢且更易受重力影响。
[###DestinyNamedSubstitutions.ui_player_action_interact_button###][###DestinyNamedSubstitutions.ui_player_action_interact_verb###]弩弹进行回收。

desc.en:
Defeat targets to charge up an improvised Solar explosive.

[Grenade]  : Throw a Solar explosive that can be shot in mid-air to cause an ignition.
desc.zh:
击败目标可充能临时烈日爆炸。

[手雷]  ：投掷出可在半空被击中，造成点燃的烈日爆炸。

desc.en: This vehicle reloads weapons while you ride.
desc.zh: 在骑乘载具时填装武器。

desc.en: Using your class ability grants a Barricade grenade.
desc.zh: 使用你的职业技能可获得一枚屏障手雷。

desc.en: Applies an orange crown aura.
desc.zh: 增加一个橙色头冠光环。

desc.en: Gain 10% more XP while on Nessus.
desc.zh: 在涅索斯上获取10%的额外经验值。

desc.en: Rapid Strand weapon final blows create Orbs of Power.
desc.zh: 快速缚丝武器最后一击可生成能量球。

desc.en: Vanguard playlist strikes and Nightfall completions have a chance to award an Upgrade Module.
desc.zh: 完成先锋游戏列表打击和日落有几率奖励一个升级模块。

desc.en: Combusts combatants with explosive slugs. Strong against  [Stagger] Unstoppable Champions.
desc.zh: 用爆炸弹头点燃战斗人员。克制势不可挡勇士。

desc.en: After being out of combat for a moderate duration, this weapon gains a greater amount of stability, reload speed, and handling. These benefits decay over time after reentering combat.
desc.zh: 脱离战斗一定时间后，此武器的稳定性、填装速度和操控性获得更多提升。这些加成会在你重新进入战斗后逐渐衰减。

desc.en: Each final blow increases charge/draw speed.
desc.zh: 每次最后一击都能提高充能/拉弓速度。

desc.en: Improved recovery.
desc.zh: 更强的恢复力。

desc.en: -10 Health ▼
desc.zh: -10 生命值 ▼

desc.en: Suspend, unravel, and sever effects applied to targets, and radiant and restoration effects applied to you have increased duration.
desc.zh: 对目标施加的悬停、瓦解和割裂效果，以及对自身施加的焕光和恢复效果拥有更长的持续时间。

desc.en: Picking up an ammo brick gives you a stacking bonus to weapon swap and stow speeds until you die.
desc.zh: 拾取弹药盒会提供可叠加的武器切换和收起速度加成，直到你死亡。

desc.en: Well-rounded, reliable, and sturdy.
desc.zh: 全面，可靠，耐用。

desc.en: Grants radar while aiming down sights. Bonus damage after kill-reload.
desc.zh: 瞄准时启动雷达。击杀后填装提供额外伤害。

desc.en: Spark of Discipline
desc.zh: 纪律火花

desc.en: Your third match win grants a bonus win.
desc.zh: 取得的第三场比赛胜利会奖励一个额外胜场。

desc.en: This visual effect is suppressed while in combat.
desc.zh: 此视觉效果在战斗中会被抑制。

desc.en:
Arc weapon final blows have a chance to create an Ionic Trace.

Collecting an Ionic Trace grants you a stack of Bolt Charge.
desc.zh:
电弧武器最后一击有几率生成一个离子轨迹。

收集一个离子轨迹会为你提供一层电光充能。

desc.en:
While you're on the Leviathan, your Void abilities deal 25% more damage.

This mod's abilities cannot stack across multiple copies.
desc.zh:
在利维坦上时，你的虚空技能可造成25%额外伤害。

这个模组的能力无法重复叠加。

desc.en: Rockets attach on impact and detonate after a delay. Substantially increases blast radius and increases damage.
desc.zh: 火箭会在碰撞时粘附，延迟一定时间后引爆。爆炸范围大幅扩大且伤害提高。

desc.en: Dealing damage with Threadlings increases Threadling damage. At maximum stacks, Threadlings stun [Stagger] Unstoppable Champions.
desc.zh: 使用线虫造成伤害可提升线虫伤害。叠满层数时，线虫可眩晕势不可挡勇士。

desc.en: If you have fewer than 2 stacks of Armor Charge, rapid precision shots with Bows, Snipers, and Scout Rifles generate an Armor Charge.
desc.zh: 如果你拥有的护甲充能少于2层，使用弓箭、狙击步枪和斥候步枪快速精准命中会生成一层护甲充能。

desc.en: Rapid non-Sidearm final blows grant Sidearms a period of increased damage for a short time upon next draw.
desc.zh: 使用非手枪武器快速造成最后一击会使手枪下次拔出时获得短时间的伤害提升。

desc.en: Picking up an Elemental pickup matching your subclass element or picking up a Tangle while you have a [Strand]Strand Super equipped grants energy to your least charged ability.
desc.zh: 装备缚丝超能时，拾取与你分支职业元素相匹配的元素拾取物或拾取缠结会为你充能最少的技能提供能量。

desc.en: Granting allies an elemental buff gives class ability energy.
desc.zh: 为盟友提供元素增益会获得职业技能能量。

desc.en: While you have Frost Armor, taking critical damage releases a burst that freezes nearby combatants and grants Frost Armor to you and nearby allies.
desc.zh: 拥有冰霜护甲时，受到暴击伤害会释放爆发冻结附近的战斗人员，并为你和附近的盟友提供冰霜护甲。

desc.en: Rapid precision hits with [Solar]Solar weapons grant Radiant. Rapid precision hits with [Stasis]Stasis weapons grant Frost Armor.
desc.zh: 使用烈日武器快速精准命中目标可获得焕光。使用冰影武器快速精准命中目标可获得冰霜护甲。

desc.en: Increase Glimmer gains by 10% on Io.
desc.zh: 在木卫一的微光获取量提升10%。

desc.en: +10 Stability
desc.zh: +10稳定性

desc.en: Gain damage resistance while part of a tether chain. Multiple copies of this mod stack to increase this benefit.
desc.zh: 被吸附时获得伤害抗性。此模组可叠加以增强效果。

desc.en: Swords get bonus reserves when picking up Heavy ammo.
desc.zh: 拾取重型弹药时，刀剑获得额外储存弹药。

desc.en: Destroying a Warmind Cell creates a burst of Solar energy that causes enemies to burn for several seconds.
desc.zh: 摧毁战争思维电池会引爆一股烈日能量，点燃敌人数秒。

desc.en: Solar splash damage final blows have a chance to create Warmind Cells.
desc.zh: 烈日溅射伤害最后一击有一定几率生成战争思维电池。

desc.en: Destroying a Warmind Cell creates a burst of healing for you and allies near you.
desc.zh: 摧毁战争思维电池会在你和附近的盟友身上制造一股治疗波。

desc.en: Adds additional Solar damage to the explosions of Warmind Cells you destroy.
desc.zh: 为你摧毁的战争思维电池的爆炸效果增加额外的烈日伤害。

desc.en: Become Charged with Light by rapidly defeating multiple enemies with the explosion of a Warmind Cell.
desc.zh: 使用战争思维电池的爆炸快速击杀多名敌人以变得充斥光能 。

desc.en: Fires a three-round burst.
desc.zh: 可进行三发连射。

desc.en: Charges and deploys a guidance system.
desc.zh: 充能并部署制导系统。

desc.en: Gain 10% more XP while on the moon Titan.
desc.zh: 在土卫六获取10%的额外经验值。

desc.en: This visual effect is suppressed while in combat.
desc.zh: 此视觉效果在战斗中会被抑制。

desc.en: Increased ammo generation. When airborne, accuracy and reload speed are increased but target acquisition is decreased.
desc.zh: 增加弹药生成。在空中时，精度与填装速度提升，但目标捕获能力降低。

desc.en: Sliding partially reloads this weapon's magazine and temporarily boosts range and stability greatly.
desc.zh: 滑行可填装武器的一部分弹匣，并暂时性地大幅提高武器射程和稳定性。

desc.en: Generate Gunsmith telemetry data on Solar weapon kills.
desc.zh: 在烈日武器击杀时生成枪匠遥测数据。

desc.en: Buffs slide and jumping.
desc.zh: 加强滑行和跳跃的能力。

desc.en: Hand Cannons ready faster and gain increased accuracy and bonus damage.
desc.zh: 使手炮举枪速度更快，并获得额外精准度和伤害。

desc.en: Grants Deadfall and Moebius Quiver energy.
desc.zh: 提供狩猎陷阱和莫比乌斯箭袋能量。

desc.en: Adds a Solstice appearance to your transmat effects.
desc.zh: 为你的传送效果添加一个至日英雄外观。

desc.en: After defeating a target with a melee attack, final blows with this weapon cause targets to explode for an improved duration.
desc.zh: 使用近战攻击击败目标后，在更长时间内使用此武器造成最后一击可使目标爆炸。

desc.en:
Increases damage while lowering rate of fire.
  •  Decreases magazine size
desc.zh:
低射速时造成伤害会增加。
  •  缩小弹匣容量

desc.en: Chance to obtain additional faction consumables on the moon Titan.
desc.zh: 有机会在土卫六上获得额外的阵营消耗品。

desc.en: Reduces incoming Arc damage from combatants.
desc.zh: 减少来自战斗人员的电弧伤害。

desc.en: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
desc.zh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

desc.en: Fires insectoid robot grenades.
desc.zh: 发射类虫机器人榴弹。

desc.en: While at low heat, this weapon has slightly more improved range, handling, and accuracy.
desc.zh: 在低热量状态下，此武器的射程、操控性与精度提升得略微更高。

desc.en: Upon taking damage from a target, quickly guard or aim down sights with this weapon to gain bonus damage, handling, and charge rate for a short time.
desc.zh: 受到来自目标的伤害后，使用此武器快速防卫或瞄准目标，可在短时间内获得额外伤害、操控性和充能速度。

desc.en:
Tether foes to a Void Anchor, dramatically weakening and suppressing them for you and your allies.

Fire two volleys of three Void Arrows that seek nearby targets. Shadowshot makes targets volatile and deals increased damage to tethered targets. Defeating tethered targets creates Orbs of Power.

While the Super is active, dealing damage increases the damage of your Void Arrows and Bow weapons.
desc.zh:
将敌人束缚在虚空之锚上，为你和盟友大幅削弱和压制他们。

发射两组三发虚空箭矢，搜寻附近目标。暗影箭矢会使敌人变得不稳定，对已被束缚的目标造成更高伤害。击败被束缚的目标会生成能量球。

在超能启用期间，造成伤害会提升你的虚空箭矢和弓箭武器伤害。

n.zh: 暗影箭矢：莫比乌斯箭袋

desc.en:
Tether foes to a Void Anchor, dramatically weakening and suppressing them for you and your allies.

The Void Anchors fired from Shadowshot pull targets toward the impact point, which then become traps and wait for prey. Void Anchors have increased range and last longer.
desc.zh:
将敌人束缚在虚空之锚上，为你和友军大幅削弱和压制他们。

暗影箭矢所发射的虚空之锚会将敌人拉向命中位置，随后变成陷阱静候猎物的到来。虚空之锚射程与持续时间均增加。

desc.en:
Summon a pair of deadly Void blades and stalk the battlefield in a veil of shadows.

[Light Attack]  : Perform a quick melee attack.

[Heavy Attack]  : Perform a heavy attack that weakens your target, and once again vanish from sight.
desc.zh:
召唤一对致命的虚空利刃，然后在暗影笼罩之下潜入战场。

 [轻攻击] ：进行一次快速的近战攻击。

 [重攻击] ：进行一次可削弱目标的重攻击，并再次从敌人的视野中消失。

desc.en: Deep ammo reserves. Fast reload when empty.
desc.zh: 更多弹药储备。打空时可提高填装速度。

desc.en: Collecting Orbs of Power strengthens this weapon's next several ricochet shots, providing more damage and more bounces between targets.
desc.zh: 收集能量球会强化此武器接下来的几发跳弹，造成更高的伤害并在目标间产生更多弹射。

desc.en: +5 Melee ▲ / -5 Weapons ▼
Adds a gold Crucible crest to your transmat effects.
desc.zh: 为你的传送效果添加一个金色熔炉纹章。

desc.en: Gain an overshield after you collect 10 Motes. This mod's effect does not stack with other copies of this mod.
desc.zh: 收集10个萤光后可获得力场护盾。此模组的效果无法与其他副本叠加。

desc.en: Become Charged with Light by picking up an elemental well. If the elemental well's element type matches your subclass element, you gain 2 stacks of Charged with Light.
desc.zh: 拾取元素井也会使你充斥光能。如果元素井的元素类型与你的分支职业元素相同，你会获得2层光之充能。

desc.en:
Collecting an Elemental pickup, collecting an Orb of Power, or destroying a Tangle reduces slightly more heat.

Elemental pickups include [Solar]Firesprites, [Void]Void Breaches, [Arc]Ionic Traces, [Stasis]Stasis Shards, and [Strand]Strand Tangles.
desc.zh:
收集元素拾取物、能量球，或是摧毁缠结会降低略多的热量。

元素拾取物包括焰灵、虚空裂口、离子轨迹、冰影碎片和缚丝缠结。

desc.en: Spread weakening effects with smoke.
desc.zh: 使用烟雾扩散削弱效果。

desc.en: Final blows with this weapon grant a small amount of health.
desc.zh: 使用此武器完成最后一击可恢复少量生命值。

desc.en: Dodging makes you vanish from sight for a short time.
desc.zh: 闪身使你从视野中消失一小段时间。

desc.en: The weekly clan challenge also grants an Enhancement Core.
desc.zh: 周常公会挑战还会提供一个强化核心作为奖励。

desc.en: Bow, Shotgun, or Sword final blows temporarily reduce incoming damage. Damaging targets with those weapons extends the effect.
desc.zh: 弓箭、霰弹枪或刀剑最后一击会暂时减少受到的伤害。使用这些武器对目标造成伤害可延长效果。

desc.en: Final blows with freshly drawn or reloaded weapons heal you.
desc.zh: 用刚刚拔出或填装的武器造成最后一击会治疗你。

desc.en:
Class abilities recharge faster when using an Arc subclass.
  •  Stacks up to 3 times
desc.zh:
使用电弧分支职业时职业技能的充能速度提高。
  •  最高可叠加3次

desc.en: Adds an additional round to the magazine and increases reload speed.
desc.zh: 为弹匣添加一发额外的子弹且提高填装速度。

desc.en: Whenever you suppress a combatant, you also weaken them, causing them to take additional damage for a short time.
desc.zh: 当你压制一名战斗人员时，你也会将其削弱，使该战斗人员在短时间内受到额外伤害。

desc.en: Defeating weakened targets creates an Orb of Power and a Void Breach.
desc.zh: 击败虚弱的目标会生成一个能量球以及一个虚空裂口。

desc.en: An ally is using Enhanced Cheer, granting all members of your fireteam the chance to gain additional Dawning Essence upon activity completion.
desc.zh: 一个队友正在使用强化欢呼，使你所在的火力战队全部成员在活动结束时有几率获得额外的曙光精华。

desc.en: Gradually reloads your stowed Shotguns over time. Multiple copies of this perk stack to reduce the time taken to fully reload.
desc.zh: 随着时间推移，逐渐为已收起的霰弹枪装填弹药。此特性的效果可以叠加，以缩短完全重新装弹的耗时。

desc.en: +10 Weapon ▲
Dealing sustained damage creates an explosion around the target. Triggers faster.
desc.zh: 造成持续伤害会在目标周围引发爆炸。触发速度更快。

desc.en: You can pick up, carry, and throw Warmind Cells. Once thrown, a Warmind Cell cannot be picked up again.
desc.zh: 你可以拾取、携带和投掷战争思维电池。投掷后，战争思维电池将无法再被拾取。

desc.en: Become Charged with Light by collecting a Warmind Cell.
desc.zh: 通过收集战争思维电池以变得充斥光能。

desc.en: Rapidly defeating targets with the detonation of a Warmind Cell generates an Orb of Power.
desc.zh: 通过引爆战争思维电池快速消灭目标会生成能量球。

desc.en: Collecting a Warmind Cell increases the chances that your next final blow with a Seraph weapon will create a Warmind Cell.
desc.zh: 收集战争思维电池会提升你下一次使用炽天使武器造成最后一击可制造战争思维电池的几率。

desc.en: Warmind Cells you create affect and damage targets at a greater distance.
desc.zh: 你所制造的战争思维电池可以影响和伤害更远距离的目标。

desc.zh: 位于盟友附近时会慢慢积累更多的部分紧急弹药，以备下次此武器弹药耗尽时使用。紧急弹药数量随着在盟友附近时间的增加而增加。

desc.zh: 提高火箭发射器的填装速度。

desc.en: Final blows with this weapon temporarily grant increased damage, reload speed, and range. This effect is frozen in time while the weapon is stowed.
desc.zh: 使用此武器造成最后一击会临时赋予更高的伤害、填装速度和射程。收起武器时暂停此效果的计时。

desc.en: Dealing damage while airborne increases this weapon's damage output.
desc.zh: 在空中时造成伤害会提升此武器的伤害输出。

desc.en: Collecting an Orb of Power causes nearby allies with at least one Armor Charge to gain an additional one.
desc.zh: 收集能量球时，会使附近所有至少拥有一层护甲充能的盟友获得额外一层。

desc.en: Stasis final blows transfer ammo to this weapon's magazine from reserves.
desc.zh: 冰影最后一击会用储存弹药填充此武器的弹匣。

desc.en:
Summon two Stasis kamas, Silence and Squall, that you throw one after another.

Silence : Creates a flash-freeze blast that freezes and damages targets.

Squall : Creates a Stasis Storm that slows and damages targets caught inside.
desc.zh:
召唤两把冰影镰刃：“沉默”与“狂啸”，并接连掷出。

沉默：制造一场急速冰冻爆炸，冰冻并伤害目标。

狂啸：制造一场冰影风暴以减速和伤害被包裹的目标。

desc.en: Adds a purple rabbit crest to your transmat effects.
desc.zh: 为你的传送效果添加一个紫色兔子纹章。

desc.en:
Cast your class ability to grant a moderate amount of Bolt Charge stacks to you and nearby allies.

While behind your Barricade, you and allies gain stacks of Bolt Charge over time and your weapons can discharge max stacks of Bolt Charge.
desc.zh:
施放你的职业技能，为你和附近的盟友提供适量的电光充能层数。

当你位于屏障后面时，你和盟友会随着时间推移获得电光充能层数，并且你的武器可以释放最大层数的电光充能。

desc.en: Improves Ascension and Tempest Strike.
desc.zh: 提升飞升与裂空打击。

desc.en: This weapon gains bonus stability and reload speed when activating a grenade ability. Healing grenades and grenade final blows grant additional stacks of the bonus.
desc.zh: 此武器在激活手雷技能时可获得稳定性和填装速度加成。治愈手雷和手雷最后一击可提供额外叠加层数。

desc.en: Shattering a [Stasis] Stasis crystal temporarily boosts your grenade recharge rate. Shattering additional [Stasis] Stasis crystals increases the duration of this benefit.
desc.zh: 破碎 冰影结晶会在短时间内使你的手雷充能速度加快。破碎额外的 冰影结晶可增加此增益的持续时间。

desc.en: Defeating a combatant with a Stasis weapon spawns a Stasis crystal. Must have a Stasis subclass equipped.
desc.zh: 使用冰影武器击败一名战斗人员会生成一个冰影水晶。必须装备冰影分支职业。

desc.en: Gain charges by inflicting subclass debuffs on targets. Consume charges by defeating combatants. While charged, this weapon gains handling, reload speed, and Sword charge rate.
desc.zh: 通过对目标施加分支职业减益来获得充能。击败战斗人员来消耗充能。充能时，此武器获得操控性、填装速度和刀剑充能速度。

desc.en: Detect caches within a 40-meter range while on Titan.
desc.zh: 在土卫六上探测40米范围内的缓存箱。

n.zh: 增强版土卫六缓存箱探测器

desc.en:
[Super]  : Conjure a hail of deadly woven needles.

After embedding themselves in the environment, the needles will re-weave into a host of Threadlings.

Threadlings you create will return to you and perch if they can't find any nearby targets. Damaging targets with your weapons or melee will send out perched Threadlings to attack.
desc.zh:
[超能]  ：召唤一阵致命织针风暴。

这些织针融入环境后，会重新编织成大量线虫。

如果你生成的这些线虫无法找到任何附近目标，它们会返回你的位置并息停。使用你的武器或近战对目标造成伤害会派出息停的线虫发动攻击。

desc.en: Void weapons get bonus reserves when picking up ammo used by that weapon.
desc.zh: 拾取该虚空武器所用弹药时，获得额外弹药储量。

desc.en: Reach seven wins to claim Passage rewards. Each win contributes to the total Crucible Performance Multiplier.
desc.zh: 达到七场胜利以领取入场券奖励。每次胜利都会提升熔炉竞技场表现系数总值。

desc.en: +15 Melee ▲
Faster ready and stow speed for Hand Cannons.
desc.zh: 提高手炮的收举速度。

desc.en: Once per activation of Force Converter, sprinting while at critical health, being suspended, or being slowed by a Stasis effect will immediately grant Speed Booster for a short duration.
desc.zh: 每次激活力量转化器可生效一次，生命危急、被悬停或受冰影效果减速时冲刺，会立即获得短暂的速度加成。

desc.en: After a final blow with a Rocket Launcher, Grenade Launcher, or micro-missile, sprint for a short time to gain Speed Booster.
desc.zh: 使用火箭发射器、榴弹发射器或微型导弹造成最后一击后，冲刺一小段时间来获得速度加成。

desc.en: Multiple final blows with this weapon grant Devour to the wielder.
desc.zh: 使用此武器多次造成最后一击可为使用者提供吞食效果。

desc.en: Highlights nearby loot caches on Io for you and your fireteam.
desc.zh: 为你和你的火力战队在木卫一上标记出位于附近的战利品缓存箱。

desc.en:
Destroying vehicles and constructs or breaking target shields grants this weapon bonus reload speed and charge rate.

Constructs include barricades, turrets, Stasis crystals, and other objects created in the field.
desc.zh:
摧毁载具和构造体或击碎目标护盾可以增加此武器的填装速度和充能速度。

构造体包括屏障、炮台、冰影水晶以及其他在战场上生成的物体。

desc.en: Grants increased reload speed when close to full magazine.
desc.zh: 接近满弹匣时赋予更快的填装速度。

desc.en:
Aiming down the sights of a Sniper Rifle for a short time loads a powerful payload that stuns unshielded combatants. 

Strong against [Stagger] Unstoppable Champions.
desc.zh:
用狙击步枪举枪瞄准一小段时间会填装强力载荷，眩晕没有护盾的战斗人员。

克制势不可挡勇士。

desc.en: Purchase this Stasis Fragment from the Exo Stranger on Europa after completing the Beyond Light campaign.
desc.zh: 在完成凌光之刻战役后，从木卫二上的Exo陌客处购买此冰影碎片。

desc.en: Increased recovery when you're in a fireteam with clanmates.
desc.zh: 当你与公会队友同处一个火力战队时，恢复力提高。

desc.en: Gain Super energy on Rocket Launcher final blows.
desc.zh: 火箭发射器最后一击获得超能能量。

desc.en: Defeating targets with grenade final blows grants Volatile Rounds to your [Void] Void weapons. Defeating targets with powered melee final blows grants Unraveling Rounds to your [Strand] Strand weapons.
desc.zh: 使用手雷最后一击击败目标会提供不稳定弹药给你的虚空武器。使用充能近战最后一击击败目标会提供瓦解弹药给你的缚丝武器。

desc.en: After defeating a target, this weapon fires, charges, or draws more slowly and deals increased damage for a brief time.
desc.zh: 在击败目标后，此武器的射速、充能速度、换持速度都会减慢，但是会在短时间内造成额外伤害。

desc.en: While Charged with Light, defeating combatants with melee damage and Swords spawns 1 Orb of Power for your allies and consumes one stack of Charged with Light.
desc.zh: 当充斥光能的时候，通过近战伤害和刀剑消灭战斗人员将为你的同伴产生1个能量球并消耗1层光之充能。

desc.en: Become Charged with Light by rapidly defeating multiple combatants with Fusion Rifles or Shotguns.
desc.zh: 使用融合步枪或霰弹枪快速击败多名战斗人员来变得充斥光能。

desc.en: When you become Charged with Light, nearby allies also become Charged with Light, if they are not already.
desc.zh: 当你充斥光能的时候，附近的同伴若还未充斥光能，则同样将充斥光能。

desc.en: While Charged with Light, regain half of your melee energy when you use a charged melee ability, consuming one stack of Charged with Light.
desc.zh: 当充斥光能的时候， 当你使用充能近战技能时重新获得一半的近战能量， 消耗一层 光之充能。

desc.en: When active, the aura grants a Bright Engram once a week when you are completing a Leviathan raid as a Guide.
desc.zh: 光环被激活后，每周作为指导者完成一次利维坦突袭后都将获得一个光明记忆水晶。

desc.en: Final blows with this weapon create a Threadling nest that periodically spawns Threadlings. Final blows with this weapon near an existing Threadling nest create a Threadling instead.
desc.zh: 使用此武器的最后一击会生成一个线虫巢，周期性地产生线虫。在已有的线虫巢附近用此武器造成最后一击时，会改为生成一个线虫。

desc.en: Sword Guard has high endurance, but low resistance.
desc.zh: 刀剑格挡拥有高持久和低抗性。

desc.en:
Uninterrupted fire from your equipped Auto Rifles grants bullets that stun combatants, delaying ability energy regeneration and lowering combatant damage output.

Strong against [Disruption] Overload Champions.
desc.zh:
使用装备的自动步枪不间断开火可以射出眩晕战斗人员的子弹，延缓其技能能量回复并降低伤害输出。

克制过载勇士。

desc.en: This weapon gains bonus range until your shield is destroyed. The bonus returns more quickly once your shield has regenerated to full strength.
desc.zh: 此武器可获得射程加成，直至你的护盾被摧毁。在你的护盾重新充满能量后，该加成将更快地重新生效。

desc.en: Final blows with this weapon grant improved bonus Super energy. When your Super expires, this weapon's magazine size is doubled for an improved long duration and reloads from reserves.
desc.zh: 使用此武器造成最后一击会获得更多额外的超能能量。你的超能结束时，此武器的弹匣容量在更长持续时间内翻倍，并从弹药储备中填装。

desc.en: Dealing damage grants a stacking bonus to magazine size, target acquisition, and range until your next final blow with this weapon.
desc.zh: 造成伤害会为弹匣容量、目标捕获能力和射程提供可叠加的加成，直至你下一次使用此武器造成最后一击。

desc.en: Fires poison arrows on perfect draw. Strong against [Disruption] Overload Champions.
desc.zh: 完美拉弓可射出毒化箭矢。克制过载勇士。

desc.en: +5 Super ▲ / -5 Health ▼
desc.zh: +5 超能 ▲ /-5 生命值 ▼

desc.en: Immediately regain your melee charge when you or an ally stuns an [Stagger]  Unstoppable Champion.
desc.zh: 当你或盟友眩晕势不可挡勇士时，立即充能你的近战技能。

desc.en: -10 to the stat that governs your class ability recharge rate
desc.zh: 决定你的职业技能充能速度的属性-10

desc.en: Breaking an enemy's shield with this weapon makes them more vulnerable to Kinetic damage for a brief period.
desc.zh: 使用武器破坏敌人的护盾，使他们在一小段时间内对动能伤害的承受力更低。

desc.en: Picking up ammo, Orbs of Power, Elemental pickups, or destroying a Strand Tangle grants stacks of Untold Greed, slightly reducing damage taken and providing reload speed to equipped weapons. When your shields are broken, some stacks are lost.
desc.zh: 拾取弹药、能量球、元素拾取物，或摧毁缚丝缠结时获得无尽贪婪层数，略微降低所受伤害，并为已装备武器提供填装速度加成。当你的护盾被击破时，会失去部分层数。

desc.en: While you have stacks of Untold Greed, Orbs of Power and Elemental pickups provide more of their respective energy, and Strand Tangles deal increased damage. When your shields are broken, all stacks are converted into a fountain of Orbs of Power.
desc.zh: 拥有无尽贪婪层数时，能量球和元素拾取物会提供更多对应能量，并且提升缚丝缠结造成的伤害。当你的护盾被击破时，所有层数会转化为一股能量球的泉涌。

desc.en: Adds a stalwart appearance to your transmat effects.
desc.zh: 为你的传送效果添加一个尽忠竭力外观。

desc.en: Adds a proud appearance to your transmat effects.
desc.zh: 为你的传送效果添加一个骄傲外观。

desc.en: Reloading after a final blow loads a high-powered round, causing the next hit to cause improved additional splash damage. Strong against [Shield-Piercing] Barrier Champions.
desc.zh: 最后一击后填装，会加载高威力弹药，使下一次命中造成更高的额外溅射伤害。克制屏障勇士。

desc.en: Quicksilver nanites grant more health the greater your stacks of Nano-Assault are. Taking damage while Nano-Assault is active has the chance to generate nanites nearby.
desc.zh: 瞬变纳米蜂群会根据你的纳米突袭层数提供更多生命值。纳米突袭生效时受到伤害有几率在附近生成纳米蜂群。

desc.en: Detect caches or resources within a 30-meter range while on Mercury.
desc.zh: 在水星上探测30米范围内的缓存箱或资源。

desc.en: Adds a green Crucible crest to your transmat effects.
desc.zh: 为你的传送效果添加一个绿色熔炉纹章。

desc.en: Blocking an attack immediately after guarding increases damage for a short duration.
desc.zh: 在防御后立刻格挡攻击将会在短时间内增加伤害。

desc.en: Sustained fire increases accuracy and range by an improved amount. Increases lunge distance for Swords, and projectile velocity for Launchers is improved amount.
desc.zh: 持续射击会进一步提升精度和射程。进一步提升刀剑的前冲距离，以及发射器的射弹速度。

desc.en: [Aim Down Sights]  : Spin up.
desc.zh: [瞄准]  ：旋转。

desc.en: Adds a Taegeuk to your transmat effects.
desc.zh: 为你的传送效果添加一个太极形态。

desc.en: Adds a Fallen Ketch appearance to your transmat effects.
desc.zh: 为你的传送效果添加一个堕落双桅船外观。

desc.en: Adds a Stasis appearance to your transmat effects.
desc.zh: 为你的传送效果添加一个冰影外观。

desc.en: Rapidly landing precision hits will return one round to the magazine.
desc.zh: 快速精准命中目标会向弹匣里填装一枚弹药。

desc.en: Dealing sustained damage creates an Orb of Power.
desc.zh: 造成持续伤害会生成一个能量球。

desc.en: Higher base damage, increased damage versus powerful combatants. High heat generated. [Reload]  to vent heat from the weapon. Overheating forces a sustained vent. Weapon cools down more rapidly between shots.
desc.zh: 高基础伤害，提升对强力战斗人员造成的伤害，高热量积累。[填装]  以释放武器热量。过热将强制持续排气。武器在射击间隙冷却得更快。

desc.en: Increases chance of receiving an engram when completing playlist activities with a clan member.
desc.zh: 提高与公会成员共同完成列表活动时获得记忆水晶的几率。

desc.en: Your equipped Pulse Rifles fire shield-piercing rounds and stun [Shield-Piercing] Barrier Champions.
desc.zh: 你装备的脉冲步枪可发射护盾穿透子弹并眩晕屏障勇士。

desc.en: Deal damage with all equipped weapons within a short time to give this weapon a damage boost.
desc.zh: 在短时间内使用所有已装备的武器造成伤害可为此武器提供伤害加成。

desc.en: Gain bonus aim assistance or projectile tracking for an improved duration after picking up an Orb of Power.
desc.zh: 拾取能量球后，获得一段时间的瞄准辅助或射弹追踪加成，持续时间延长。

desc.en:
Grenades recharge faster when using a Solar subclass.
  •  Stacks up to 3 times
desc.zh:
使用烈日分支职业时手雷技能的充能速度提高。
  •  最高可叠加3次

desc.en:
Your equipped Shotguns fire disrupting rounds which stun the target, delaying ability energy regeneration and lowering combatant damage output.

Strong against [Disruption] Overload Champions.
desc.zh:
你装备的霰弹枪会发射扰乱子弹，使目标眩晕，延缓其技能能量回复并降低伤害输出。

克制过载勇士。

desc.en: +3 Grenade
desc.zh: +3 手雷

desc.en: Detect caches within a 40-meter range while in the EDZ.
desc.zh: 在欧洲无人区中探测40米范围内的缓存箱。

n.zh: 增强版欧洲无人区缓存箱探测器

desc.en: Become Charged with Light by rapidly defeating multiple combatants with Grenade Launchers or Rocket Launchers.
desc.zh: 使用榴弹发射器或火箭发射器快速击败多名战斗人员来变得充斥光能。

desc.en: Reloading after a final blow or becoming amplified grants a longer period of increased damage. Stacks 5x.
desc.zh: 在最后一击或进入增幅状态后填装，会获得更长时间的伤害提升。最多叠加5层。

desc.en: Reloading grants this weapon bonus handling and reduces incoming flinch for a short time.
desc.zh: 填装可在短时间内为此武器提供额外的操控性并减少受到伤害时的抖动。

desc.en: Detect caches within a 30-meter range while on Io.
desc.zh: 在木卫一上探测30米范围内的缓存箱。

desc.en: Improved target acquisition, accuracy, and aim-down-sights speed for Stasis weapons.
desc.zh: 改善冰影武器的目标捕获能力、精度和瞄准速度。

desc.en: Temporarily increases reload speed and handling after sprinting or while amplified. This effect is improved when you are amplified.
desc.zh: 在冲刺后或处于增幅状态时暂时提高填装速度和操控性。此效果在你处于增幅状态时会得到提升。

desc.en: Final blows with this weapon grant bonus damage. While this buff is active, grenade or melee kills of the same damage type greatly increase its damage and duration.
desc.zh: 使用此武器对敌人造成最后一击可提供额外伤害。此增益生效期间，相同伤害类型的手雷或近战击杀会大幅提高其伤害输出并延长持续时间。

desc.en:
Picking up a piece of Candy generates a weakening pulse.

Only one mask upgrade can be active at a time. Activating this mask upgrade will deactivate the others.
desc.zh:
拾取糖果会生成削弱脉冲。

一次只能激活一个面具升级。激活此面具升级将停用其他面具升级。

desc.en: Dealing sustained damage creates an explosion around the target.
desc.zh: 造成持续伤害会在目标周围引发爆炸。

desc.en:
Sustained damage from this weapon exhausts the target for an improved duration.

Exhausted targets deal reduced outgoing damage.
desc.zh:
此武器的持续伤害会在更长时间内使目标疲惫。

疲惫的目标造成的伤害会减少。

desc.en: Targets near the blast of Property: Irreducible are [afflicted|burdened|cursed] with an elemental effect matching your equipped grenade's damage type.
desc.zh: 靠近“属性：不可约简”爆炸范围的目标会受到与你装备的手雷伤害类型相匹配的元素效果的[影响|负累|诅咒]。

desc.en: Gain a chance to obtain additional resources on the Moon.
desc.zh: 有机会在月球上获得额外的资源。

desc.en: Dealing damage with both other weapons before readying this weapon refills it from reserves. Increases ammo generation.
desc.zh: 在此武器准备就绪前，使用其他两件武器造成伤害可从弹药储备中填装弹药。提升弹药生成。

desc.en: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
desc.zh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

desc.en: Roaring Flames improves weapon and ignition damage. You are harder to suspend, slow, and freeze.
desc.zh: 咆哮烈焰会提升武器和点燃伤害。你更难被悬停、减速和冻结。

desc.en: Increases your chance of finding ammo while you have a Grenade Launcher equipped.
desc.zh: 装备榴弹发射器后，提高你找到弹药的机会。

n.zh: 榴弹发射器弹药搜寻者

desc.en: Increases ammo generation. Faster reload, stow, and ready speed when you're crouching.
desc.zh: 增加弹药储备量。蹲伏时填装、收举和准备速度提高。

desc.en: Effect lasts for 30 minutes.
desc.zh: 效果将持续30分钟。

desc.en: Overflows the magazine based on the number of rapid final blows before reloading. Improves reload.
desc.zh: 根据填装之前完成的最后一击数可过量填充弹匣, 提高填装速度。

desc.en: Every shell fired increases rate of fire for a short time. Magazine size and reserves are increased beyond their normal limits.
desc.zh: 每发射一发子弹都会暂时提升射速。弹匣容量和弹药储备超出正常限制。

desc.en: Final blows create a wave of deadly energy behind the target.
desc.zh: 最后一击会在目标后方产生致命能量波。

desc.en: Precision final blows create multiple explosive submunitions.
desc.zh: 精准最后一击会产生多个爆炸子弹药。

desc.en: Supremely improved hip fire weapon performance.
desc.zh: 极度地提升腰射武器性能。

desc.en: Precision final blows produce randomized effects.
desc.zh: 精准最后一击会产生随机效果。

desc.en: Landing precision hits or most of a pellet spread will attach a delayed explosive to the target.

收集离子轨迹会使你进入增幅状态。

desc.en: Reloading this weapon randomly overfills it from reserves to an improved degree.
desc.zh: 填装此武器将随机从储存弹药中填装更多弹药。

desc.en: Greatly improved target acquisition, accuracy, and aim-down-sights speed for Submachine Guns.
desc.zh: 大幅改善微型冲锋枪的目标锁定能力、精度和瞄准速度。

n.zh: 强化型微型冲锋枪瞄准性能

desc.en: Greatly increases targeting acquisition.
desc.zh: 大幅提升目标获取能力。

desc.en: Summon a flaming maul and crush enemies with the force of an earthquake.
desc.zh: 召唤一支燃烧的大锤，用地震的力量碾碎敌人。

desc.en: Faster ready and stow speed for Solar weapons.
desc.zh: 提高烈日武器的收举速度。

desc.en: Rapid precision hits create a lightning storm at the point of impact and grant a stack of Bolt Charge.
desc.zh: 快速精准命中会在命中位置制造一场闪电风暴，并提供一层电光充能。

desc.en: Collect Candy to become amplified.
desc.zh: 收集糖果以进入增幅状态。

desc.en: Increases accuracy, stability, and precision hit targeting when firing from the hip.
desc.zh: 提高腰际射击时的命中率、稳定性和精准命中能力。

desc.en: [Alternate Weapon Action]  : Consume the magazine and load a more powerful round.
desc.zh: [替换武器动作]  ： 消耗弹匣以填充一枚更强大的弹药。

desc.en: Increases the amount of Fusion Rifle ammo you can carry.
desc.zh: 提高可携带的融合步枪弹药数量。

desc.en: Powerful short-range Solar burst.
desc.zh: 强大的近距离烈日冲击。

desc.en: Picking up a Stasis elemental well grants you additional energy for your ability that has the lowest energy. Multiple copies of this mod increase this effect.
desc.zh: 拾取一个冰影元素井会赋予当前能量最少的技能能量。多个此模组会增强此效果。

desc.en: Elemental well mods that grant you time-limited benefits can now stack, increasing the duration of the effect for each copy of the mod you have equipped.
desc.zh: 赋予你限时加成的元素井模组现在可以叠加效果了。效果的持续时间会随着同款模组的装备数量而增加。

desc.en: Casting your Super spawns three Stasis elemental wells near you. Does not apply to Crucible, Trials, or Iron Banner.
desc.zh: 释放你的超能会在你周围生成三个冰影元素井。在熔炉竞技场、试炼或铁旗中无效。

desc.en: Stasis shards count as Stasis elemental wells for you. Does not apply to Crucible, Trials, or Iron Banner.
desc.zh: 冰影碎片现在对你等同于冰影元素井。在熔炉竞技场、试炼或铁旗中无效。

desc.en:
After dodging, your next melee attack has increased lunge range, jolts the target, and creates a damaging aftershock.

Damaging any jolted target with melee attacks also blinds them.
desc.zh:
在闪身之后，下一记近战攻击会增加前冲距离，使目标震颤，并产生破坏性的余震。

使用近战攻击对任何震颤的目标造成伤害，也会使其致盲。

desc.en: Stowing weapon restores ability energy based on final blows.
desc.zh: 收起武器会根据最后一击恢复技能能量。

desc.en:
Sustained damage from this weapon exhausts the target for an improved duration.

Exhausted targets deal reduced outgoing damage.
desc.zh:
此武器的持续伤害会在更长时间内使目标疲惫。

疲惫的目标造成的伤害会减少。

desc.en: When you fill your Heavy ammo meter, it also creates smaller bricks of Heavy ammo for your allies.
desc.zh: 当你填满重型弹药量表时，也会为盟友生成较小的重型弹药盒。

desc.en: Rapid final blows create a lightning storm.
desc.zh: 快速最后一击会生成一场闪电风暴。

desc.en: Increase Glimmer gains by 10% in the EDZ.
desc.zh: 在欧洲无人区的微光获取量提升10%。

n.zh: 欧洲无人区微光回收利用

desc.en:
Aiming down sights for a brief period with any Fusion Rifle you are wielding loads a powerful explosive payload that stuns unshielded combatants.

Strong against [Stagger] Unstoppable Champions. Additionally, Fusion Rifles are always overcharged when that modifier is active.
desc.zh:
使用任意融合步枪举枪瞄准一段时间会装载一个强力高爆载荷，眩晕没有护盾的战斗人员。

克制势不可挡勇士。此外，该修改器生效期间，融合步枪将始终过充。

desc.en: Your equipped Sidearms fire shield-piercing rounds and stun [Shield-Piercing] Barrier Champions. Additionally, Sidearms are always overcharged when that modifier is active.
desc.zh: 你装备的手枪可发射护盾穿透子弹并眩晕屏障勇士。此外，该修改器生效期间手枪将始终过充。

desc.en:
Shots from Machine Guns you are wielding disrupt combatants, stunning them, delaying ability energy regeneration and exhausting them. Strong against [Disruption] Overload Champions. 

Additionally, Machine Guns are always overcharged when that modifier is active.

Exhausted targets deal reduced outgoing damage.
desc.zh:
你使用的机枪射出的子弹可扰乱战斗人员，使其眩晕，延缓其技能能量回复，并使其疲惫。克制过载勇士。

此外，该修改器生效期间机枪将始终过充。

疲惫的目标造成的伤害会减少。

desc.en: Glaives you wield fire a powerful explosive payload that stuns unshielded combatants. Strong against [Stagger] Unstoppable Champions. Additionally, Glaives are always overcharged when the modifier is active.
desc.zh: 你装备的偃月可发射一枚强力高爆载荷，眩晕没有护盾的战斗人员。克制势不可挡勇士。此外，该修改器生效期间偃月将始终过充。

desc.en:
Sniper Rifles you are wielding fire shield-piercing rounds and stun [Shield-Piercing] Barrier Champions.

Additionally, Sniper Rifles are always overcharged when that modifier is active.
desc.zh:
你使用的狙击步枪可发射护盾穿透子弹，眩晕屏障勇士。

此外，该修改器生效期间狙击步枪将始终过充。

desc.en:
Shortly after you ready or reload a Rocket Launcher, damage from that weapon stuns unshielded combatants. Strong against [Stagger] Unstoppable Champions.

Additionally, Rocket Launchers are always overcharged when that modifier is active.
desc.zh:
在你准备或填装火箭发射器之后不久，该武器造成的伤害会眩晕没有护盾的战斗人员。克制势不可挡勇士。

此外，该修改器生效期间火箭发射器将始终过充。

desc.en:
Uninterrupted fire from your equipped Trace Rifle causes the beam to stun combatants, delaying ability energy regeneration and exhausting them.

Strong against [Disruption] Overload Champions.

Exhausted targets deal reduced outgoing damage.
desc.zh:
使用装备的追踪步枪不间断开火可以使光束眩晕战斗人员，延缓其技能能量回复并使其疲惫。

克制过载勇士。

疲惫的目标造成的伤害会减少。

desc.en: Detect caches within a 40-meter range while on the Tangled Shore.
desc.zh: 在纷争海岸上探测40米范围内的缓存箱。

n.zh: 增强版纷争海岸缓存箱探测器

desc.en: Faster ready and stow speed for Auto Rifles.
desc.zh: 提高自动步枪的收举速度。

desc.en: Adds a chain-breaking appearance to your transmat effects.
desc.zh: 为你的传送效果添加一个锁链断裂外观。

desc.en: With the scanner augment, powerful targets are marked by precision shots and take increased damage for a short period.
desc.zh: 拥有扫描增益时，遭到精准命中的强大目标会被标记，短时间内受到的伤害提高。

desc.en: Adds a gold Ghost ring to your transmat effects.
desc.zh: 为你的传送效果添加一个金色机灵环。

desc.en:
Melee hits increase your equipped weapon's reload speed and stability for a short duration.

While amplified, the effects are increased and you gain increased stacks of Bolt Charge from all sources.
desc.zh:
近战命中会在短时间内提升你已装备武器的填装速度和稳定性。

处于增幅状态时，效果获得提升，并且你会从所有来源获得更多电光充能层数。

desc.en: Picking up an Orb of Power grants Special ammo progress.
desc.zh: 拾取能量球会提供特殊弹药进度。

desc.en: Final blows with primary ammo weapons grant your primary ammo weapons temporarily increased reload speed.
desc.zh: 使用主弹药武器造成最后一击会暂时提升主弹药武器的填装速度。

desc.en: Solar weapon or ability final blows extend the duration of restoration and radiant effects applied to you.
desc.zh: 烈日武器或技能最后一击可延长施加在自身的恢复和焕光效果的持续时间。

desc.en: +3 Weapons
desc.zh: +3 武器

desc.en: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
desc.zh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

desc.en: Aiming this weapon for a short period of time without firing grants the ability to weaken the next target. Timer resets after firing or when you stop aiming down sights.
desc.zh: 瞄准此武器一小段时间而不射击，你将能够削弱下一个目标。计时器在射击或停止瞄准后重置。

desc.en: Gain [Stasis] Stasis ability energy whenever you or a member of your fireteam stuns a Champion.
desc.zh: 每当你或你的火力战队成员眩晕勇士时，获得冰影技能能量。

desc.en: Aiming in midair holds you in place while you have a Solar super equipped.
desc.zh: 装备烈日超能时，在空中瞄准可保持稳定姿态。

desc.en: Extra Fusion Grenade. Grenade kills charge Rift.
desc.zh: 额外融合手雷。手雷击杀充能裂痕。

desc.en:
Weave a vicious rope dart and tear through your targets.

[Light Attack]  : Swing the rope dart in front of you to deal damage. The tip of the dart deals bonus damage, and defeating targets with the tip causes them to explode.

[Heavy Attack]  : Swing the rope dart in a circular motion to deal heavy damage all around you.

[Grenade]  : Use the grapple to move forward quickly.
desc.zh:
编织出一根毒辣的绳镖，刺穿你的目标。

[轻攻击]  ：向前方投掷绳镖以造成伤害。绳镖尖会造成额外伤害，用镖尖击败目标会使其爆炸。

[重攻击]  ：以圆周运动挥动绳镖，对周围一切造成重创。

[手雷]  ：使用抓钩来迅速向前移动。

desc.en: Grants increased range and stability.
desc.zh: 提高射程和稳定性。

desc.en: Final blows grant a stacking bonus to airborne effectiveness. Final blows while airborne grant increased stacks.
desc.zh: 最后一击可为空中效率提供叠加加成。在空中时最后一击可提供更多层数。

desc.en: Creates tracking micro-missiles on impact.
desc.zh: 命中时生成追踪微型导弹。

desc.en:
Adds a division computed appearance to your transmat effects.

This effect will change to reflect your current Competitive Division in Crucible.
desc.zh:
为你的传送效果添加一个级别结算外观。

此效果会发生变化，以反映你当前的熔炉竞技场多人竞技级别。

desc.en: Quick attacks immediately after swapping to this Sword do additional damage for an improved duration.
desc.zh: 切换至这把刀剑之后立即进行快速攻击可造成额外伤害，持续时间延长。

desc.en: Greatly increases this weapon's ready and stow speed.
desc.zh: 大幅提升此武器的收举速度。

desc.en: Improved target acquisition, accuracy, and aim-down-sights speed for Linear Fusion Rifles.
desc.zh: 改善线性融合步枪的目标捕获能力、精度和瞄准速度。

n.zh: 线性融合步枪瞄准性能

desc.en: Projectiles attached to targets explode after a short delay. Increases stability.
desc.zh: 射弹可粘附在目标上，并在短暂延迟后爆炸。提高稳定性。

desc.en: Greatly increases ready and stow speed for Grenade Launchers.
desc.zh: 大幅提高榴弹发射器的收举速度。

n.zh: 强化型榴弹发射器灵巧

desc.en: Improves Juggernaut. Allies who follow closely gain speed boost.
desc.zh: 提升无畏护甲。紧随其后的盟友可获得速度加成。

desc.en: +15 Health ▲
desc.zh: +15 生命值 ▲

desc.en: All XP gains increased by 10%.
desc.zh: 所有获得的经验值增加10%。

desc.en: This weapon deals more damage for each elemental debuff applied to the target.
desc.zh: 此武器会根据目标身上被施加的每个元素减益效果造成更多伤害。

desc.en: Greatly increases reload speed of Pulse Rifles.
desc.zh: 大幅提高脉冲步枪的填装速度。

n.zh: 强化型脉冲步枪装填装置

desc.en: Gain increasing damage resistance when you deal damage or land final blows. Finishers grant accelerated progress. At max stacks, the recharge rate of your abilities is also increased.
desc.zh: 造成伤害或最后一击时获得递增的伤害抗性。终结技提供更快的进度。层数叠满时，你的技能充能速度也将获得提升。

desc.en: Gain a powerful overshield while performing your finisher. When you finish a target, release a slowing burst around you.
desc.zh: 使用终结技时获得一个强大的覆盖护盾。终结目标时，在你周围释放一次减速爆发。

desc.en: This weapon is granted an improved amount of aim down sights speed and movement speed while aiming down sights when no allies are near.
desc.zh: 在附近没有盟友的情况下瞄准时，此武器提供更多的瞄准速度和移动速度加成。

desc.en: Powered melee kills and finishers unleash explosions.
desc.zh: 强大近战击杀和终结技将释放爆炸。

desc.en: Significantly increases reload, range, and accuracy when no targets are in close proximity.
desc.zh: 若附近无目标，大幅提升填装、射程和精度。

desc.en: Final blows when surrounded by combatants grant Super energy.
desc.zh: 被战斗人员包围时的最后一击将赋予超能能量。

desc.en: This weapon deals increased precision damage when near two or more allies. Handling is increased.
desc.zh: 在两个或更多盟友身边时，武器造成的精准伤害增加。提高操控性。

desc.en: Improved target acquisition, accuracy, and aim-down-sights speed for Shotguns.
desc.zh: 改善霰弹枪的目标捕获能力、精度和瞄准速度。

desc.en:
Final blows grant a stacking stability, range, and accuracy bonus to this weapon. Precision final blows grant more stacks.
Effect duration is improved.
desc.zh:
最后一击可为此武器提供稳定性、射程及精度的叠加加成。精准最后一击可提供更多层数。
效果持续时间延长。

desc.en: Improves Threaded Specter.
desc.zh: 提升线织幽灵。

desc.en: Charge weapon to enable special projectile attack.
desc.zh: 充能武器来启用特殊射弹攻击。

desc.en: While Creeping Attrition is active, destroying Stasis crystals or landing precision final blows creates a Stasis shard. The Stasis shard returns to you, and collecting Stasis shards refills the magazine.
desc.zh: 在蔓延羸弱生效时，摧毁冰影水晶或造成精准最后一击会生成冰影碎片。冰影碎片可返回给你，收集冰影碎片可填装弹匣。

desc.en: Being near allies slowly builds up a partial emergency ammo refill for the next time this weapon runs out of ammo. Emergency ammo amount increases with time spent near allies.
desc.zh: 位于盟友附近时会慢慢积累部分紧急弹药，以备下次此武器弹药耗尽时使用。紧急弹药数量随着在盟友附近时间的增加而增加。

desc.en: When the battery is full, your next burst is improved, dealing additional damage and causing targets to explode when defeated.
desc.zh: 电池充满时，你的下一次点射获得提升，造成额外伤害并使目标在被击败时爆炸。

desc.en: Gain bonus Super energy from Power weapon kills.
desc.zh: 威能武器击杀可提供额外超能能量。

desc.en: This visual effect is suppressed while in combat.
desc.zh: 此视觉效果在战斗中会被压制。

克制势不可挡勇士。此外，该修改器生效期间，融合步枪将始终过充。

desc.zh: 用此武器造成持续伤害会提升填装速度和刀剑充能速度，并略微提升伤害。

基础爆炸范围增大。

desc.en: Stay amplified longer while your Arc or Prismatic subclass is equipped.
desc.zh: 装备电弧或棱镜分支职业时增幅状态保持得更久。

desc.zh: 在重伤或增幅状态下施放可获得电弧超能伤害加成。持续至超能激活结束。

desc.en: Increases the amount of damage dealt by unraveling a target.
desc.zh: 提高瓦解目标造成的伤害。

desc.en: Greatly improves the benefits provided by the Unsated Hunger, Nanotech Tracer Rockets, Harmonic Resonance, and Noble Deeds traits.
desc.zh: 大幅提升未足之饥、纳米技术追踪火箭、和谐回声和高尚事迹特性提供的增益。

desc.en: Defeating a Void debuffed target creates a Void Breach while your Void or Prismatic subclass is equipped.
desc.zh: 装备虚空或棱镜分支职业时击败受虚空减益效果影响的目标可生成一个虚空裂口。

desc.en:
Provides a non-stacking benefit to blast radius and decreases self-damage. Damaging yourself launches you further than usual.

Rapid final blows with this weapon are guaranteed to drop an enhanced Heavy ammo brick.
desc.zh:
提供对爆炸范围的不可叠加增益，并降低自我伤害。对自己造成伤害时，你被推行的距离比平常更远。

使用此武器打出快速最后一击时，必定掉落一个强化的重型弹药盒。

desc.en:
This weapon is automatically reloaded after a short period of time while holstered.

This effect completely ignores magazine size.
desc.zh:
此武器在收回枪套一小段时间后会自动填装弹药。

此效果完全无视弹匣容量。

desc.en: This weapon summons allied mini Screebs on impact.
desc.zh: 此武器在命中时会召唤友方迷你变异体。

desc.en: Allows shields to slowly recharge into an overshield.
desc.zh: 护盾会缓慢充能形成覆盖护盾。

desc.en: Increases reload speed of Grenade Launchers.
desc.zh: 提高榴弹发射器的填装速度。

desc.en: Gain charges by assisting your allies with revives, healing, overshields, and subclass buffs. Consume charges by defeating combatants. While charged, this weapon is granted bonus handling, reload speed, and sword charge rate.
desc.zh: 通过使用复活、治疗、覆盖护盾和分支职业增益协助盟友来获得充能。击败战斗人员会消耗充能。充能时，此武器可获得更高的操控性、填装速度和刀剑充能速度。

desc.zh: 你装备的虚空伤害武器会对傀儡军团战斗人员造成更多伤害。

desc.en: Increases the maximum number of stacks of Armor Charge you can carry by 1.
desc.zh: 增加1层你可携带的最大护甲充能层数。

desc.en: Gain 10% more XP while in Hellas Basin.
desc.zh: 在赫拉斯盆地中获取10%的额外经验值。

desc.en: Greatly reduces flinching from incoming fire while aiming Hand Cannons.
desc.zh: 大幅降低使用手炮瞄准时因受到伤害而产生的画面颤动。

desc.en: First loss has been forgiven.
desc.zh: 首场失利已被宽恕。

desc.en: Greatly increases nock speed of Bows.
desc.zh: 大幅提高弓箭的搭弦速度。

desc.en: Adds a green Guardian crest to your transmat effects.
desc.zh: 为你的传送效果添加一个绿色守护者纹章。

desc.en: Heavy attacks emit delayed detonating projectiles.
desc.zh: 重攻击会发射延时引爆射弹。

desc.en: Greatly increased accuracy, stability, and handling when firing while crouched.
desc.zh: 蹲伏射击时可大幅提高精度、稳定性和操控性。

desc.en: Increased resilience when you're in a fireteam with clanmates.
desc.zh: 当你与公会队友同处一个火力战队时，韧性提高。

desc.en: Kills increase this weapon's damage and begin to steadily reload the magazine from reserves until you stop firing.
desc.zh: 击杀会提高武器伤害，同时在停止射击前会持续将弹药从储存弹药中转移至弹匣。

desc.en:
Summon a precision flaming pistol that scorches and disintegrates targets with Solar Light.

Your Golden Gun deals massively increased precision damage, overpenetrates targets, and creates Orbs of Power on precision hits.

Benefits from being radiant.
desc.zh:
召唤一把精准烈焰手枪，产生烈日之光灼烧并裂解目标。

你的黄金枪可造成大幅增加的精准伤害，穿透目标，并在精准命中时生成能量球。

可从焕光状态中获益。

desc.en:
Summon a rapid-fire flaming pistol that scorches and disintegrates targets with Solar Light.

Final blows with this weapon refund a Golden Gun round and extend your super duration.

Benefits from being radiant.
desc.zh:
召唤一把速射烈焰手枪，产生烈日之光灼烧并裂解目标。

使用此武器造成最后一击将返还一枚黄金枪弹药，并延长你的超能持续时间。

可从焕光状态中获益。

desc.en: Vault into the air and unleash a volley of Solar-charged knives that explode and scorch targets.
desc.zh: 跃向空中并释放一连串会爆炸并灼烧目标的烈日能量飞刀。

desc.en: Increases mobility by +5.
desc.zh: 敏捷+5。

desc.en: Faster ready and stow speed for Bows.
desc.zh: 提高弓箭的收举速度。

desc.en: Increases the airborne effectiveness of all equipped weapons.
desc.zh: 增加所有已装备武器的空中效率。

desc.en: Increases the duration and effectiveness of the Ambush Origin Trait and the Bray Inheritance Origin Trait.
desc.zh: 强化“伏击”和“布瑞遗产”原始特性的持续时间和效果。

desc.en: Gradually reloads your stowed Grenade Launchers over time. Multiple copies of this perk stack to reduce the time taken to fully reload.
desc.zh: 随着时间推移，逐渐为已收起的榴弹发射器装填弹药。此特性的效果可以叠加，以缩短完全重新装弹的耗时。

desc.en: Reloading this weapon randomly overfills it from reserves.
desc.zh: 装填此武器将随机从备弹中多填装弹药。

desc.en: Final blows with this weapon grant your projectiles tracking and increase reload speed for an improved duration. Dealing further damage extends the duration.
desc.zh: 使用此武器造成最后一击可为射弹提供追踪能力并增加填装速度，效果持续时间延长。造成更多伤害可延长持续时间。

desc.en: Grants two knives per charge.
desc.zh: 每次充能提供两枚飞刀。

desc.en: Breaking a combatant's shield with the matching damage type grants you Armor Charge.
desc.zh: 用匹配的伤害类型击破战斗人员的护盾可获得护甲充能。

desc.en: While using an Arc subclass, Arc weapon final blows have a chance to spawn an Arc Elemental Orb. Arc Orbs can be thrown to create an Arc explosion that jolts targets it damages.
desc.zh: 使用电弧分支职业时，电弧武器最后一击有几率生成一个电弧元素能量球。电弧能量球可被投掷出去造成一次电弧爆炸，对造成伤害的目标施加震颤效果。

desc.en: While using a Solar subclass, Solar weapon final blows have a chance to spawn a Solar Elemental Orb. Solar Orbs can be thrown to create a Solar explosion that scorches targets it damages.
desc.zh: 使用烈日分支职业时，烈日武器最后一击有几率生成一个烈日元素能量球。烈日能量球可被投掷出去造成一次烈日爆炸，对造成伤害的目标施加灼烧效果。

desc.en: Weapons with the Head Rush, Nanotech Tracer Rockets, Unsated Hunger, and Cursed Thrall Origin Traits are always overcharged when that modifier is active.
desc.zh: 在该修改器生效时，带有热血上头、纳米技术追踪火箭、未足之饥和诅咒怨魂原始特性的武器将始终过充。

desc.en: While using a Void subclass, Void weapon final blows have a chance to spawn a Void Elemental Orb. Void Orbs can be thrown to create a Void explosion that makes enemies it damages volatile.
desc.zh: 使用虚空分支职业时，虚空武器最后一击有几率生成一个虚空元素能量球。虚空能量球可被投掷出去造成一次虚空爆炸，对造成伤害的目标施加不稳定效果。

desc.en: Strand weapon final blows have a chance to generate a Tangle.
desc.zh: 缚丝武器最后一击有几率生成一个缠结。

desc.en: You gain a bonus to your Super stat while you have any Armor Charge. Armor Charges decay over time.
desc.zh: 在拥有任何护甲充能时，你会获得额外超能属性。护甲充能会逐渐衰减。

desc.en:
Grants weapon shield-piercing, bypassing combatant defenses.

Strong against [Shield-Piercing] Barrier Champions.
desc.zh:
赐予武器 护盾穿透特性，击穿敌人的防御。

克制屏障勇士。

desc.en: Grants a chance to receive an Enhancement Prism as a reward at the end of Iron Banner matches.
desc.zh: 使你在铁旗比赛结束时有机会获得增强棱镜奖励。

desc.en:
Hipfiring: Projectiles will track marked targets, dealing increased body shot damage on impact.

Aiming: Projectiles have greatly increased velocity and cause extra damage when dealing precision final blows to marked targets.
desc.zh:
腰射时：射弹追击已标记的目标，命中时造成更高的身体射击伤害。

瞄准时：射弹拥有大幅提升的速度，并且对已标记的目标进行精准最后一击时造成额外伤害。

desc.en: Final blows with bonus damage rounds build and store charges which allow you to swap and stow Sturm and Together Forever weapons at a massively increased rate.
desc.zh: 使用额外伤害弹药造成最后一击会积累和存储充能，极大地提升你切换和收起狂飙和永不分离武器的速度。

desc.en: Adds a class sigil to your transmat effects.
desc.zh: 为你的传送效果添加一个职业印记。

desc.en: Dealing sustained damage scorches the target. Dealing damage to a scorched target inflicts scorch.
desc.zh: 造成持续伤害会灼烧目标。对被灼烧的目标造成伤害会施加灼烧效果。

desc.en: Arrows explode after a short delay.
desc.zh: 箭矢在短暂延迟后爆炸。

desc.en:
Sustained damage from this weapon exhausts the target for an improved duration.

Exhausted targets deal reduced outgoing damage.
desc.zh:
此武器的持续伤害会在更长时间内使目标疲惫。

疲惫的目标造成的伤害会减少。

desc.en: Increases how quickly Dark Descent reaches its full potential.
desc.zh: 加快黑暗后裔达到其全部潜能的速度。

desc.en: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
desc.zh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

desc.en: When you reach critical health or heal an ally at critical health, Auto Rifles, Scout Rifles, and Sidearms gain a period of increased range, stability, and reload speed.
desc.zh: 当你陷入生命危急或治疗生命危急的盟友时，自动步枪、斥候步枪和手枪会暂时获得射程、稳定性和填装速度提升。

desc.en: Reloading an Auto Rifle, Scout Rifle, or Sidearm after a final blow slowly restores health until you reenter combat.
desc.zh: 造成最后一击后填装自动步枪、斥候步枪或手枪可缓慢恢复生命值，直至你重新进入战斗。

desc.en: Precision final blows create an elemental damage explosion that deals more damage based on the number of rapid precision hits dealt beforehand.
desc.zh: 精准最后一击会产生元素伤害爆炸，该爆炸会根据先前造成的快速精准命中次数造成额外伤害。

desc.en: Final blows build and store charges which allow you to swap and stow this weapon at an additionally improved rate.
desc.zh: 最后一击会储存多股能量，使你切换和收举此武器的速度大幅增加。

desc.en: Greatly reduces flinching from incoming fire while aiming Sidearms.
desc.zh: 大幅降低使用手枪瞄准时因受到伤害而产生的画面颤动。

desc.en: Detects caches and resources within a 75-meter range on Mercury.
desc.zh: 在水星上探测75米范围内的缓存箱和资源。

desc.en: Landing three light-attack hits within an improved short time grants special ammo.
desc.zh: 时间窗口延长的短时间内进行三次轻攻击可提供特殊弹药。

desc.en: Sword Guard has low overall defenses, but increases charge rate.
desc.zh: 刀剑格挡拥有较低综合防御，但充能效率增加。

desc.en: Melee grants energy to nearby Aeon Cultists.
desc.zh: 使用近战可让附近永劫教派盟友获得能量。

desc.en: Improves weapon handling for equipped Power weapon.
desc.zh: 改善已装备威能武器的操控性。

desc.en: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
desc.zh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

desc.en: Final blows deploy homing robot grenades.
desc.zh: 最后一击将会部署引导机器人榴弹。

desc.en:
Activate your Barricade ability to create a ripple in reality that travels forward along the ground, suspending and damaging the targets it hits.

Final blows on targets affected by Suspend, Unravel, or Sever grant class ability energy.

This ability's damage increases with your Class stat when your Class stat is 100 or higher.
desc.zh:
激活屏障技能来在现实世界中生成一道沿着地面向前传播的涟漪，悬停击中的目标并对其造成伤害。

对受到悬停、瓦解或断舍影响的目标造成最后一击可获得职业技能能量。

当你的职业属性达到100或更高时，此技能伤害会根据职业属性而增加。

desc.en: Precision final blows in Crucible have a chance to award an Enhancement Core.
desc.zh: 在熔炉竞技场取得精准最后一击有几率奖励一个强化核心。

n.zh: 次级核心收割（熔炉竞技场）

desc.en: Precision final blows in Crucible have a chance to award an Enhancement Prism.
desc.zh: 在熔炉竞技场取得精准最后一击有几率奖励一个强化棱镜。

n.zh: 高级核心收割（熔炉竞技场）

desc.en: Breaking a combatant's shield with a matching weapon type creates an elemental well.
desc.zh: 使用对应的武器类型打破战斗人员护盾可以产生一个元素井。

desc.en:
Defeating a weakened, suppressed, or volatile target grants Invisibility and Truesight.

After performing a Stylish Execution, your next melee attack while invisible weakens targets.
desc.zh:
击败虚弱的、被压制的、或不稳定的目标可获得隐身和真视。

在完成一次潇洒处刑后，你下一次的隐身近战攻击会使目标虚弱。

desc.en: Reduces flinching from incoming fire while aiming Scout Rifles.
desc.zh: 降低使用斥候步枪瞄准时因受到伤害而产生的画面颤动。

desc.en: Increases the damage granted by Surrounded. Bonus damage lingers for a brief time when no longer surrounded by three or more enemies.
desc.zh: 提高腹背受敌造成的伤害。当周围的敌人小于三人时，额外伤害将会持续一小段时间。

desc.en: Gain bonus reserves when you pick up Special ammo.
desc.zh: 拾取特殊弹药时获得额外弹药。

desc.en: Slightly reduces flinching from incoming fire while aiming your Kinetic weapon.
desc.zh: 降低使用动能武器瞄准时因受到伤害而产生的画面颤动。

desc.en: This weapon has increased reload speed and stability for the top half of the magazine.
desc.zh: 此武器的前半弹匣弹药拥有更高的填装速度和稳定性。

desc.en: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
desc.zh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

desc.en: Faster ready and stow speed for Void weapons.
desc.zh: 提高虚空武器的收举速度。

desc.en:
Solar and Stasis melees disrupt combatants, stunning them, delaying ability regeneration and lowering combatant damage output.

Strong against [Disruption] Overload Champions. Refresh your melee ability whenever you or a member of your fireteam stuns an Overload Champion.
desc.zh:
烈日和冰影近战会扰乱战斗人员并使其眩晕，延缓其技能回复速度并降低伤害输出。

克制过载勇士。每当你或你的火力战队成员眩晕过载勇士时，刷新你的近战技能。

desc.en: This visual effect is suppressed while in combat.
desc.zh: 此视觉效果在战斗中会被抑制。

desc.en: Final blows with this weapon increase the size of its detonations for a short duration.
desc.zh: 使用此武器造成最后一击会在短时间内提升爆炸的范围。

desc.en: Defeating targets with Kinetic weapons grants you bonus Transcendence energy. Defeating targets with your Super grants you and nearby allies bonus Transcendence energy.
desc.zh: 使用动能武器击败目标会为你提供额外超凡能量。使用超能击败目标会为你和附近盟友提供额外超凡能量。

desc.en: Each rapid kill with this weapon progressively increases reload speed for a short time.
desc.zh: 此武器的每个快速击杀将在短时间内累积增加装填速度。

desc.en: Equipping multiple weapons from this set grants this weapon increased reload speed and handling. It also deals increased damage versus targets wielding Light and Darkness.
desc.zh: 装备此套装中的多件武器可增加此武器的填装速度和操控性，并增加对操控光能与暗影之力目标的伤害。

desc.en: Body shots landed with this weapon increase precision damage and aim assist for a short time. Body shots landed while the perk is active refresh the time.
desc.zh: 使用此武器命中身体部位可在短时间内提高精准伤害和瞄准辅助。特性激活时命中身体射击可刷新时长。

desc.en:
Fast movement.
[Heavy Attack]  : Dash attack.
desc.zh:
快速移动。
[重攻击] ：前冲攻击。

desc.en: Rapidly landing precision hits will return two rounds to the magazine. Increases time between precision shots.
desc.zh: 快速精准命中目标会向弹匣里返还两枚弹药。增加精准命中之间的时间间隔。

desc.en: Acquired armor pieces with randomized stats are more likely to drop with the Specialist archetype, which has Class as its primary stat and Weapons as its secondary.
desc.zh: 获取的随机属性护甲更有可能掉落专家框架：职业为主要属性，武器为次要属性。

desc.en: When you redeem a Salvage Key or a Deep Dive Key, you have a chance to earn an additional Deep Engram.
desc.zh: 兑换回收密钥或深渊潜水密钥时，你有一定几率获得额外的深渊记忆水晶。

desc.en: Defeating a combatant with a Solar or Stasis melee creates an Orb of Power.
desc.zh: 使用烈日或冰影近战攻击消灭战斗人员会生成一个能量球。

desc.en: Precision final blows greatly decrease reload time for an improved duration.
desc.zh: 精准最后一击可大幅缩短填装时间，持续时间延长。

desc.en: Sliding or standing up after crouching for a short time grants this weapon a brief period of improved bonus handling, reload speed, and damage against Hive combatants.
desc.zh: 下蹲一段时间后起身或者滑行会使此武器在短时间内提升更多操控性和填装速度，以及对邪魔族战斗人员的伤害。

desc.en: When an ally is defeated, Primary ammo weapons gain increased handling, reload speed, target acquisition, and reduced flinch. Bonus increases when multiple allies are dead at the same time or when you are running solo.
desc.zh: 当一名盟友被击败时，提高主弹药武器的操控性、填装速度、目标捕获能力并减轻抖动。当多名盟友同时死亡或单人行动时，加成提升。

desc.en: Final blows with Primary ammo weapons remove you from radar for a short time. Drawing a weapon that does not use Primary ammo will immediately end this effect.
desc.zh: 使用主弹药武器造成最后一击将使你暂时从雷达中消失。举起非主弹药武器将立即中断此效果。

desc.en: This weapon has improved reload speed and stability for the top half of the magazine.
desc.zh: 此武器的前半弹匣弹药拥有进一步提升的填装速度和稳定性。

desc.en: Fires a stable burst of four lightweight rounds.
desc.zh: 稳定地连续发射四发轻型子弹。

desc.en: Increased ammo reserves.
desc.zh: 增加弹药储备量。

desc.en:
Dealing sustained damage grants bonus damage against vehicles and constructs for an improved duration and refills ammo from reserves. Damage with Primary ammo or against constructs provides additional progress.

Constructs include barricades, turrets, Stasis crystals, and other objects created in the field.
desc.zh:
造成持续伤害可提供对载具和构造体的额外伤害，效果持续时间延长，并从备弹中填充弹药。主弹药伤害或对构造体的伤害可提供额外进度。

构造体包括屏障、炮台、冰影水晶以及其他在战场上生成的物体。

desc.en: Reduces incoming Strand damage from combatants.
desc.zh: 减少来自敌方战斗人员的缚丝伤害。

desc.en: This item comes with randomized perks.
desc.zh: 此物品自带随机特性。

desc.en: Rapid precision hits against distant combatants weaken them for a short duration.
desc.zh: 对远距离战斗人员的精准命中会在短时间内削弱他们。

desc.en: Faster ready and stow speed for Shotguns.
desc.zh: 提高霰弹枪的收举速度。

desc.en: Final blows with this weapon grant increased health and improved damage resistance from combatants.
desc.zh: 使用此武器造成最后一击可提供更高的生命值以及更多对战斗人员的伤害抗性。

desc.en:
Heavy attack deploys a shockwave uppercut and launches the user into the air.
An immediate follow-up swing after the uppercut deploys a homing strike that aggressively seeks a target.
desc.zh:
重攻击会激发一股上行震荡波，将使用者抛到空中。
在上行震荡波发生后立即进行后续攻击，会发射一次主动搜寻目标的制导打击。

desc.en: This transmat effect may be awarded in gold, green, pink, or purple color variants.
desc.zh: 此传送效果可能出现金色、绿色、粉色或紫色变幻。

desc.en: Greatly improved target acquisition, accuracy, and aim-down-sights speed for Sidearms.
desc.zh: 大幅改善手枪的目标锁定能力、精度和瞄准速度。

desc.en: Final blows with this weapon slow nearby targets.
desc.zh: 使用此武器完成最后一击可使周围目标减速。

desc.en: Fires a beam that generates a heat field.
desc.zh: 发射出一道能产生热力场的光束。

desc.en: Your Arc grenades jolt targets.
desc.zh: 你的电弧手雷会震颤目标。

desc.en: Adds spotlights to your transmat effects.
desc.zh: 为你的传送效果添加一束聚光灯。

desc.en: Understand basic words and concepts in Aionian, allowing for a greater range of linguistic interfacing with Aionian devices and ciphers.
desc.zh: 理解艾昂人的基本词汇和概念，使你能够与艾昂人的设备和暗码进行更广泛的语言交互。

n.en: Understand basic words and concepts in Aionian, allowing for a greater range of linguistic interfacing with Aionian devices and ciphers.
n.zh: 理解艾昂人的基本词汇和概念，使你能够与艾昂人的设备和暗码进行更广泛的语言交互。

desc.en: Understand most words and sentence structures in Aionian, allowing for a greater range of linguistic interfacing with Aionian devices and ciphers.
desc.zh: 理解艾昂人的大多数词汇和概念，使你能够与艾昂人的设备和暗码进行更广泛的语言交互。

n.en: Understand most words and sentence structures in Aionian, allowing for a greater range of linguistic interfacing with Aionian devices and ciphers.
n.zh: 理解艾昂人的大多数词汇和概念，使你能够与艾昂人的设备和暗码进行更广泛的语言交互。

desc.en: Understand advanced and technical concepts in the Aionian language, allowing full depth of translation.
desc.zh: 理解艾昂人语言中的高级和技术概念，实现完全的深度翻译。

n.en: Understand advanced and technical concepts in the Aionian language, allowing full depth of translation.
n.zh: 理解艾昂人语言中的高级和技术概念，实现完全的深度翻译。

desc.en: +5 Weapons ▲ / -5 Grenade ▼

While amplified, ammo is gradually transferred from reserves to the magazine.

While in Speed Booster, ammo regenerates faster and overflows the magazine. Improves magazine size.
desc.zh:
处于增幅状态时，弹药会逐渐从备弹转移到弹匣中。

拥有速度加成时，弹药回复更快并会过量填充弹匣。提升弹匣容量。

desc.en:
Your Solar Supers are enhanced. Deadshot Golden Gun has damage resistance, Marksman Golden Gun has increased duration, and Blade Barrage launches more projectiles.

While radiant, final blows with your equipped Throwing Knife fully refund your melee energy.
desc.zh:
你的烈日超能已得到强化。死亡射击黄金枪获得伤害抗性，神枪手黄金枪持续时间延长，利刃弹幕可发射更多射弹。

拥有焕光效果时，使用已装备的投掷飞刀造成最后一击可完全补偿近战能量。

desc.en: Greatly increases reload speed of Machine Guns.
desc.zh: 大幅提高机枪的填装速度。

desc.en: Rocket Launchers deal increased damage to Champions.
desc.zh: 火箭发射器对勇士造成更高伤害。

desc.en: Breaking a combatant's shield with a Strand or Stasis weapon has a chance to suspend or freeze that combatant.

desc.zh: 在此次打击中增加你和你所在火力战队的先锋代币掉落几率。

Activate your air move to consume your class ability energy and dive to the ground, suspending all nearby targets on impact.

Suspending combatants with this ability grants you Woven Mail.

This ability's damage increases with your Class stat when your Class stat is 100 or higher.

激活空中移动来消耗你的职业技能能量并朝地面俯冲，悬停附近所有的目标。

使用此技能悬停战斗人员可为你提供织造铠甲。

当你的职业属性达到100或更高时，此技能伤害会根据职业属性而增加。

desc.en: Automatically collects nearby Orbs of Power when you activate your class ability.
desc.zh: 激活职业技能时自动收集附近的能量球。

desc.en: Massively improves weapon target acquisition at the cost of a reduced amount of weapon range.
desc.zh: 以牺牲较少量武器射程为代价，大幅提升武器的目标捕获能力。

desc.zh: 最后一击会填装能量武器的弹匣。

desc.zh: 更多弹药储备。打空时可提高填装速度。

Class abilities recharge faster when using a Void subclass.

desc.en: Faster ready and stow speed for Fusion Rifles.

desc.en: [Arc] Arc sources deal increased damage to Blind targets.

desc.zh: 拾取虚空裂口后，使用虚空武器造成伤害会生成追踪射弹雨。

Picking up a [Stasis] Stasis Shard grants you class ability energy. 

Picking up a [Void] Void Breach grants you melee energy.
desc.zh:
拾取冰影碎片会赋予你职业技能能量。

拾取虚空裂口会赋予你近战能量。

desc.en:
Sustained damage with a Grenade Launcher increases the reload speed of Grenade Launchers and triggers a damaging Kinetic shockwave.

This shockwave can stun [Stagger] Unstoppable Champions.
desc.zh:
使用榴弹发射器造成持续伤害会提升榴弹发射器的填装速度，并触发造成伤害的动能冲击波。

此冲击波可以眩晕势不可挡勇士。

desc.en: Picking up a Void Breach causes your next source of Void damage to create a large weakening pulse.
desc.zh: 拾取虚空裂口可让你的下一次虚空伤害来源生成一次大型的削弱脉冲。

desc.en: Frozen combatants become surrounded by chilling fog, which slows combatants that aren't already.
desc.zh: 被冻结的战斗人员受到寒冷雾气包围，减速尚未被减速的战斗人员。

desc.en: Using your class ability changes this weapon's damage type to match your equipped Super until you stow the weapon. Improves handling.
desc.zh: 使用你的职业技能会将此武器的伤害类型更改为匹配你已装备超能的属性，直到你收起此武器。提升操控性。

desc.en:
Recovering a bolt from a living target deals damage.
[###DestinyNamedSubstitutions.ui_player_action_interact_button###][###DestinyNamedSubstitutions.ui_player_action_interact_verb###] with the bolt to retrieve it.

从存活的目标身上回收弩弹会造成伤害。
[###DestinyNamedSubstitutions.ui_player_action_interact_button###][###DestinyNamedSubstitutions.ui_player_action_interact_verb###]弩弹进行回收。

desc.en: Gain bonus Glimmer when completing Crucible matches.
desc.zh: 完成熔炉竞技场比赛可获得额外微光。

desc.zh: 燃烧锻锤和神圣献祭会生成火焰旋风。

Dealing sustained damage to Champion, miniboss, or boss combatants exhausts them and grants this weapon handling and reload speed for a longer duration.

Exhausted targets deal reduced outgoing damage.

对勇士、初级首领或首领战斗人员造成持续伤害会使他们疲惫，并在更长的时间内赋予此武器操控性和填装速度。

疲惫的目标造成的伤害会减少。

快速移动。
[重攻击] ：前冲攻击。

desc.zh: 生命值低下时，使用此武器造成最后一击可提供强化雷达，将你从敌方守护者雷达上移除，并减少战斗人员对你的攻击性。

desc.zh: 瞄准目标一小段时间会填装一枚制导微型导弹。

desc.zh: 斥候步枪举枪瞄准一小段时间可装填高爆载荷，眩晕没有护盾的战斗人员。克制势不可挡勇士。此外，该修改器生效期间斥候步枪将始终过充。

Bows gain shield-piercing arrows, which bypass combatant defenses.

弓箭射出护盾穿透箭矢，击穿战斗人员的防御。

克制屏障勇士。此外，该修改器生效期间，弓箭将始终过充。

使用任意融合步枪举枪瞄准一段时间会装载一个强力高爆载荷，眩晕没有护盾的战斗人员。

克制势不可挡勇士。此外，该修改器生效期间，融合步枪将始终过充。

Landing consecutive hits with any Hand Cannon you are wielding disrupts combatants, stunning them, delaying ability energy regeneration and lowering combatant damage output.

Strong against [Disruption] Overload Champions.
desc.zh:
使用手炮连续命中可扰乱战斗人员并使其眩晕，延缓其技能恢复速度并降低其伤害输出。

克制过载勇士。

desc.en: Your equipped Bows fire shield-piercing broadheads and stun [Shield-Piercing] Barrier Champions.
desc.zh: 你装备的弓箭会发射护盾穿透箭头并眩晕屏障勇士。

desc.zh: 降低使用狙击步枪瞄准时因受到伤害而产生的画面颤动。

desc.zh: 当你拥有增幅、焕光，或吞食效果时，此武器获得填装速度、操控性与瞄准速度。

desc.zh: 压制目标时可为充能最少的技能补充能量。

desc.zh: 滑行可填装武器的一部分弹匣，并暂时性地大幅提高武器操控性和稳定性。

desc.zh: 你所在火力战队的一名成员正在进行《命运2》试玩版。火力战队中的所有成员都将获得额外经验值。

desc.zh: 此武器在激活手雷技能时可获得更多的稳定性和填装速度加成。治愈手雷和手雷最后一击可提供额外叠加层数。

desc.zh: 快速移动积累充能，逐渐提升你的生命值回复速度。全速轰鸣时，冲刺会提供速度加成。

desc.en: Sliding while Speed Booster is active jolts combatants in front of you.
desc.zh: 速度加成生效时，滑行将震颤你前方的战斗人员。

desc.zh: 拾取弹药时微型冲锋枪获得额外弹药储量。

desc.zh: 快速元素最后一击和对受元素减益影响的目标造成最后一击，会定期准备一枚制导微型导弹，在此武器下次造成最后一击后从目标位置发射。可准备多枚导弹。

desc.en: Melee final blows with this weapon grant it additional bonus energy and provide increased movement speed while blocking.
desc.zh: 使用此武器造成近战最后一击可为其进一步提供额外能量，并在格挡时提供更高的移动速度。

desc.zh: 弹药在命中时爆炸，产生范围效果。

desc.zh: 减少来自近距离敌人的伤害。

desc.zh: 获取的随机属性护甲更有可能掉落高能者框架：武器为主要属性，超能为次要属性。

desc.en:
Picking up [Stasis] Stasis shards grants stacks of Frost Armor.

While you have Frost Armor, defeating combatants with Stasis or Kinetic weapons may cause them to shatter, damaging other nearby foes. The shatter chance increases with your Frost Armor stacks.

Taking damage while you have Frost Armor generates grenade energy.
desc.zh:
拾取冰影碎片会获得冰霜护甲层数。
