[格挡]  ：格挡。
[手雷]  ：进行圣盾投掷。

用哨兵圣盾防御来制造一堵可以吸引敌人火力的防护墙。处于护盾后方的盟友将获得更高的生存能力、武器伤害和被动填装。

为盟友防御和阻挡伤害会延长护盾持续时间并提升你的圣盾投掷伤害。

desc.en:
[Super]  : Summon three Void axes and throw them at your foes one after another. On impact, the axes pull in nearby targets and detonate in a weakening explosion. After exploding, the axes can be picked up by you or your allies and used as a weapon for a short time.

While carrying a Void axe:
[Light Attack]  : Slash forward with your axe, dealing damage and weakening targets.
[Heavy Attack]  : Throw the axe, consuming all remaining ammo.
desc.zh:
[超能]  ：召唤三把虚空战斧并依次将其扔向敌人。命中时，战斧会拉近附近的目标，然后造成具有削弱效果的爆炸。爆炸后，战斧可以被你或盟友拾起，在短时间内作为武器使用。

携带一把虚空战斧时：
[轻攻击]  ：向前挥斩，造成伤害并削弱目标。
[重攻击]  ：投掷战斧，耗尽战斧的剩余弹药。

desc.en: Adds a beastly appearance to your transmat effects.
desc.zh: 为你的传送效果添加一个兽性外观。

desc.en: Adds a lucent appearance to your transmat effects.
desc.zh: 为你的传送效果添加一个光辉外观。

desc.en: Grants a chance of receiving a Legendary engram when completing strikes with a clan member.
desc.zh: 与一名公会成员完成打击后有几率获得一个传说记忆水晶。

desc.en: Acquired armor pieces with randomized stats are more likely to drop with the Gunner archetype, which has Weapons as its primary stat and Grenade as its secondary.
desc.zh: 获取的随机属性护甲更有可能掉落枪手框架：武器为主要属性，手雷为次要属性。

desc.en: This weapon gains increased damage from melee kills and kills with this weapon. Melee kills grant ammo for this weapon.
desc.zh: 使用近战和此武器获得击杀，可提高此武器造成的伤害。近战击杀可为此武器恢复弹药。

desc.en:
You will receive a gift from a generous Guardian if you complete this activity together.

Each type of gift can be awarded only up to 4 times per activity.
desc.zh:
如果你们共同完成此项活动，一位慷慨大方的守护者将赠予你一份礼物。

每种礼物在同一活动中最多可以获得4次。

desc.en: Damaging nearby combatants with melee abilities dramatically increases handling and damage. Expires after a short duration or the next shot.
desc.zh: 使用近战技能对附近战斗人员造成伤害可大幅提高操控性和伤害。持续短暂时间后，或下次射击后过期。

desc.en: Improves reload speed for equipped Kinetic weapon.
desc.zh: 提高已装备动能武器的填装速度。

desc.en: Improves weapon damage after damaging a target with an ability.
desc.zh: 使用技能对目标造成伤害后提升武器伤害。

desc.en: Greatly increases draw time and accuracy.
desc.zh: 大幅提升拔枪速度和精度。

desc.en: Detect resources within a 30-meter range while in Hellas Basin.
desc.zh: 在赫拉斯盆地中探测30米范围内的资源。

n.zh: 赫拉斯盆地资源探测器

desc.en: Picking up an Orb of Power grants a temporary strong bonus to weapon damage of the same elemental type as your subclass.
desc.zh: 拾取能量球会暂时大幅提升与你分支职业相同元素类型的武器伤害。

desc.en:
Shatter or defeat targets with [Stasis] Stasis abilities or weapons to create a Stasis lance.

[Shoot]  : Throw the lance to freeze targets on impact.

[Melee]  : Slam the lance to the ground to freeze targets in a small area.
desc.zh:
碎裂或使用冰影技能或武器击败目标以生成冰影长矛。

[射击]  ：投掷长矛以冻结被击中的目标。

[近战]  ：使用长矛猛击地面以冻结小范围内的目标。

desc.en: A member of your fireteam has used a Scout Report, which highlights nearby loot catches in the EDZ for all members of the fireteam.
desc.zh: 你所在火力战队的一名成员使用了侦察报告，为火力战队的所有成员在欧洲无人区中标记出位于附近的战利品缓存箱。

desc.en: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
desc.zh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

desc.en: Dealing damage grants you an extended window of increased movement speed and airborne effectiveness. Landing a final blow increases these effects.
desc.zh: 造成伤害会在更长的时间内赋予你更高的移动速度和空中效率。造成最后一击会提升这些效果。

desc.en: While Charged with Light, readying or firing a Rocket Launcher grants it increased damage and reload speed. Damaging a combatant with a rocket consumes one stack of Charged with Light.
desc.zh: 充斥光能时，就绪或发射火箭发射器可提升它的伤害和填装速度。用火箭对战斗人员造成伤害消耗一层充斥光能。

desc.en: Final blows with [Solar] Solar abilities or ignitions increase the damage of your Solar abilities. Stacks 3 times.
desc.zh: 使用烈日技能或点燃完成最后一击可提高烈日技能的伤害。可叠加3层。

desc.en: Increases reload speed of Void weapons.
desc.zh: 提高虚空武器的填装速度。

desc.en:
Unleash a long-range channeled beam of concentrated Arc energy.
[Super]  : Use while active to deactivate Chaos Reach early and save Super energy.
desc.zh:
释放一道由浓缩电弧能量组成的远距离引导光束。
[超能] ：超能激活时使用以提前终止混沌之触，保留部分超能能量。

desc.en: Adds a hallowed geometry appearance to your transmat effects.
desc.zh: 为你的传送效果添加一个神圣几何外观。

desc.en: Precision final blows spawn a large Stasis crystal at a target's location.
desc.zh: 精准最后一击会在目标附近生成一块大型冰影水晶。

desc.en:
Defeating [Arc]Arc debuffed targets grants Bolt Charge.

Rapidly defeating Arc debuffed targets spawns an Orb of Power and heals a small portion of health.
desc.zh:
击败受到电弧减益的目标可获得电光充能。

快速击败受到电弧减益的目标会生成一个能量球并治疗一小部分生命值。

desc.en: Breaking a combatant's shield temporarily grants you damage resistance and increased melee damage.
desc.zh: 打破战斗人员的护盾会暂时获得伤害抗性和近战伤害提升。

desc.en: When you or a member of your fireteam stuns a champion, you gain energy for your least-charged ability.
desc.zh: 当你或你的火力战队成员眩晕勇士时，你充能最少的技能将获得能量。

desc.en: Briefly pause after executing a light attack, then follow it up with a light or heavy attack to empower your Sword for a short time, granting it bonus damage and charge rate.
desc.zh: 在一次轻攻击后稍作停顿，然后接续一次轻攻击或重攻击，可在短时间内强化你的刀剑，赋予其伤害加成和充能速度。

desc.en: While you have a Void elemental buff, melee and Sword hits weaken targets, while melee and Sword final blows create a weakening burst.
desc.zh: 当你拥有虚空元素增益时，近战和刀剑命中会削弱目标；近战和刀剑最后一击会产生削弱爆发。

desc.en: Final blows on jolted combatants blind nearby combatants.
desc.zh: 对被震颤的战斗人员造成最后一击会致盲附近的战斗人员。

desc.en: Precision final blows build progress towards a large Orb of Power that also grants bonus weapon damage on pickup. Higher ranked targets grant more progress.
desc.zh: 精准最后一击会累积进度生成一个大型能量球，拾取后为武器提供额外伤害加成。高等级目标提供更多进度。

desc.en: Improved target acquisition, accuracy, and aim-down-sights speed for Strand weapons.
desc.zh: 改善缚丝武器的目标捕获能力、精度和瞄准速度。

desc.en: Increases the Melee stat.
desc.zh: 提升近战属性。

desc.en: This item comes with randomized perks, as well as an extra perk in the left trait column.
desc.zh: 此物品自带随机特性和左侧特性栏的一个额外特性。

desc.en:
Fires projectiles made of compressed quantum particles that decompress within targets after a short delay, lacerating them.

Over-pressurizing this weapon with Quantum Nova releases a detonation around you.
desc.zh:
发射由压缩量子粒子构成的射弹，它将在目标体内短暂延迟后解压，撕裂目标。

使用量子新星对该武器进行过度增压，会在你周围引爆。

desc.en: Improved weapon performance and greatly increased recovery when its wielder is the last living member of a fireteam.
desc.zh: 当你是火力战队最后存活的成员时，武器性能提高，生命值恢复速度大幅提高。

desc.en: Increases reload speed of Solar weapons.
desc.zh: 提高烈日武器的填装速度。

desc.en: Increases duration of Rampage.
desc.zh: 提高狂暴的持续时间。

desc.en: After dealing damage with your Super, health and shields regenerate over time while you are in motion. Additional Super damage refreshes this effect.
desc.zh: 使用超能造成伤害后，你移动时会逐渐回复生命值和护盾。额外超能伤害可刷新此效果。

desc.en: Picking up ammo reloads stowed Special weapons from reserves.
desc.zh: 拾取弹药会从备弹中填装收起的特殊武器。

desc.en: Increased chance to obtain additional faction consumables in the Crucible.
desc.zh: 提高在熔炉竞技场中获得额外阵营消耗品的几率。

n.zh: 改良熔炉竞技场探测器

desc.en: Spark of Resilience
desc.zh: 韧性火花

desc.en: Grants class ability energy when you cause damage with a grenade.
desc.zh: 使用手雷造成伤害时获得职业技能能量。

desc.en: Your equipped weapons that deal Kinetic damage deal increased damage to Taken combatants.
desc.zh: 你装备的动能伤害武器会对傀儡军团战斗人员造成更多伤害。

desc.en: Gain damage reduction while carrying the King's Fall relic.
desc.zh: 在运送“国王的陨落”圣物时获得伤害减免。

desc.en: Gain increased mobility and resilience while you are Torn Between Dimensions.
desc.zh: 维度撕裂期间，提高敏捷和韧性。

desc.en: Gain increased recovery and weapon reload speed while you have a Brand or are in a pool of Reclaimed Light.
desc.zh: 当你持有烙印或在回收光能池中时，可提高恢复和武器填装速度。

desc.en: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
desc.zh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

desc.en: A member of your fireteam has used a Scout Report, which highlights nearby loot catches on Titan for all members of the fireteam.
desc.zh: 你所在火力战队的一名成员使用了侦察报告，为火力战队的所有成员在土卫六上标记出位于附近的战利品缓存箱。

desc.en: This weapon can be drawn unbelievably fast.
desc.zh: 难以置信武器的拔出速度有多快。

desc.en: Reduces incoming Solar damage from combatants.
desc.zh: 减少来自战斗人员的烈日伤害。

desc.en: Increases the amount of Trace Rifle ammo you can carry.
desc.zh: 提高可携带的追踪步枪弹药数量。

desc.en: Increases the buff effect of the To Excess Origin Trait and the healing effect of the Souldrinker Origin Trait.
desc.zh: 增加“过量”原始特征的增益效果，并强化“灵魂饮者”原始特征的效果。

desc.en: Increases this armor's resilience, allowing you to absorb more damage.
desc.zh: 提高这件护甲的韧性，以提高你的伤害接受能力。

desc.en: Adds an ensign appearance to your transmat effects.
desc.zh: 为你的传送效果添加一个旗帜外观。

desc.en: Using a Noble Round on an ally heals them and grants both you and them a weapon damage bonus for a short duration.
desc.zh: 对一位盟友使用高尚弹药可对其进行治疗，并在短时间内给予你和该盟友武器伤害加成。

desc.en: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
desc.zh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

desc.en: Damaging targets while firing from the hip increases handling, reload speed, and movement speed for an improved amount while aiming down sights.
desc.zh: 腰射时伤害目标会进一步提升瞄准时的操控性、填装速度和移动速度。

desc.en: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
desc.zh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

desc.en: Reloading a weapon grants it a bonus to handling and reduces incoming flinch for a short time. Weapons with the SUROS Synergy Origin Trait are granted increased range instead.
desc.zh: 填装武器可在短时间内提升其操控性及减少受到的抖动。如果武器拥有SUROS协同原始特性，则改为提升射程。

desc.en: Gain increased reload speed for the bottom half of your equipped weapon's magazine.
desc.zh: 你装备的武器弹匣剩余一半子弹时填装速度提升。

desc.en: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
desc.zh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

desc.en: +5 Class ▲ / -5 Weapons ▼
Chance to obtain additional faction consumables on Nessus.
desc.zh: 有机会在涅索斯上获得额外的阵营消耗品。

desc.en:
Collecting ammo loads this weapon from reserves and enhances its damage and reload speed for an improved duration.

Collecting Heavy ammo grants more time.
desc.zh:
拾取弹药会从备弹中填装此武器，并在更长时间内提升其伤害和填装速度。

拾取重型弹药提供的时间更长。

desc.en: Improves weapon handling for equipped Energy weapon.
desc.zh: 改善已装备能量武器的操控性。

desc.en: When you fill your Special ammo meter, it also creates smaller bricks of Special ammo for your allies.
desc.zh: 当你填满特殊弹药量表时，也会为盟友生成较小的特殊弹药盒。

desc.en: Kills with this weapon heal the wielder. Precision kills also refill the magazine.
desc.zh: 完成击杀可治疗持枪者。完成精准击杀还可装填弹匣。

desc.en: Increases the Class stat.
desc.zh: 提升职业属性。

desc.en: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
desc.zh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

desc.en: Gain enhanced radar resolution and increased reload speed when combatants are in close proximity.
desc.zh: 当战斗人员接近时，获得强化的雷达分辨率和提升的填装速度。

desc.en: Gain 10% more XP while on Mercury.
desc.zh: 在水星上获取10%的额外经验值。

desc.en: Rapid Arc weapon final blows create an Orb of Power.
desc.zh: 快速电弧武器最后一击可生成能量球。

desc.en: Create traps that suspend targets.
desc.zh: 生成可悬停目标的陷阱。

desc.en: Reduces grenade cooldown each time you pick up an Orb of Power.
desc.zh: 每次拾取能量球都将缩短手雷的冷却时间。

desc.en: Landing consecutive hits with a Sword you are wielding disrupts combatants, stunning them, delaying ability energy regeneration and lowering combatant damage output. Strong against [Disruption]  Overload Champions. Additionally, Swords are always overcharged when that modifier is active.
desc.zh: 使用刀剑连续命中可扰乱战斗人员并使其眩晕，延缓其技能能量回复速度并降低战斗人员伤害输出。克制过载勇士。此外，该修改器生效期间刀剑将始终过充。

desc.en: +10 Impact
desc.zh: +10 冲击力

desc.en: Shoots a long volley of rockets.
desc.zh: 发射一长串火箭。

desc.en: Landing a hit on a slowed or frozen target has a chance to return the round to the magazine.
desc.zh: 击中被减速或冻结的目标有几率将弹药返还到弹匣。

desc.en: Scout Rifles get bonus reserves when you pick up ammo.
desc.zh: 拾取弹药时斥候步枪获得额外弹药储量。

desc.en: While sliding, activate your charged melee ability to blink forward, calling down lightning strikes that jolt targets as you rematerialize. This ability also makes you amplified and grants Bolt Charge.
desc.zh: 在滑铲时，启动你的已充能近战技能来向前瞬移，在重新物质化的同时降下闪电打击震颤目标。此技能还能让你获得增幅状态，并提供电光充能。

desc.en: Vanguard playlist strikes and Nightfall completions have a chance to drop an additional piece of Legendary gear.
desc.zh: 完成先锋游戏列表打击和日落有几率额外掉落一件传说装备。

desc.en: Dodging grants energy to nearby Aeon Cultists.
desc.zh: 闪身可使附近永劫教派盟友获得能量。

desc.en:
Arc melee abilities recharge faster.
  •  Stacks up to 3 times
desc.zh:
提高电弧近战技能充能速度。
  •  最高可叠加3次

desc.en: Defeating targets partially reloads the magazine from reserves.
desc.zh: 消灭目标会使弹药从储存弹药中转移并填装部分弹匣。

desc.en: Precision final blows and rapid precision hits briefly grant bonus handling, range, rate of fire, and precision damage with this weapon.
desc.zh: 精准最后一击和快速精准击杀会短暂提供武器额外的操控性、射程、射速和精准伤害。

desc.en: Defeating combatants with this weapon generates an improved small amount of Super energy.
desc.zh: 使用此武器消灭战斗人员会产生少量超能能量，能量数量提高。

desc.en: Gain extra damage resistance against powerful combatants.
desc.zh: 获得对抗来自强大敌人的额外伤害抗性。

desc.en: While you are the only member of your fireteam, precision weapon final blows increase weapon damage until you are defeated.
desc.zh: 当你是火力战队的唯一成员时，精准武器最后一击会提升武器伤害，直至你被击败。

desc.en: Your Dragonfly, Chain Reaction, and Firefly explosions deal more damage.
desc.zh: 提高蜻蜓、连锁反应和萤火虫爆炸所造成的伤害。

desc.en: When using a Grenade Launcher, damaging a boss, damaging a Champion, or breaking a combatant's shield reloads your stowed weapons and weakens the combatant.
desc.zh: 当使用榴弹发射器的时候，对首领造成伤害、对勇士造成伤害、或打破战斗人员的护盾将填装你收起的武器并削弱战斗人员。

desc.en: Dealing damage with elemental abilities grants increased damage to weapons of the same element for a short duration. Dealing damage with elemental weapons grants increased damage to abilities of the same element for a short duration.
desc.zh: 使用元素技能造成伤害会在短时间内加强同元素武器的伤害。使用元素武器造成伤害会在短时间内加强同元素技能的伤害。

desc.en: Receive less damage from combatants that are close to you while you are wielding a Glaive.
desc.zh: 挥舞偃月时，你附近的战斗人员对你造成的伤害降低。

desc.en: Dealing damage to Void debuffed targets increases this weapon's damage for a short time per each type of Void debuff affecting the target.
desc.zh: 对受到虚空减益的目标造成伤害，会按影响目标的虚空减益类型数量在短时间内提升此武器的伤害。

desc.en: While Adrenal Rush is active, final blows grant Special Ammo progress. Final Blows against powerful combatants, Guardians, and Taken grants additional progress.
desc.zh: 肾上腺素亢奋生效期间，最后一击提供特殊弹药进度。对强力战斗人员、守护者及傀儡军团造成的最后一击可提供额外进度。

desc.en: Sprinting for a short time grants a period of improved reload speed and handling. Final blows extend this period.
desc.zh: 短暂冲刺会在一段时间内提升填装速度和操控性。最后一击可延长持续时间。

desc.en: Your class ability recharges faster when you scorch targets.
desc.zh: 灼烧目标时你的职业技能充能速度将加快。

desc.en: Blocking damage after raising your guard emits a short-range blast that disorients targets.
desc.zh: 举起防御阻挡伤害后会释放出一道使目标迷失方向的短程冲击波。

desc.en: Rapid Solar weapon final blows create an Orb of Power.
desc.zh: 快速烈日武器最后一击可生成能量球。

desc.en: Sustained fire weakens targets. Strong against [Shield-Piercing] Barrier Champions.
desc.zh: 持续火力可削弱目标。克制屏障勇士。

desc.en:
Grants a Dawning reward to your fireteam upon completion of an Ops activity, with additional rewards based on the number of teammates with Boons active.

Effect lasts until a reward is earned. Only one Boon of Friendship may be active per fireteam member.
desc.zh:
在完成行动活动时给予你的火力战队一个曙光节奖励，并根据当前受到恩惠的队友数量提供额外奖励。

效果会在获得一个奖励后消失。每名火力战队成员只能启用一个友谊恩惠。

desc.en: Melee kills restore health for a short duration.
desc.zh: 完成近战击杀可在一小段时间内补充生命值。

desc.en: Solar grenades burn longer. Melee kills restore them.
desc.zh: 烈日手雷燃烧时间更长，可通过近战击杀充能。

desc.en: Melee and finisher final blows increase melee damage.
desc.zh: 近战和终结技最后一击会提升近战伤害。

desc.en:
[Grenade]  : Overcharge your grenade, making it deadlier and more effective.

Vortex Grenade: Increases the size, linger duration, and pull of the vortex.

Axion Bolt: Detonates twice and has enhanced seekers.

Scatter Grenade: Submunitions track to nearby targets.

Magnetic Grenade, Spike Grenade, Voidwall Grenade, and Suppressor Grenade: Releases a short-range Void blast. Cooldown is reduced.

Grants an additional grenade charge.
desc.zh:
[手雷]  ：对手雷进行过充，使其更加致命有效。

涡流手雷：提升漩涡的大小、持续时间和和拉力。

量子光束：引爆两次，拥有强化追踪弹。

散射手雷：子弹药可追踪附近目标。

磁性手雷、尖刺榴弹、虚空之墙手雷和抑制手雷：释放短程的虚空爆破。冷却时间减少。

提供额外手雷充能。

desc.en:
You can fire weapons, melee, and throw grenades while gliding.

[Grenade]  : Hold to consume your grenade, gaining Heat Rises and releasing a burst of healing energy that cures nearby allies. The strength of the burst is increased when a Healing Grenade is consumed.

Final blows while airborne increase the duration of Heat Rises and grant melee energy.
desc.zh:
滑行时可使用武器射击、发动近战和投掷手雷。

[手雷]  ：按住来消耗手雷，可获得炙热升腾并爆发治疗能量，来治愈 附近的盟友。消耗治愈手雷时，爆发强度将会提升。

在空中时造成最后一击可提升炙热升腾的持续时间并提供近战 能量。

desc.en:
Sustained damage from this weapon exhausts the target for a short duration.

Exhausted targets deal reduced outgoing damage.
desc.zh:
此武器的持续伤害会在短时间内使目标疲惫。

疲惫的目标造成的伤害会减少。

desc.en: Dealing sustained damage with this weapon loads a small amount of ammo from reserves, or removes heat, and slightly increases damage.
desc.zh: 用此武器造成持续伤害会从备弹中填装少量弹药或移除热量，并略微提升伤害。

desc.en: Reduces class ability cooldown each time you pick up an Orb of Power.
desc.zh: 每次拾取能量球都将缩短职业技能的冷却时间。

desc.en: Adds a hunting crest appearance to your transmat effects.
desc.zh: 为你的传送效果添加一个猎杀纹章外观。

desc.en: Dealing sustained damage severs the target.
desc.zh: 造成持续伤害可割裂目标。

desc.en: Increases the energy recharge rate of your equipped Swords. Your equipped Glaives gain more energy from dealing damage with their ranged attacks.
desc.zh: 提高装备中刀剑的充能速率。装备中的偃月会在使用远程攻击造成伤害时获得更多能量。

desc.en: A member of your fireteam has used a Scout Report, which highlights nearby loot catches on Io for all members of the fireteam.
desc.zh: 你所在火力战队的一名成员使用了侦察报告，为火力战队的所有成员在木卫一上标记出位于附近的战利品缓存箱。

desc.en: Deals extra damage against powerful combatants, bosses, and vehicles.
desc.zh: 对强大的战斗人员、首领和载具造成额外伤害。

desc.en: Increased chance to find Solstice Key Fragments.
desc.zh: 增加找到至日密匙片段的几率。

desc.en: When you have Unstable Essence, rapid weapon damage or final blows heal you and begin health regeneration.
desc.zh: 拥有不稳定精华时，你的快速武器伤害或最后一击会提供治疗并开启生命值回复。

desc.en: Final blows to a challenging combatant or higher-ranked target grant Unstable Essence. When you have Unstable Essence, you receive grenade and melee stat bonuses.
desc.zh: 对强力战斗人员或高阶目标造成最后一击可获得不稳定精华。拥有不稳定精华时，你会获得手雷和近战属性加成。

desc.en: Improved target acquisition, accuracy, and aim-down-sights speed for Sidearms.
desc.zh: 改善手枪的目标捕获能力、精度和瞄准速度。

desc.en: While stunned, Champions take bonus damage from your abilities and Elemental Orb damage.
desc.zh: 处于眩晕状态时，勇士会受到来自你技能和元素能量球的额外伤害。

desc.en: When an ally destroys or picks up your Tangle or Elemental Orb, the Tangle cooldown is reduced by 5 seconds and you gain bonus damage with weapons matching your subclass for 10 seconds.
desc.zh: 当盟友摧毁或拾取你的缠结或元素能量球时，缠结冷却减少5秒，你使用与分支职业相匹配的武器会获得额外伤害，持续10秒。

desc.en:
Uninterrupted fire from your equipped Machine Guns grants bullets that stun combatants, delaying ability energy regeneration and lowering combatant damage output.

Strong against [Disruption] Overload Champions.
desc.zh:
使用装备的机枪不间断开火可以射出使战斗人员眩晕的子弹，延缓其技能能量回复并降低其伤害输出。

克制过载勇士。

desc.en: Picking up a Tangle or Elemental Orb grants energy to your least-powered ability.
desc.zh: 拾取缠结或元素能量球会为你充能最少的技能提供能量。

desc.en: If you have fewer than 2 stacks of Armor Charge, rapid precision shots with Bows, Snipers, and Scout Rifles generate an Armor Charge.
desc.zh: 如果你拥有的护甲充能少于2层，使用弓箭、狙击步枪和斥候步枪快速精准命中会生成一层护甲充能。

desc.en: Increased damage against bosses, vehicles, and Guardians with their Super active. Stability is improved. Swords have improved guard resistance.
desc.zh: 对首领、载具和激活超能的守护者造成更多伤害。提升稳定性。刀剑拥有更高的防御抗性。

desc.en: Improves Sentinel Shield and Unbreakable.
desc.zh: 提升哨兵圣盾和坚不可摧。

desc.en: Adds a bone spiral appearance to your transmat effects.
desc.zh: 为你的传送效果添加一个白骨螺旋外观。

desc.en: Adds a heartbreaking appearance to your transmat effects.
desc.zh: 为你的传送效果添加一个心碎外观。

desc.en: Direct hits with the top half of the magazine cause a detonation that slows nearby targets.
desc.zh: 使用前半弹匣弹药直接命中可造成减速附近目标的爆炸。

desc.en: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
desc.zh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

desc.en: Collecting a Stasis shard grants energy to your least-charged ability.
desc.zh: 收集冰影碎片可为你充能最少的技能提供能量。

desc.en: This weapon gains a boost to reload speed as your health gets lower.
desc.zh: 你的生命值越低，这款武器的填装速度就越快。

desc.en: Damaging rank-and-file combatants increases damage against more powerful ones. Powerful shots consume fewer stacks.
desc.zh: 对普通战斗人员造成伤害会提升对高阶敌人的伤害。强力射击会消耗更少层数。

desc.en: Kills refill the magazine, increase damage, and grant Super energy.
desc.zh: 完成击杀可填装弹匣，增加伤害，并给予超能能量。

desc.en: Detect caches within a 30-meter range while on Nessus.
desc.zh: 在涅索斯上探测30米范围内的缓存箱。

desc.en: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
desc.zh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

desc.en: Improves Sol Invictus and Sunspots.
desc.zh: 提升无敌索尔与太阳黑子。

desc.en: Increases weapon handling and health after freezing a target with [Stasis] Stasis.
desc.zh: 使用冰影冻结目标后，提升武器操控性和生命值。

desc.en: Faster time to aim down sights.
desc.zh: 提高瞄准速度。

desc.en: When your shields begin to regenerate, you gain flinch resistance and damage resistance for a short time.
desc.zh: 当你的护盾开始回复时，你在短时间内获得抖动抗性和伤害抗性。

desc.en: While your reserves are low, combatant final blows with weapons provide additional ammo progress based on their ammo type.  Primary ammo weapons boost Special ammo progress, and Special ammo weapons boost Heavy ammo progress.
desc.zh: 当你的弹药储备较低时，使用武器对战斗人员造成最后一击，会根据武器弹药类型提供额外的弹药进度。主弹药武器可提升特殊弹药进度，特殊弹药武器可提升重型弹药进度。

desc.en: When aiming down sights, weapon rate of fire slows while weapon damage increases. Final blows while aiming down sights grant bonus Heavy ammo progress. [Alternate Weapon Action]  to swap to Spinning Up.
desc.zh: 瞄准时武器射速会降低，但伤害会提高。瞄准时造成最后一击可提供额外重型弹药进度。[替换武器动作] 切换至旋转直上。

desc.en: Increases your chance of finding Primary ammo while you have a Submachine Gun equipped.
desc.zh: 装备微型冲锋枪后，提高你找到主武器弹药的机会。

n.zh: 微型冲锋枪弹药搜寻者

desc.en: Throw your Praxic Blade to hit multiple targets. Strong against [Shield-Piercing] Barrier Champions.
desc.zh: 投掷你的英勇利刃以命中多个目标。克制屏障勇士。

desc.en: Hipfired shots track targets.
desc.zh: 腰射弹药将追踪目标。

desc.en: Adds a purple beam to your transmat effects.
desc.zh: 为你的传送效果添加一束紫色光束。

desc.en:
Grenades bounce.
[Shoot]  : Fire; release to detonate.
desc.zh:
可弹跳榴弹。
[射击] ： 发射，松开扳机引爆。

desc.en: Your Solar Super projectiles have stronger target acquisition.
desc.zh: 你的烈日超能弹道将拥有更强的捕获能力。

desc.en: Grants extra Strange Coins when completing Vanguard Ops or Onslaught activities, or also for winning Crucible or Gambit matches. Rewards increase with additional stacks.
desc.zh: 完成先锋行动或猛攻活动时，或者赢得熔炉竞技场或智谋比赛时，可获得额外的奇异硬币。额外层数越多，奖励会随之增加。

desc.en: Grants extra Strange Coins when completing Vanguard Ops or Onslaught activities, or also for winning Crucible or Gambit matches. Rewards increase with additional stacks.
desc.zh: 完成先锋行动或猛攻活动时，或者赢得熔炉竞技场或智谋比赛时，可获得额外的奇异硬币。额外层数越多，奖励会随之增加。

desc.en: Grants extra Strange Coins when completing Vanguard Ops or Onslaught activities, or also for winning Crucible or Gambit matches. Rewards increase with additional stacks.
desc.zh: 完成先锋行动或猛攻活动时，或者赢得熔炉竞技场或智谋比赛时，可获得额外的奇异硬币。额外层数越多，奖励会随之增加。

desc.en: Aiming down sights at a target for a short time loads a homing micro-missile.
desc.zh: 瞄准目标一小段时间会填装一枚制导微型导弹。

desc.en:
Class abilities recharge faster when using a Void subclass.
  •  Stacks up to 3 times
desc.zh:
使用虚空分支职业时职业技能的充能速度提高。
  •  最高可叠加3次

desc.en: Improves melee damage when you're surrounded.
desc.zh: 当你被包围时提升近战伤害。

desc.en: Weapon final blows grant grenade damage.
desc.zh: 武器最后一击会提供手雷伤害加成。

desc.en: Finishers and powered melee final blows grant invisibility.
desc.zh: 终结技和充能近战最后一击会赋予隐身。

desc.en: Using an ability empowers the other two abilities.
desc.zh: 使用技能会为其他两项技能赋能。

desc.en: Weapons ready very quickly.
desc.zh: 武器的准备速度非常快。

desc.en: Orbs of Power overcharge your Super.
desc.zh: 能量球会过充超能。

desc.en: Final round drains life force to deal extra damage.
desc.zh: 最后一发子弹会吸收生命力以造成更大伤害。

desc.en: This visual effect is suppressed while in combat.
desc.zh: 此视觉效果在战斗中会被压制。

desc.en: Powered melee hits against targets makes you radiant. Powered melee final blows make you and nearby allies radiant.
desc.zh: 充能近战命中目标会赋予你焕光效果。充能近战最后一击会赋予你和附近盟友焕光效果。

desc.en:
Uninterrupted fire from your equipped Auto Rifles grants bullets that stun combatants, delaying ability energy regeneration and lowering combatant damage output. Strong against [Disruption] Overload Champions.

Additionally, Auto Rifles are always overcharged when this modifier is active.
desc.zh:
使用装备的自动步枪不间断开火可以射出眩晕战斗人员的子弹，延缓其技能能量回复并降低其伤害输出。克制过载勇士。

此外，该修改器生效期间自动步枪将始终过充。

desc.en:
Sniper Rifles you are wielding fire shield-piercing rounds and stun [Shield-Piercing] Barrier Champions.

Additionally, Sniper Rifles are always overcharged when that modifier is active.
desc.zh:
你使用的狙击步枪可发射护盾穿透子弹，眩晕屏障勇士。

此外，该修改器生效期间狙击步枪将始终过充。

desc.en:
Submachine Guns you are wielding fire shield-piercing rounds and stun [Shield-Piercing] Barrier Champions.

Additionally, Submachine Guns are always overcharged when the modifier is active.
desc.zh:
你使用的微型冲锋枪可发射护盾穿透子弹并眩晕屏障勇士。

此外，该修改器生效期间微型冲锋枪将始终过充。

desc.en:
Landing consecutive hits with any Hand Cannon you are wielding disrupts combatants, stunning them, delaying ability energy regeneration and lowering combatant damage output. Strong against [Disruption] Overload Champions. 

Additionally, Hand Cannons are always overcharged when the modifier is active.
desc.zh:
使用任意手炮连续命中可扰乱战斗人员并使其眩晕，延缓其技能能量回复速度并降低战斗人员伤害输出。克制过载勇士。

此外，该修改器生效期间手炮将始终过充。

desc.en: Aiming down the sights of a Scout Rifle for a short time loads a powerful explosive payload that stuns unshielded combatants. Strong against [Stagger] Unstoppable Champions. Additionally, Scout Rifles are always overcharged when that modifier is active.
desc.zh: 斥候步枪举枪瞄准一小段时间可装填高爆载荷，眩晕没有护盾的战斗人员。克制势不可挡勇士。此外，该修改器生效期间斥候步枪将始终过充。

desc.en:
Aiming down the sights of a Sidearm for a short time loads a powerful explosive payload that stuns unshielded combatants. Strong against [Stagger] Unstoppable Champions.

Additionally, Sidearms are always overcharged when the modifier is active.
desc.zh:
手枪举枪瞄准一小段时间可装填高爆载荷，眩晕没有护盾的战斗人员。克制势不可挡勇士。

此外，该修改器生效期间手枪将始终过充。

desc.en: Your equipped Pulse Rifles fire shield-piercing rounds and stun [Shield-Piercing] Barrier Champions. Additionally, Pulse Rifles are always overcharged when that modifier is active.
desc.zh: 你装备的脉冲步枪可发射护盾穿透子弹并眩晕屏障勇士。此外，该修改器生效期间脉冲步枪将始终过充。

desc.en: Gain an additional Shield Throw charge while Sentinel Shield is active.
desc.zh: 哨兵圣盾激活时可进行一次额外的圣盾投掷。

desc.en: [Alternate Weapon Action]  to consume Fate of all Fools and prime a single Fated Missile that deals increased damage based on the number of stacks consumed.
desc.zh: [替换武器动作]  消耗愚者宿命，准备一枚宿命导弹，根据消耗层数造成更高伤害。

desc.en: Defeating a target with a Stasis grenade spawns a Stasis shard.
desc.zh: 使用冰影手雷击败目标会生成一块冰影碎片。

desc.en: Targets under the effects of Judgment long enough are struck with a burst of damage.
desc.zh: 受审判效果影响时间足够长的目标会受到爆发性伤害。

desc.en:
Defeating a challenging Taken combatant refreshes your class ability.

This mod's abilities cannot stack across multiple copies.
desc.zh:
消灭高阶傀儡军团战斗人员会刷新你的职业技能。

装备多个此模组无法使效果叠加。

desc.en: Adds a purple spotlight to your transmat effects.
desc.zh: 为你的传送效果添加一束紫色聚光灯。

desc.en: Increases the chance of receiving reputation tokens when completing Nightfalls, Raids, and Trials.
desc.zh: 提高完成日落、突袭和试炼时获得声望代币的几率。

desc.en: Adds a pink class sigil to your transmat effects.
desc.zh: 为你的传送效果添加一个粉色职业印记。

desc.en: Reloading after defeating targets grants energy to your lowest charged ability.
desc.zh: 击败目标后填装，会提供能量给当前充能最低的技能。

desc.en: Hurl an explosive bolt of Void Light at the enemy, disintegrating those caught within its blast.
desc.zh: 向敌人抛出可发生爆炸的虚空光束，裂解爆炸范围内的敌人。

desc.en: The number of precision final blows before reloading affects the total rounds granted with increased range and damage. Precision final blows with Magnificent Howl active extend the effect for additional rounds. Improves reload.
desc.zh: 填装前精准最后一击的次数会影响射程和伤害增加的子弹总数。激活宏伟之嚎时，精准最后一击会延长额外子弹效果。提升填装速度。

desc.en: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
desc.zh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

desc.en: Adds a silver spotlight to your transmat effects.
desc.zh: 为你的传送效果添加一束银色聚光灯。

desc.en: Replaces Barricade with a wall of Stasis crystals.
desc.zh: 用冰影水晶墙替换屏障。

desc.en: Increases your chances of finding Heavy ammo while you have a Bow equipped that uses Heavy ammo.
desc.zh: 装备使用重型弹药的弓箭后，提高你找到重型弹药的机会。

desc.en: Traditional guarding is disabled in favor of offensive capabilities. Gain greatly increased damage resistance from being in combat for an extended duration.
desc.zh: 传统防御被禁用，转而偏好进攻能力。处于战斗状态时，较长时间内获得大幅增加的伤害抗性。

desc.en: Increase Glimmer gains by 10% on Mercury.
desc.zh: 在水星的微光获取量提升10%。

desc.en: Dealing damage generates grenade energy.
desc.zh: 造成伤害会生成手雷能量。

desc.en: Adds a Shadow Legion drop pod apperance to your transmat effects.
desc.zh: 为你的传送效果添加一个暗影军团空降仓外观。

desc.en: Adds a data lattice appearance to your transmat effects.
desc.zh: 为你的传送效果添加一个数据晶格外观。

desc.en: Direct hits do increased damage to combatant shields and cause a volatile detonation. Dealing damage increases reload speed. Rapid final blows against grenade-damaged combatants refill the magazine.
desc.zh: 直接命中可对战斗人员的护盾造成更多伤害并引起不稳定爆炸。造成伤害会提高填装速度。对受到手雷伤害的战斗人员造成快速最后一击可填装弹匣。

desc.en: Dealing a portion of the magazine as precision damage grants this weapon bonus damage. The shot count is reset whenever the weapon is reloaded or stowed.
desc.zh: 弹匣内的部分弹药造成精准伤害后可赋予此武器额外伤害。在填装或是收起武器时重置命中数量。

desc.en:
Defeating a jolted target makes you amplified.

While you are amplified, your dodge recharges more quickly, you are more resilient while dodging, and your reload speed is greatly increased.
desc.zh:
击败一名震颤的目标会使你进入增幅状态。

在增幅状态下，你的闪身充能更快，闪身时韧性更高，填装速度大幅上升。

desc.en: Fires full auto with deeper ammo reserves. Faster reload when weapon is empty.
desc.zh: 可进行全自动射击并具有更多的弹药储备。弹匣打空时可提高填装速度。

desc.en: Improves rewards from eliminating Cabal enemies.
desc.zh: 消灭卡巴尔敌人时可获得更高品质的奖励。

desc.en: This transmat effect may be awarded in silver, gold, green, pink, or blue color variants.
desc.zh: 此传送效果可能出现银色、金色、绿色、粉色或蓝色变幻。

desc.en: Increases the amount of Sniper Rifle ammo you can carry.
desc.zh: 提高可携带的狙击步枪弹药数量。

desc.en: Rifts create beneficial seeker projectiles.
desc.zh: 裂痕可以产生增益追踪射弹。

desc.en: Greatly increased reload, stability, and handling when targets are in close proximity.
desc.zh: 附近有目标时，填装速度、稳定性和操控性均会大幅提高。

desc.en: Increases reload speed of Arc weapons.
desc.zh: 提高电弧武器的填装速度

desc.en: Reduces flinching from incoming fire while aiming Glaives.
desc.zh: 降低使用偃月瞄准时因受到伤害而产生的画面颤动。

desc.en: Sliding or standing up after crouching for a short time grants this weapon a brief period of bonus handling, reload speed, and damage against Hive combatants.
desc.zh: 下蹲一段时间后起身或者滑行会使此武器在短时间内提升操控性和填装速度，以及对邪魔族战斗人员的伤害。

desc.en: While Charged with Light, dealing damage with a Sword gives you bonus Sword damage for 5 seconds, consuming one stack of Charged with Light.
desc.zh: 充斥光能时，使用刀剑造成伤害可在5秒内获得额外的刀剑伤害加成，消耗一层光之充能。

desc.en: Detect resources within a 30-meter range while in the EDZ.

While this weapon is equipped, taking damage accelerates its next reload by an increased amount.

Taking more damage increases the effect.
desc.zh:
装备此武器时，受到伤害可进一步加速其下次填装。

受到更多伤害可提升此效果。

desc.en: Defeating combatants with grenade abilities increases this weapon's damage.
desc.zh: 用手雷技能消灭战斗人员会提升此武器的伤害。

desc.en: Adds an animating love appearance to your transmat effects.
desc.zh: 为你的传送效果添加一个赋生之爱外观。

desc.en: Defeating a Champion by using a finisher spawns Heavy ammo for you and your fireteam.
desc.zh: 使用终结技消灭勇士会为你和你的火力战队成员生成重型弹药。

desc.en: This weapon deals increased precision damage when near two or more allies.
desc.zh: 在两个或更多盟友身边时，武器造成的精准伤害增加。

desc.en: Grenades bounce. Delayed detonation.
desc.zh: 榴弹可弹跳。延迟引爆。

desc.en:
Activate your class ability to weave three Threadlings and deploy any Threadlings you have perched.

Dealing damage and defeating targets generates perched Threadlings.
desc.zh:
激活你的职业技能来编织三条线虫并部署任何你已息停的线虫。

造成伤害和击败目标将产生息停线虫。

desc.en: Final blows of energy types matching this weapon's alignment grant increased damage for an improved duration. Light final blows boost Arc, Solar, and Void weapons. Darkness final blows boost Stasis and Strand weapons.
desc.zh: 与此武器匹配能量类型的最后一击会提升伤害，持续时间延长。光能最后一击可提升电弧、烈日和虚空武器。暗影最后一击可提升冰影和缚丝武器。

desc.en: When this weapon's magazine is empty, it refills from reserves based on the number of hits.
desc.zh: 射空此武器的弹匣时，会根据命中次数从储存弹药中填装。

desc.en: Acquired armor pieces with randomized stats are more likely to drop with the Brawler archetype, which has Melee as its primary stat and Health as its secondary.
desc.zh: 获取的随机属性护甲更有可能掉落搏击手框架：近战为主要属性，生命值为次要属性。

desc.en: Picking up an Orb of Power grants a temporary strong bonus to weapon damage of the same elemental type as your subclass.
desc.zh: 拾取能量球会暂时大幅提升与你分支职业相同元素类型的武器伤害。

desc.en: Being near allies slowly builds up a partial emergency ammo refill for the next time this weapon runs out of ammo. Emergency ammo amount increases with time spent near allies.
desc.zh: 位于盟友附近时会慢慢积累部分紧急弹药，以备下次此武器弹药耗尽时使用。紧急弹药数量随着在盟友附近时间的增加而增加。

desc.en: [Alternate Weapon Action]  : When weapon is fully charged, consume charge before firing to make your next shot track targets across the ground, jolting them and unleashing chain lightning on impact.
desc.zh: [替换武器动作]  ：武器完全充能时，开火前消耗充能使你的下一次射击在地面上追踪目标，震颤目标并在命中后释放连锁闪电。

desc.en: Reduces incoming flinch for this weapon.
desc.zh: 为此武器减少受到的抖动。

desc.en: This weapon deals improved bonus damage to combatant shields and targets with overshields. Breaking a combatant's shield disorients them; breaking an energy-matched shield also disorients nearby combatants.
desc.zh: 此武器对战斗人员护盾和带有覆盖护盾的目标造成更多额外伤害。击破战斗人员的护盾会使其迷失方向，击破能量相匹配的护盾还会使附近的战斗人员迷失方向。

desc.en: Adds an inaugural appearance to your transmat effects.
desc.zh: 为你的传送效果添加一个初始外观。

desc.en:
[Grenade]  : Hold to summon a [Void] Void shield that draws hostile fire and blocks a portion of incoming damage, gradually draining your grenade energy and granting an Overshield over time.

Releasing the grenade input or running out of energy releases a frontal blast from your shield that disorients combatants and deals increased damage based on how much damage was blocked. Final blows with the frontal blast grant you Devour.

Combatants that come in contact with your shield are temporarily disoriented.
desc.zh:
[手雷]  ：长按以召唤一个虚空护盾，它可吸引敌人火力并抵挡一部分伤害，逐渐消耗你的手雷能量并赋予一个覆盖护盾。

释放手雷键或耗尽能量时，你的护盾会释放出正面冲击波，它使战斗人员迷失方向，并基于已抵挡的伤害量造成更高的伤害。正面冲击波造成的最后一击会为你提供吞食。

接触到你护盾的战斗人员会暂时迷失方向。

desc.en: After defeating a target, this weapon fires, charges, or draws more slowly and deals increased damage for an improved time.
desc.zh: 在击败目标后，此武器的射速、充能速度、拉弓速度都会减慢，但是会造成额外伤害，持续时间延长。

desc.en:
[Brake]  : Take to the air.
[Crouch]  : Grind the air.
desc.zh:
[刹车]  ：升空。
[蹲伏]  ：驭空。

desc.en: Sprinting increases vent or reload speed for a short time. While at low heat or full magazine, gain further increased handling and movement speed when aiming down sights.
desc.zh: 冲刺可在短时间内提升排气或填装速度。处于低热量或满弹匣时，瞄准可获得进一步提升的操控性和移动速度。

desc.en: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
desc.zh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

desc.en:
While sliding, activate your charged melee ability to leap into the air, knocking nearby targets away and dealing damage.

While airborne, activate your charged melee again to launch a cluster of damaging, unraveling projectiles. Repeatedly activating melee will chain additional throws.
desc.zh:
滑行时，激活你的充能近战技能可跃向空中，击退附近目标并造成伤害。

在空中时，再次激活你的充能近战来发射一连串可造成伤害的瓦解射弹。重复激活近战技能将连锁额外投掷。

desc.en:
Damaging a target with a Sword, Glaive, or any melee attack exhausts them. 

Exhausted targets deal reduced outgoing damage.
desc.zh:
使用刀剑、偃月或任意近战攻击伤害目标会使其疲惫。

疲惫的目标造成的伤害会减少。

desc.en: Blocking attacks with a Sword or Glaive grants a short period of damage resistance against targets when you next drop your guard.
desc.zh: 使用刀剑或偃月格挡攻击后，下次解除格挡时，会在短时间内获得针对目标的伤害抗性。

desc.en: Gain health based on the number of hits before reloading.
desc.zh: 根据填装之前完成的命中数恢复生命值。

desc.en:
Sustained damage from this weapon exhausts the target for a short duration.

Exhausted targets deal reduced outgoing damage.
desc.zh:
此武器的持续伤害会在短时间内使目标疲惫。

疲惫的目标造成的伤害会减少。

desc.en: Greatly increases target acquisition.
desc.zh: 大幅提升目标获取能力。

desc.en: Very low heat generated. [Reload]  to vent heat from the weapon. Overheating forces a sustained vent. Manually venting at very high heat greatly increases venting speed.
desc.zh: 极低热量积累。[填装]  以释放武器热量。过热将强制持续排气。在极高热量时手动排气将大幅提高排气速度。

desc.en: This weapon stores an improved portion of its damage dealt into charges. At 5 charges, the weapon's next shot creates an explosive blast on impact that damages nearby combatants.
desc.zh: 此武器会将造成伤害的更大一部分储存为能量。达到5次充能时，武器的下一发射击会在命中时产生爆炸冲击，对附近战斗人员造成伤害。

desc.en: Explosive rounds. Highlights targets.
desc.zh: 高爆弹药。高亮显示目标。

desc.en: Adds a Cabal hologram entrance to your transmat effects.
desc.zh: 为你的传送添加一个卡巴尔全息登场效果。

desc.en: Adds a crashing Warsat to your transmat effects.
desc.zh: 为你的传送添加一个坠毁的战争卫星效果。

desc.en: Adds a SIVA respawn to your transmat effects.
desc.zh: 为你的传送添加一个湿婆重生效果。

desc.en: Shattering a frozen target with a melee attack grants a stack of Frost Armor.
desc.zh: 使用近战攻击击碎一个被冻结的目标会赋予一层冰霜护甲。

desc.en: Damaging targets with a [Stasis] Stasis melee reloads your weapons and grants you a temporary boost to weapon ready speed.
desc.zh: 用冰影近战对目标造成伤害会为你填装武器，并使你在短时间内获得武器准备速度加成。

desc.en: Defeating targets while you have Frost Armor has a chance to create a [Stasis] Stasis shard.
desc.zh: 拥有冰霜护甲时击败目标，有几率生成一块冰影碎片。

desc.en: You gain grenade energy each time you take damage from targets. Having Frost Armor increases the amount of energy gained.
desc.zh: 每次受到目标的伤害时获得手雷能量。拥有冰霜护甲会获得更多的能量。

desc.en: Stunning a Champion vents heat from this weapon.
desc.zh: 眩晕勇士可为此武器散热。

desc.en: Greatly increases reload speed and handling.
desc.zh: 大幅提升填装速度和操控性。

desc.en: Rapidly defeating combatants with [Solar] Solar or [Stasis] Stasis melee attacks creates an Orb of Power for your fireteam members.
desc.zh: 使用烈日或冰影近战攻击快速消灭战斗人员会为你的火力战队成员生成一个能量球。

desc.en: Detect caches or resources within a 30-meter range while on Io.
desc.zh: 在木卫一上探测30米范围内的缓存箱或资源。

desc.en: Adds a Guardian Games crest appearance to your transmat effects.
desc.zh: 为你的传送效果添加一个守护者游戏纹章外观。

desc.en: Increase Glimmer gains by 10% in the Crucible.
desc.zh: 在熔炉竞技场的微光获取量提升10%。

n.zh: 熔炉竞技场微光回收利用

desc.en: Faster movement while invisible.
desc.zh: 隐形时移速加快。

desc.en: Fires a hard-hitting, two-round burst. Slightly reduces flinching from incoming fire while aiming.
desc.zh: 发射威力巨大的两发点射。降低瞄准时因受到伤害而产生的画面抖动。

desc.en: This weapon has increased range and handling for the top half of the magazine, while rounds from the bottom half of the magazine deal increased damage.
desc.zh: 此武器增加了前半弹匣的射程和操控性，而后半弹匣的弹药能造成更大的伤害。

desc.en: Highlights nearby loot caches on the moon of Saturn for you and your fireteam.
desc.zh: 为你和你的火力战队在土卫六上标记出位于附近的战利品缓存箱。

desc.en: Adds a vision of Xol to your transmat effects.
desc.zh: 为你的传送效果添加一个尸飕幻象。

desc.en: Adds pixelation to your transmat effects.
desc.zh: 为你的传送效果添加一个像素效果。

desc.en: Adds a Warmind flourish to your transmat effects.
desc.zh: 为你的传送效果添加一个战争思维花样。

desc.en: Adds a fireworks burst to your transmat effects.
desc.zh: 为你的传送效果添加一个放烟花的效果。

desc.en: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
desc.zh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

desc.en: Highlights nearby loot caches on Mars for you and your fireteam.
desc.zh: 为你和你的火力战队在火星上标记出位于附近的战利品缓存箱。

desc.en: Omega Strike hits blind combatants. Defeating combatants with Omega Strike causes them to explode.
desc.zh: 欧米伽打击命中时致盲战斗人员。被欧米伽打击击败的战斗人员会爆炸。

desc.en: Applying restoration, cure, or radiant to allies grants increased grenade, melee, and class ability regeneration for a short duration.
desc.zh: 对盟友施加恢复、治愈或焕光效果可在短时间内提升手雷、近战和职业技能的回复能力。

desc.en: Rapidly improves accuracy and stability while continuously holding down the trigger.
desc.zh: 持续按住扳机可快速提升精度和稳定性。

desc.en: Armor Set—Collector +3
desc.zh: 护甲套装——收集者+3

desc.en:
Scout Rifles you are wielding fire shield-piercing rounds and stun [Shield-Piercing] Barrier Champions.

Scout Rifles deal bonus damage against [Shield-Piercing] Barrier Champions.
desc.zh:
你使用的斥候步枪可发射屏障穿刺子弹，眩晕屏障勇士。

斥候步枪对屏障勇士造成额外伤害。

desc.en:
Sustained damage from this weapon exhausts the target for a short duration.

Exhausted targets deal reduced outgoing damage.
desc.zh:
此武器的持续伤害会在短时间内使目标疲惫。

疲惫的目标造成的伤害会减少。

desc.en: Being in combat for an extended time increases damage, handling, and reload for this weapon for an improved duration until you are out of combat.
desc.zh: 长时间处于战斗状态会提升此武器的伤害、操控性和填装速度，持续直到脱离战斗，持续时间延长。

desc.en: Grenades attach on impact; detonate when enemies are close.
desc.zh: 碰撞后会黏住的榴弹；敌人接近后引爆。

desc.en: Extends the duration of String of Curses.
desc.zh: 延长诅咒之绳的持续时间。

desc.en: Kinetic weapons get bonus reserves when picking up ammo used by that weapon.
desc.zh: 拾取该动能武器所用弹药时，获得额外弹药储量。

desc.en: Collapses targets into spheres of Void energy.
desc.zh: 将目标瓦解为虚空能量球。

desc.en: Hammers shatter into explosive molten embers on impact.
desc.zh: 战锤会在命中后碎裂成会爆炸的熔合余烬。

desc.en: This weapon gains bonus damage while in combat for an extended time, activating faster. Remaining in combat for a slightly reduced duration rewards a larger damage bonus and periodically heals the wielder.
desc.zh: 长时间处于战斗状态会使此武器获得额外伤害，激活速度更快。战斗状态的时间稍有缩短，会使此武器获得更大的额外伤害，并周期性治疗使用者。

desc.en: Pick up Orbs of Power to overcharge your Super.
desc.zh: 拾取能量球来过载充能你的超能。

desc.en: Dealing ranged damage grants substantially increased weapon energy while you're stationary with your shield raised.
desc.zh: 保持不动举起护盾时造成远程伤害可提供大幅增加的武器能量。

desc.en: Häkke weapons deal overcharged damage in Ops activities.
desc.zh: Häkke武器在行动活动中造成过充伤害。

desc.en: Nova Bomb creates a singularity which continually damages enemies trapped inside. Kills with Nova Bomb grant the Devour effect.
desc.zh: 新星炸弹 可产生一个奇点，对困在其中的敌人造成 持续性伤害 。用 新星炸弹 击杀敌人可获得 吞噬 效果。

desc.en: Elemental final blows opposite this weapon increase damage for an improved duration. Darkness final blows boost Arc, Solar, and Void weapons. Light final blows boost Stasis, Strand, and Kinetic weapons.
desc.zh: 与此武器相克的元素最后一击会在更长的时间内提升伤害。暗影最后一击强化电弧、烈日和虚空武器。光能最后一击强化冰影、缚丝和动能武器。

desc.en: Increased Glimmer and chance to obtain additional faction consumables on Mercury.
desc.zh: 增加微光获取量并有机会在水星上获得额外的阵营消耗品。

desc.en: Damage with this weapon generates an improved amount of ability energy for the one closest to a full charge.
desc.zh: 使用此武器造成伤害，会为最接近完全充能的技能生成更多技能能量。

desc.en: Increases the amount of Pulse Rifle ammo you can carry.
desc.zh: 提高可携带的脉冲步枪弹药数量。

desc.en: Activate to teleport during Stormtrance.
desc.zh: 在雷霆万钧期间激活传送。

desc.en:
While Stasis empowered:
- Stasis Supers have extended durations.
- Defeated combatants spawn Stasis mines.

On PRISM Day, Stasis empowerment is applied while using a Stasis subclass.
desc.zh:
在冰影赋能期间：
-延长冰影超能的持续时间。
-被消灭的战斗人员会生成冰影地雷。

在棱镜日，使用冰影分支职业时会应用冰影赋能。

desc.en:
Rapid final blows cause targets to explode into a pool of radiolarian fluid.

Hip firing launches multiple projectiles at once in a slower moving spread pattern. Projectiles detonate on impact.
desc.zh:
快速最后一击将使目标爆炸成一摊活性放射体液。

腰射可同时散射多个低速射弹。射弹将在命中时引爆。

desc.en:
Grenades recharge faster when using an Arc subclass.
  •  Stacks up to 3 times
desc.zh:
使用电弧分支职业时手雷技能的充能速度提高。
  •  最高可叠加3次

desc.en: +10 Accuracy
desc.zh: +10精准

desc.en: Adds colorful Motes to your transmat effects.
desc.zh: 为你的传送效果添加多彩萤光。

desc.en:
Glaives you wield fire a powerful explosive payload that stuns unshielded combatants.

Strong against [Stagger] Unstoppable Champions.
desc.zh:
你的偃月可发射一枚高爆载荷，眩晕没有护盾的战斗人员。

克制势不可挡勇士。

desc.en: This item comes with randomized perks, as well as an extra perk in a random trait column.
desc.zh: 此物品自带随机特性和随机特性栏的一个额外特性。

desc.en: Your Void weapons gain a small bonus to damage while you have any Armor Charge. Your Armor Charge now decays over time.
desc.zh: 在拥有任何护甲充能时，你的虚空武器会获得小幅额外伤害加成。你的护甲充能现在会逐渐衰减。

desc.en: Grants increased reload speed and handling.
desc.zh: 提高填装速度和操控性。

desc.en: Greatly increases reload speed of Submachine Guns.
desc.zh: 大幅提高微型冲锋枪的填装速度。

n.zh: 强化型微型冲锋枪装填装置

desc.en: Defeating a Lucent Hive Lightbearer or Champion with your finisher spawns Heavy ammo for you and your allies.
desc.zh: 使用终结技消灭光明邪魔族负光者或勇士会为你和你的盟友生成重型弹药。

desc.en: Causing damage with a Solar ability weakens Champions for a short duration.
desc.zh: 使用烈日技能造成伤害可以弱化勇士一小段时间。

desc.en: Increases the effect of all contributions towards the Heavy ammo meter.
desc.zh: 提升对重型弹药量表的所有计入效果。

desc.en: Adds a Dawning sigil to your transmat effects.
desc.zh: 为你的传送效果添加一个曙光节印记外观。

desc.en: Blocking damage partially reloads this weapon from reserves.
desc.zh: 阻挡伤害可从储备弹药中部分填装此武器。

desc.en: Increases your chance of finding Heavy ammo while you have a Machine Gun equipped.
desc.zh: 装备机枪后，提高你找到重型武器弹药的机会。

desc.en: Grants additional Super energy on Energy or Power Grenade Launcher final blows.
desc.zh: 能量或威能榴弹发射器最后一击将获得额外超能能量。

desc.en: When the battery is full, your next burst deals additional damage and causes enemies to explode on death.
desc.zh: 电池满能时，下一次冲击将造成额外伤害并使敌人在死亡时爆炸。

desc.en: Acquired armor pieces with randomized stats are more likely to drop with the Colossus archetype, which has Super as its primary stat and Health as its secondary.
desc.zh: 获取的随机属性护甲更有可能掉落装甲兵框架：超能为主要属性，生命值为次要属性。

desc.en: Grenade final blows cure you. Transcendence grenade final blows increase the strength of the effect.
desc.zh: 手雷最后一击会治愈你。超凡手雷最后一击可提升效果强度。

desc.en: +5 Health ▲ / -5 Super ▼
desc.zh: +5 生命值 ▲ /-5 超能 ▼

desc.en:
Cast your Rift to create an Arc Soul that fires at targets in front of you. Allies can pass through your Rift to get an Arc Soul. Your Rift charges faster when allies are near.

While amplified, your Arc Souls are supercharged and gain increased fire rate.

Arc Soul damage is scaled by the enhanced benefit of the Grenade stat.
desc.zh:
施放你的裂痕以产生一个能射击你前方目标的电弧之魂。盟友可以穿过你的裂痕来获得一个电弧之魂。附近有盟友时你的裂痕充能更快。

在增幅状态下，你的电弧之魂会获得超级充能，射速更快。

电弧之魂的伤害会根据手雷属性强化增益进行调整。

desc.en: When your class ability energy is fully expended, your Armor Charge is consumed and you gain class ability energy for each Armor Charge used.
desc.zh: 在职业技能能量完全耗尽时，你的护甲充能会被消耗，每一层被消耗的护甲充能都会赋予你额外的职业技能能量。

desc.en: Builds energy to fire explosive, weakening rounds.
desc.zh: 积累能量以发射爆炸性的削弱弹药。

desc.en: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
desc.zh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

desc.en: Shows critical information in scope. Strong against [Disruption] Overload Champions.

desc.zh: 武器最后一击会造成额外伤害。近战和手雷最后一击会造成更多额外伤害，而且可叠加。

desc.en: Readying this weapon grants it bonus stability, handling, and reload speed for an improved duration that is borrowed from an alternate timeline version of the weapon. Swords gain bonus charge rate and guard resistance.
desc.zh: 武器准备就绪后一段时间内可获得稳定性、操控性和填装速度加成，取自武器在另一个时间线的版本，持续时间延长。刀剑可获得充能速度和防御抗性加成。

desc.en: Reduces the activation time of Tesseract.
desc.zh: 减少四维超正方体激活时间。

desc.en: While you are airborne, sustained damage and final blows with this weapon to difficult combatants grant a Void overshield, reduce combatant accuracy, and return ammo to the magazine.
desc.zh: 当你在空中时，使用此武器对强大的战斗人员造成持续伤害和最后一击，会获得虚空护盾，降低战斗人员的精度，并将弹药返回弹匣。

desc.en: Increases the lifespan of elemental wells you create. Multiple copies of this mod stack, further extending the lifespan.
desc.zh: 延长你创造出的元素井的寿命。多个此模组可以叠加，进一步延长元素井的寿命。

desc.en: Picking up a Void elemental well grants you additional class ability energy. Multiple copies of this mod increase this effect.
desc.zh: 拾取一个虚空元素井会赋予你额外的职业技能能量。多个此模组会增强此效果。

desc.en: Shortly after using your class ability, your next weapon final blow spawns an Orb of Power.
desc.zh: 在使用你的职业技能后的短时间内，你的下一次武器最后一击会生成一个能量球。

desc.en: Rapidly landing precision hits will return two rounds to the magazine.
desc.zh: 快速精准命中目标会向弹匣里返还两枚弹药。

desc.en: Improves duration, damage, and durability of Void Souls.
desc.zh: 提升虚空灵魂的持续时间、伤害和耐久度。

desc.en: Damaging unraveled targets with a weapon occasionally spawns a threadling.
desc.zh: 用武器伤害被瓦解的目标有时会产生一个线虫。

desc.en:
Shattering frozen targets and Stasis crystals deals increased damage.

Shattering Stasis crystals releases shards of ice that damage and slow targets.
desc.zh:
击碎被冻结目标和冰影水晶会造成更多伤害。

击碎冰影水晶会释放出伤害并减慢目标速度的冰影碎片。

desc.en: While radiant, Solar precision final blows cause combatants to ignite.
desc.zh: 拥有焕光效果时，烈日精准最后一击可点燃战斗人员。

desc.en: While you are the only member of your fireteam, precision weapon final blows increase weapon damage until you are defeated.
desc.zh: 当你是火力战队的唯一成员时，精准武器最后一击会提升武器伤害，直至你被击败。

desc.en: Firing a Rocket Launcher consumes one stack of Armor Charge, granting increased damage and reload speed until you reload or stow your Rocket Launcher.
desc.zh: 发射火箭发射器会消耗一层护甲充能，在你填装或收起火箭发射器前可提升伤害和填装速度。

desc.en: Fires small auto-tracking rockets.
desc.zh: 发射自动追踪的小型火箭。

desc.en: Picking up an Orb of Power grants a temporary strong bonus to weapon damage of the same elemental type as your subclass.
desc.zh: 拾取能量球会暂时大幅提升与你分支职业相同元素类型的武器伤害。

desc.en: This weapon deals bonus damage to combatant shields and targets with overshields. Breaking a combatant's shield disorients them; breaking an energy-matched shield also disorients nearby combatants.
desc.zh: 此武器对战斗人员护盾和带有覆盖护盾的目标造成额外伤害。击破战斗人员的护盾会使其迷失方向，击破能量相匹配的护盾还会使附近的战斗人员迷失方向。

desc.en: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
desc.zh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

desc.en: Gain 10% more XP while in the Dreaming City.
desc.zh: 在幽梦之城中获取10%的额外经验值。

desc.en: Duskfield grenades have a larger effect and reduce the damage that allies take.
desc.zh: 使暮域手雷的影响范围增加，并使盟友获得伤害减免。

desc.en: Improves your Shield Throw melee.
desc.zh: 提升圣盾投掷近战能力。

desc.en: After activating Harbinger's Pulse multiple times, [Alternate Weapon Action]  to cause a rain of projectiles on your next direct hit with this weapon.
desc.zh: 多次激活预兆脉动后，[替换武器动作] 以在下次使用此武器直接命中时造成射弹雨。

desc.en: Greatly reduces flinching from incoming fire while aiming Fusion Rifles.
desc.zh: 大幅降低使用融合步枪瞄准时因受到伤害而产生的画面颤动。

n.zh: 强化型稳定融合步枪瞄准

desc.en: After not taking damage for a short duration, this weapon gains significantly increased aim down sight speed, handling and flinch resistance until the next shot is fired. Activates faster.
desc.zh: 短时间内未受伤害后，此武器会获得显著提升的瞄准速度、操控性与抖动抗性，效果持续至下一次射击。激活速度更快。

desc.en:
After suppressing a target, you gain increased weapon stat for a short duration, and your equipped weapon is reloaded from reserves.

Defeating suppressed targets creates a Void Breach.
desc.zh:
压制目标后，你的武器属性会在短时间内提升，并用储存弹药填装当前装备的武器。

击败被压制的目标会生成一个虚空裂口。

desc.en: Stunning a Champion creates an explosive blast.
desc.zh: 眩晕一名勇士会造成一次爆炸。

desc.en: Adds the illusion of a sandcastle to your transmat effects.
desc.zh: 为你的传送效果添加沙堡的幻象。

desc.en: Adds the illusion of a beach ball to your transmat effects.
desc.zh: 为你的传送效果添加沙滩球的幻象。

desc.en: Detect caches within a 40-meter range while on Nessus.
desc.zh: 在涅索斯上探测40米范围内的缓存箱。

n.zh: 增强版涅索斯缓存箱探测器

desc.en: Increases this armor's recovery, allowing you to recover health faster.
desc.zh: 提高这件护甲的恢复值，以提高你的生命值恢复速度。

desc.en: Precision final blows while aiming down sights grant damage resistance until you stop aiming down sights.
desc.zh: 瞄准时造成精准最后一击会提供伤害抗性，直至你停止瞄准。

desc.en:
Precision final blows with any weapon grant a stacking bonus to reload speed, target acquisition, and weapon damage against non-boss combatants for a short duration.

Weapon final blows with non-precision direct hits end this effect early.
desc.zh:
使用任意武器造成精准最后一击会提供可叠加的增益，在短时间内提升填装速度、目标捕获能力以及对非首领战斗人员造成的武器伤害。

造成非精准直接命中的武器最后一击将提前结束此效果。

desc.en: Increases the ammo generation of Void weapons.
desc.zh: 提升虚空武器的弹药生成速度。

desc.en:
Dealing melee damage gives this weapon increased target acquisition and range for a short period of time.
Dealing melee damage again extends the effect.
desc.zh:
造成近战伤害会使此武器的目标捕获能力和射程在短时间内提升。
再次造成近战伤害可延长此效果。

desc.en: Picking up an Orb of Power grants a temporary strong bonus to weapon damage of the same elemental type as your subclass.
desc.zh: 拾取能量球会暂时大幅提升与你分支职业相同元素类型的武器伤害。

desc.en: Adds a tower of presents to your transmat effects.
desc.zh: 为你的传送效果添加一个礼物塔。

desc.en: Highlights nearby loot caches on Nessus for you and your fireteam.
desc.zh: 为你和你的火力战队在涅索斯上标记出位于附近的战利品缓存箱。

desc.en: Adds additional Solar damage to the explosions of Warmind Cells you destroy.
desc.zh: 为你摧毁的战争思维电池的爆炸效果增加额外的烈日伤害。

desc.en: Enrages when dealing or sustaining damage.
desc.zh: 在造成伤害或受到伤害时发怒。

desc.en: After using your class ability, final blows with this weapon grant you bonus damage resistance.
desc.zh: 使用你的职业技能后，使用此武器造成最后一击可获得额外的伤害抗性。

desc.en: [Solar]Solar final blows grant Burning Souls. Dodge applies Cure.
desc.zh: 烈日最后一击提供燃烧之魂。闪身施加治愈。

desc.en: Fully automatic, slow-firing slug launcher with a charge time.
desc.zh: 需要充能时间的全自动、低射速重弹发射器。

desc.en: Half mag bonus damage and regens health.
desc.zh: 后半部分弹夹造成更高伤害并可触发生命回复。

desc.en: Create a Sunspot when critically wounded or on Barricade cast.
desc.zh: 在重伤或释放屏障时生成一个太阳黑子。

desc.en: This weapon loads an increased amount of ammo from reserves when dealing damage to targets that are slowed, frozen, or suspended.
desc.zh: 此武器在对被减速、冻结或悬停的目标造成伤害时，会从备弹中填装弹匣，填装弹药数量提升。

desc.en: +5 Grenade ▲
desc.zh: +5 手雷 ▲

desc.en: +3 Grenade ▲
desc.zh: +3 手雷 ▲

desc.en: Gradually reloads your stowed Arc weapons over time.
desc.zh: 逐渐填装你已收起的电弧武器。

desc.en: Improves the effect of the Soul Drinker and Hot Swap weapon Origin perks.
desc.zh: 强化“饮魂者”和“热切换”武器原有特性的效果。

desc.en: Machine Guns get bonus reserves when you pick up ammo.
desc.zh: 拾取弹药时机枪获得额外弹药储量。

desc.en: Increases reload speed of Glaives.
desc.zh: 提高偃月的填装速度。

desc.en: Grants class ability energy when you cause damage with a powered melee attack.
desc.zh: 使用充能近战攻击造成伤害时获得职业技能能量。

desc.en: When firing from the hip, this weapon shoots in full auto and damage and rate of fire are increased, but accuracy and range are decreased.
desc.zh: 腰射时，此武器以全自动模式射击，提升伤害和射速，但降低精度和射程。

desc.en: Reloading near allies overflows the magazine. Bows receive faster draw time and Swords receive faster charge rate.
desc.zh: 在盟友附近填装会过量填充弹匣。弓箭的开弓速度和刀剑的充能速度会加快。

desc.en: Targeting system
desc.zh: 瞄准系统

desc.en: Picking up an Orb of Power increases the next projectile's blast radius and damage.
desc.zh: 拾取能量球会增加下一枚射弹的爆炸范围和伤害。

desc.en: Increases reload speed of Fusion Rifles.
desc.zh: 提高融合步枪的填装速度。

desc.en: Rapidly defeating combatants with Stasis weapons creates a Stasis mine that damages and freezes nearby combatants.
desc.zh: 使用冰影武器快速击败战斗人员可生成冰影地雷，它能伤害并冻结附近的战斗人员。

desc.en:
Performing a finisher while you are amplified grants Amplified to nearby allies. 

Performing a finisher while you have Woven Mail grants Woven Mail to nearby allies. 

Performing a finisher while you have Devour grants Devour to nearby allies.
desc.zh:
在增幅状态下发动终结技可为附近盟友提供增幅状态。

拥有织造铠甲时发动终结技可为附近盟友提供织造铠甲。

在吞食状态下发动终结技可为附近盟友提供吞食状态。

desc.en: After throwing an Arc grenade, gain increased grenade recharge for a short time. Arc final blows extend the duration of this benefit.
desc.zh: 投掷电弧手雷后，短时间内手雷充能速度加快。电弧最后一击会延长此增益的持续时间。

desc.en: Arc final blows while you are amplified summon a burst of lightning that damages and jolts targets.
desc.zh: 处于增幅状态时造成电弧最后一击可召唤出一道闪电，伤害并震颤目标。

desc.en: Picking up a Void Breach causes your next source of Void damage to create a large weakening pulse.
desc.zh: 拾取虚空裂口可让你的下一次虚空伤害来源生成一次大型的削弱脉冲。

desc.en: Targets affected by Strand debuffs take increased damage from Arc and Void abilities.
desc.zh: 受缚丝减益效果影响的目标会受到更高的电弧和虚空技能伤害。

desc.en: Air dodge reloads weapons. Fusion Rifle and Linear Fusion Rifle final blows make you radiant.
desc.zh: 空中闪避可重新填装武器。融合步枪和线性融合步枪最后一击将使你获得焕光效果。

desc.en:
Thanks to you, all players will receive a gift upon completing this activity.

No gifts will be awarded if you leave the activity early.
desc.zh:
多亏了你，所有玩家将在完成此活动后获得一件礼物。

如果你提前离开活动，礼物将会消失哦。

desc.en: Increases your chances of finding Heavy ammo while you have a Bow equipped that uses Heavy ammo.
desc.zh: 装备使用重型弹药的弓箭后，提高你找到重型弹药的机会。

desc.en: [Brake]  : Brake and corner more aggressively.
desc.zh: [刹车]  ：使用刹车或急转弯。

desc.en: Reloading after dealing a final blow grants Cure to you and your nearby allies. You have additional time to perform the reload.
desc.zh: 最后一击后填装，可为自身和附近盟友提供治愈。你有额外的时间来进行填装。

desc.en: Applies a gold crown aura.
desc.zh: 增加一个金色头冠光环。

desc.en: When targets are nearby, final blows grant an improved amount of bonus Melee stat.
desc.zh: 当目标在附近时，最后一击会赋予更多的近战属性加成。

desc.en: Rapid final blows with a Kinetic weapon or a weapon matching your equipped Super create an Elemental pickup that matches your equipped Super.
desc.zh: 使用动能武器或与已装备超能匹配的武器造成快速最后一击，可生成一个与已装备超能匹配的元素拾取物。

desc.en: Stasis final blows against slowed or frozen targets release a burst that slows combatants and grants Frost Armor to allies caught in the blast.
desc.zh: 对被减速或被冻结的目标造成冰影最后一击会释放可减速战斗人员的冲击波，并为范围内的盟友赋予冰霜护甲。

desc.en: Destroying a Tangle with a Strand weapon creates a larger and more damaging explosion.
desc.zh: 使用缚丝武器摧毁缠结可造成更大、伤害更高的爆炸。

desc.en: Breaking a combatant's shield grants increased weapon stability, handling, and reload speed. Swords gain increased guard resistance.
desc.zh: 打破战斗人员的护盾可以提高武器的稳定性、操控性和填装速度。刀剑可获得更高的防御抗性。

desc.en: Continuously damaging combatants or healing allies with an Auto Rifle grants you damage resistance.
desc.zh: 使用自动步枪持续对战斗人员造成伤害或治疗盟友可提供伤害抗性。

desc.en: Solar Sniper Rifle precision hits scorch targets.
desc.zh: 烈日狙击步枪精准命中可灼烧目标。

desc.en: Improved Skip Grenade.
desc.zh: 弹跳手雷效果更强。

desc.en: Become Charged with Light by defeating combatants with Void melee abilities.
desc.zh: 使用虚空近战技能消灭战斗人员来充斥光能。

desc.en: Gradually reloads your stowed Shotguns over time. Multiple copies of this perk stack to reduce the time taken to fully reload.
desc.zh: 随着时间推移，逐渐为已收起的霰弹枪装填弹药。此特性的效果可以叠加，以缩短完全重新装弹的耗时。

desc.en: Increases the duration of the Psychohack Origin Trait and the effect of the Extrovert Origin Trait.
desc.zh: 增加“心灵骇入”原始特征的持续时间，并强化“外向”原始特征的效果。

desc.en: Increases your chance of finding Special ammo while you have a Trace Rifle equipped.
desc.zh: 装备追踪步枪后，提高你找到特殊弹药的机会。

desc.en: Gradually reloads your stowed Sidearms over time. Multiple copies of this perk stack to reduce the time taken to fully reload.
desc.zh: 随着时间推移，逐渐为已收起的手枪装填弹药。此特性的效果可以叠加，以缩短完全重新装弹的耗时。

desc.en: Improved target acquisition, accuracy, and aim-down-sights speed for Pulse Rifles.
desc.zh: 改善脉冲步枪的目标捕获能力、精度和瞄准速度。

desc.en: Causing damage with a grenade reduces your melee cooldown.
desc.zh: 使用手雷造成伤害可缩短近战技能的冷却时间。

desc.en: Massively improves weapon target acquisition at the cost of weapon range.
desc.zh: 以牺牲武器射程为代价，大幅提升武器的目标获取能力。

desc.en: Improved handling and reload speed when allies are nearby.
desc.zh: 友军在附近时，提高操控性和填装速度。

desc.en: Improved Fist of Havoc. Arc final blows grant a weapon damage bonus.
desc.zh: 改进浩劫之拳。电弧最后一击会提供武器伤害加成。

desc.en: Reloading after a final blow or becoming amplified grants a period of increased damage. Stacks 5x.
desc.zh: 在最后一击或进入增幅状态后填装，会获得一段时间的伤害提升。最多叠加5层。

desc.en: While in full auto mode, final blows or rapid hits with this weapon grant bonus damage, accuracy, and stability for a short duration.
desc.zh: 在全自动模式下，使用此武器达成最后一击或快速命中会奖励持续一小段时间的额外伤害、精度和稳定性。

desc.en: Deal damage with all equipped weapons within a short time to give this weapon a damage boost for an improved duration.
desc.zh: 在短时间内使用所有已装备的武器造成伤害可为此武器提供伤害加成，持续时间延长。

desc.en: Maximizes quiver size.
desc.zh: 最大化箭袋容量。

desc.en:
Collecting an Elemental pickup or destroying a Tangle grants this weapon a stacking period of grenade energy generation on hit. Throwing a Tangle provides additional time.

Elemental pickups include [Solar]Firesprites, [Void]Void Breaches, [Arc]Ionic Traces, [Stasis]Stasis Shards, and [Strand]Strand Tangles.
desc.zh:
收集一个元素拾取物或摧毁缠结会赋予此武器一段叠加期，期间命中时生成手雷能量。投掷缠结会延长持续时间。

元素拾取物包括焰灵、虚空裂口、离子轨迹、冰影碎片和缚丝缠结。

desc.en: Better target acquisition.
desc.zh: 更易捕获目标。

desc.en: Generate Gunsmith telemetry data on any elemental weapon kills at an increased rate.
desc.zh: 在任意元素武器远距离击杀时以更快的速度生成枪匠遥测数据。

desc.en: Activating Void class abilities grants an overshield. Increases cooldown of your class ability.
desc.zh: 激活虚空职业技能将获得覆盖护盾。增加你的职业技能冷却时间。

desc.en: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
desc.zh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

desc.en: Increases your chance of finding Heavy ammo while you have a Rocket Launcher equipped.
desc.zh: 装备火箭发射器后，提高你找到重型武器弹药的机会。

n.zh: 火箭发射器弹药搜寻者

desc.en: +3 Melee
desc.zh: +3 近战

desc.en: Rapid precision hits temporarily increase stability and reload speed.
desc.zh: 快速精准命中目标会暂时提高稳定性和填装速度。

desc.en: Rapidly defeating targets with Light damage grants melee energy. Rapidly defeating targets with Darkness damage grants grenade energy.
desc.zh: 使用光能伤害快速击败目标会提供近战能量。使用暗影伤害快速击败目标会提供手雷能量。

desc.en: Super final blows emit a suspending burst from the target.
desc.zh: 超能最后一击会从目标身上爆发出悬停脉冲。

desc.en: Landing rapid precision hits emits a severing blast from the target. While transcendent, the severing blast is bigger.
desc.zh: 造成快速精准命中会从目标身上爆发出割裂爆炸。处于超凡状态时，割裂爆炸威力更大。

desc.en: Detect caches within a 30-meter range while on Mercury.
desc.zh: 在水星上探测30米范围内的缓存箱。

desc.en: Arc melee abilities stagger unshielded combatants. Strong against Unstoppable Champions.
desc.zh: 电弧近战技能可 眩晕 无护盾的战斗人员。擅长对抗势不可挡的勇士。

desc.en: Adds an Awoken pointillistic appearance to your transmat effects.
desc.zh: 为你的传送效果添加一个觉醒者点彩外观。

desc.en: Adds a cannon appearance to your transmat effects.
desc.zh: 为你的传送效果添加一个大炮外观。

desc.en: This weapon deals bonus damage to suspended targets. Gain faster draw time for a short duration when you suspend a target from any source or damage a suspended target with this weapon.
desc.zh: 此武器会对被悬停目标造成额外伤害。当你通过任意来源悬停目标或使用此武器对被悬停的目标造成伤害时，可在短时间内获得更快的拔枪速度。

desc.en: Your Dragonfly, Chain Reaction, and Firefly explosions deal more damage.
desc.zh: 提高蜻蜓、连锁反应和萤火虫爆炸所造成的伤害。

desc.en: Grants slightly increased ammo generation.
desc.zh: 小幅提升弹药生成速度。

desc.en: Picking up an Orb of Power grants a temporary strong bonus to weapon damage of the same elemental type as your subclass.
desc.zh: 拾取能量球会暂时大幅提升与你分支职业相同元素类型的武器伤害。

desc.en: +10 Grenade ▲
Rapidly defeating targets while you are amplified creates an Orb of Power.
desc.zh: 在增幅状态下快速击败目标可产生能量球。

desc.en: Aiming down sights loads a high-impact burst that stuns unshielded combatants. Strong against [Stagger]  Unstoppable Champions.
desc.zh: 举枪瞄准会装载一梭强力爆破弹药，可眩晕无护盾的战斗人员。克制势不可挡勇士。

desc.en: Greatly increases the chances of finding Heavy ammo while you have the Voltaic Overflow buff. Multiple copies of this mod stack to increase this benefit.
desc.zh: 大幅提高你在拥有电流丰盈增益时找到重型弹药的几率。此模组可叠加以增强效果。

desc.en: Adds a blue Guardian crest to your transmat effects.
desc.zh: 为你的传送效果添加一个蓝色守护者纹章。

desc.en: Completing a clan vendor challenge awards Enhancement Cores.
desc.zh: 完成公会商人挑战将会获得强化核心。

desc.en: Dealing damage to a combatant with a Fusion Rifle or Linear Fusion Rifle grants bonus damage with a Fusion Rifle or Linear Fusion Rifle against that combatant for a short duration. This effect stacks up to 5 times.
desc.zh: 使用融合步枪或线性融合步枪对某个战斗人员造成伤害后，在一小段时间内使用融合步枪或线性融合步枪会对该战斗人员造成额外伤害。此效果最高可叠加5次。

desc.en: Increases your chance of finding Primary ammo while you have a Scout Rifle equipped.
desc.zh: 装备斥候步枪后，提高你找到主武器弹药的机会。

desc.en: Increases reload speed of Glaives.
desc.zh: 提高偃月的填装速度。

desc.en: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
desc.zh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

desc.en: When aiming down sights, weapon rate of fire slows while weapon damage increases. Final blows while aiming down sights grant bonus Heavy ammo progress. [Alternate Weapon Action]  to swap to Spinning Up.
desc.zh: 瞄准时武器射速会降低，但伤害会提高。瞄准时造成最后一击可提供额外重型弹药进度。[替换武器动作] 切换至旋转直上。

desc.en: Improved target acquisition, accuracy, and aim down sights speed for Machine Guns.
desc.zh: 改善机枪的目标捕获能力、精度和瞄准速度。

desc.en: +5 Grenade ▲ / -5 Melee ▼
This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
desc.zh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

desc.en: Reloading after defeating a target grants increased damage for an improved duration.
desc.zh: 消灭目标后填装可提高武器伤害力，持续时间延长。

desc.en: Greatly improved target acquisition, accuracy, and aim-down-sights speed for Fusion Rifles.
desc.zh: 大幅改善融合步枪的目标锁定能力、精度和瞄准速度。

n.zh: 强化型融合步枪瞄准性能

desc.en: Spark of Intellect
desc.zh: 智慧火花

desc.en: Increases magazine size. Final blows with Wolfpack Rounds spawn a faster, more powerful micro-missile at the target's location.
desc.zh: 提高弹匣容量。使用狼群弹药对目标造成最后一击时，会在目标附近生成更快、更强大的微型导弹。

desc.en: Rapid final blows cause targets to explode into a pool of radiolarian fluid. Duration of pool is increased.
desc.zh: 快速最后一击将使目标爆炸成一摊活性放射体液，活性放射体液持续时间延长。

desc.en: Adds a silver Dawning lantern to your transmat effects.
desc.zh: 为你的传送效果添加一个银色曙光灯笼。

desc.en: Sustained damage spawns Threadlings.
desc.zh: 持续伤害会生成线虫。

desc.en: Landing rapid precision hits emits a severing burst from the target.
desc.zh: 造成快速精准命中会从目标身上爆发出割裂脉冲。

desc.en: Sliding collects nearby ammo and temporarily grants enhanced reload speed and handling to your weapons.
desc.zh: 滑行会收集附近的弹药，并在短时间内为你的武器提供强化的填装速度和操控性。

desc.en: Dealing damage with your weapons temporarily grants enhanced sliding. Sliding provides damage resistance.
desc.zh: 用武器造成伤害会在短时间内提供强化滑行。滑行时会获得伤害抗性。

desc.en: Stunning a Champion further refills your magazine, triggers health regeneration, and further improves recovery for a short duration.
desc.zh: 眩晕一名勇士可进一步装填弹匣，触发生命值回复并在短时间内进一步提升恢复效果。

desc.en: Faster ready and stow speed for Machine Guns.
desc.zh: 提高机枪的收举速度。

desc.en: Kills increase this weapon's damage until it is stowed or reloaded.
desc.zh: 完成击杀可提高此武器的伤害，效果持续至切换或填装武器。

desc.en: Reviving allies or defeating combatants with finishers reloads this weapon and readies an emergency ammo refill for the next time this weapon runs out of ammo.
desc.zh: 复活盟友或使用终结技击败战斗人员可填装此武器，并为下次此武器耗尽弹药时储备一次紧急弹药填充。

desc.en: Rapid [Arc] Arc weapon precision hits consume an Armor Charge to trigger a blinding burst at the target's location.
desc.zh: 快速电弧武器精准命中会消耗一层护甲充能，在目标位置触发一次致盲爆发。

desc.en: When using a Grenade Launcher, damaging a boss, damaging a Champion, or breaking a combatant's shield reloads your stowed weapons and weakens the combatant.
desc.zh: 当使用榴弹发射器的时候，对首领造成伤害、对勇士造成伤害、或打破战斗人员的护盾将填装你收起的武器并削弱战斗人员。

desc.en:
While Devour is active, [Void] Void weapon final blows have a chance to generate a Void Breach.

Picking up a Void Breach increases weapon reload and handling; Shotguns and Grenade Launchers are also reloaded from reserves.
desc.zh:
吞食生效时，虚空武器最后一击有几率生成一个虚空裂口。

拾取虚空裂口可提升武器填装和操控性；霰弹枪和榴弹发射器也会从备弹中填装。

desc.en:
The first time you break a target's shield or break the shield of a Guardian using their Super, you create an Orb of Power.

Collecting an Elemental pickup, collecting an Orb of Power, or destroying a Tangle grants you a small amount of health.
desc.zh:
你首次击破目标的护盾，或击破使用超能的守护者的护盾时，会生成一个能量球。

收集元素拾取物、能量球，或是摧毁缠结会为你提供少量生命值。

desc.en: While you have Frost Armor, taking critical damage releases a burst that freezes nearby combatants and grants Frost Armor to you and nearby allies.
desc.zh: 拥有冰霜护甲时，受到暴击伤害会释放爆发冻结附近的战斗人员，并为你和附近的盟友提供冰霜护甲。

desc.en:
Finishers emit a damaging wave that matches the element of your currently equipped Super.

Arc, Void, and Stasis waves apply Blind, Weaken, and Slow respectively.
desc.zh:
终结技会释放一道与当前已装备超能元素相匹配的伤害波。

电弧、虚空和冰影伤害波分别施加致盲、削弱和减速。

desc.en: Shattering [Stasis] Stasis crystals releases shards of ice that damage and slow targets.
desc.zh: 击碎冰影水晶会释放出伤害并减慢目标速度的冰影碎片。

desc.en: Increases detonation damage as the projectile travels farther before exploding. Increases blast radius.
desc.zh: 随着射弹在爆炸前飞得越远，造成的爆炸伤害就越高。扩大爆炸范围。

desc.en:
Final blows grant Bolt Charge.
While amplified, final blows grant additional Bolt Charge. 
Gain increased Bolt Charge stacks when you have none.
desc.zh:
最后一击会提供电光充能。
处于增幅状态时，最后一击会提供额外的电光充能。
没有电光充能时，获得的电光充能层数提升。

desc.en: Defeating an unraveled combatant grants grenade ability energy. If you have max grenade energy, you are granted Special ammo meter progress instead.
desc.zh: 击败被瓦解的战斗人员会提供手雷技能能量。如果你的手雷能量已充满，则获得特殊弹药量表进度。

desc.en: Activating your grenade or the Nanotech Tracer Missiles Origin Trait provides stacking resistance to incoming damage at point-blank range.
desc.zh: 激活手雷或纳米技术追踪导弹原始特性会为近距离来袭伤害提供可叠加的抗性。

desc.en:
Final blows grant stacks.
[Alternate Weapon Action]  : Refresh abilities.
desc.zh:
最后一击可叠加层数。
[替换武器动作]  ： 刷新技能。

desc.en: Black Armory weapon final blows briefly grant ammo generation, reload speed, and damage against combatants when the weapon is redrawn. Buff potency and duration increases for each equipped Black Armory weapon.
desc.zh: 黑色军械库武器最后一击会在武器再次被举起时短暂提供弹药生成、填装速度和对战斗人员的伤害。装备的每一件黑色军械库武器都会提升增益的强度和持续时间。

desc.en: Gain aim assist, stability, and flinch resistance while you have Woven Mail, Frost Armor, or Void Overshield.
desc.zh: 当你拥有织造铠甲、冰霜护甲或虚空覆盖护盾时，获得瞄准辅助、稳定性和抖动抗性。

desc.en: Bullseye Bolster
desc.zh: 靶心加固

desc.en: Picking up Heavy ammo also grants increased ammo to this weapon.
desc.zh: 拾取重型弹药会为此武器提供更多弹药。

desc.en: Build up blight to fire Seekers.
desc.zh: 积攒凋零阴影，发射追踪弹。

desc.en: With no augment, you gain a bonus to Resilience and Recovery, and your class ability recharges faster.
desc.zh: 没有增益时，你获得韧性和恢复加成，你的职业技能充能速度提升。

desc.en: Final blows with area-of-effect damage, Solar abilities, Seventh Seraph weapons, or IKELOS weapons grant Warmind Charges. Each stack of Warmind Charge increases your Weapons and Grenade stats.
desc.zh: 范围效果伤害、烈日技能、第七炽天使武器或似像者武器最后一击提供战争思维充能。每层战争思维充能都会提升你的武器和手雷属性。

desc.en:
While you have Warmind Charges, defeating powerful combatants, destroying a construct, or destroying a Tangle releases a Solar detonation that damages combatants and heals allies.

Constructs include barricades, turrets, Stasis crystals, and other objects created in the field.
desc.zh:
持有战争思维充能时，击败强力战斗人员、摧毁构造体，或摧毁缠结会释放一次烈日爆炸，对战斗人员造成伤害并治疗盟友。

构造体包括屏障、炮台、冰影水晶以及其他在战场上生成的物体。

desc.en: Generate Gunsmith telemetry data on Void weapon kills.
desc.zh: 在虚空武器击杀时生成枪匠遥测数据。

desc.en:
Uninterrupted fire from your equipped Auto Rifles and Submachine Guns grants bullets that stun combatants, delaying ability energy regeneration and lowering combatant damage output.

Strong against [Disruption] Overload Champions.
desc.zh:
使用装备的自动步枪和微型冲锋枪不间断开火可以射出眩晕战斗人员的子弹，延缓其技能能量回复并降低伤害输出。

克制过载勇士。

desc.en: Your decaying Armor Charge has a longer duration.
desc.zh: 延长护甲充能衰减时的持续时间。

desc.en: Withering Blade creates Stasis crystals.
desc.zh: 枯萎之刃会生成冰影水晶。

desc.en: Adds a Solar sigil to your transmat effects.
desc.zh: 为你的传送效果添加一个烈日印记。

desc.en: Final blows build and store charges which allow you to swap and stow this weapon at a faster rate.
desc.zh: 最后一击会储存多股能量，使你切换和收举此武器的速度增加。

desc.en: A luminous concentration of [Solar] Solar energy. When picked up, Firesprites grant grenade energy.
desc.zh: 烈日能量的发光浓缩物。当被拾取时，焰灵会赋予手雷能量。

desc.en:
When a frozen target is shattered, they take damage and deal damage to nearby targets. 

Shatter damage causes [Stagger] Unstoppable Champions to be stunned.
desc.zh:
当被冻结的目标碎裂时，将会受到伤害，并对附近目标造成伤害。

碎裂伤害会使势不可挡勇士眩晕。

desc.en: You are fortified by layers of durable [Stasis] Stasis matter, reducing incoming damage. Frost Armor damage resistance grows stronger as you gain additional stacks.
desc.zh: 你被数层坚韧的冰影物质强化，受到的伤害将减少。冰霜护甲叠加越多，你的伤害抗性就越强。

desc.en:
Your weapons are enhanced by the power of the Traveler and deal increased damage to combatants. 

While you are radiant, your weapons pierce the shields of [Shield-Piercing] Barrier Champions and stun them.
desc.zh:
你的武器因旅行者的力量获得了强化，可对战斗人员造成更高的伤害。

当你进入焕光状态时，你的武器会穿透屏障勇士的护盾并使其眩晕。

desc.en:
You resonate in perfect harmony with Light and Darkness. You gain increased ability regeneration, increased weapon damage, and damage resistance against combatants.

Your grenade is replaced with a unique Prismatic grenade that combines multiple damage types. Defeating targets while Transcendent extends its duration.
desc.zh:
你跟光能与暗影完美和谐地共鸣。你获得了更快的技能回复、更高的武器伤害以及对战斗人员的伤害抗性。

你的手雷已被替换为融合了多种伤害类型的独特棱镜手雷。处于超凡状态时击败目标可延长其持续时间。

desc.en: Exotic gear and catalyst quests.
desc.zh: 异域装备和催化任务。

desc.en: Vanguard, Crucible, and Gambit quests.
desc.zh: 先锋、熔炉竞技场与智谋任务。

desc.en:
Combatants are disoriented and cannot fire their weapons. Opposing Guardians' HUD is removed and their vision is obscured.

When blinded, [Stagger] Unstoppable Champions are stunned.
desc.zh:
使战斗人员失去方向感，无法用武器开火。敌对守护者的HUD在此状态下会消失，且视线会受阻。

被致盲时，势不可挡勇士会眩晕。

desc.en: Quests related to New Light tutorials and introductions.
desc.zh: 与新曙光相关的任务、教程和简介。

desc.en: You vanish from sight and do not appear on radar. While invisible, your radar range is reduced. Performing offensive actions will end invisibility.
desc.zh: 你将从视线中消失，不会出现在雷达上。隐身时，你的雷达范围会缩小。发起进攻会终止隐身。

desc.en:
The target is permeated with destructive [Strand] Strand matter. As they take additional damage, they create unraveled projectiles that seek out nearby targets.

Unraveling Rounds from your [Strand] Strand weapons pierce the shields of [Shield-Piercing] Barrier Champions and stun them.

Unraveled targets unwind into a Tangle when defeated.
desc.zh:
目标身上充满着毁灭性的缚丝物质。当其受到额外伤害时，会生成瓦解射弹，搜寻附近的目标。

缚丝武器的瓦解弹药可穿透屏障勇士的护盾并眩晕他们。

瓦解的目标被击败时会解绕为一个缠结。

desc.en:
The target is singed by destructive [Solar] Solar Light, taking damage over time. Scorch damage increases as the target accumulates more Scorch stacks.

After enough Scorch stacks are applied to the target, they ignite.
desc.zh:
目标被毁灭性的烈日光能烧焦，随时间不断受到伤害。灼烧伤害随着目标累积更多灼烧层数而增加。

对目标施加足够的灼烧层数后，会将其点燃。

desc.en: No Time Filters
desc.zh: 无时间过滤

desc.en: Darkness debuffs include [Stasis] Slow, [Stasis] Freeze, [Strand] Sever, [Strand] Suspend, and [Strand] Unravel.
desc.zh: 暗影减益包括减速、冻结、割裂、悬停以及瓦解。

desc.en:
A knot of [Strand] Strand matter, swirling with potential. Tangles can be shot and destroyed, or picked up and thrown, dealing damage.

Defeating targets afflicted by any [Strand] Strand debuff will unwind them and create a Tangle.
desc.zh:
一团缚丝物质的结节，带着电势旋转着。缠结可被射击或摧毁，或被拾取并投掷来造成伤害。

消灭受到任何缚丝减益效果影响的目标会将其解绕并生成一个缠结。

desc.en: Darkness buffs include [Stasis] Frost Armor and [Strand] Woven Mail.
desc.zh: 暗影增益包括冰霜护甲和织造铠甲。

desc.en: The metric data from the current Season.
desc.zh: 当前赛季的统计数据。

desc.en: The metric data from the current week.
desc.zh: 本周的统计数据。

desc.en: Quests from past expansions.
desc.zh: 来自之前扩展的任务。

desc.en: You are armored with a protective barrier of [Void] Void Light. Reduces damage taken from combatants.
desc.zh: 你将身披保护性的虚空光能屏障。可减少来自战斗人员的伤害。

desc.en:
The target's connections to the world around them are cut, and their outgoing damage is significantly reduced.

Severed targets unwind into a Tangle when defeated.
desc.zh:
目标与周围世界的联系被切断，其造成的伤害显著降低。

割裂的目标被消灭时会解绕为一个缠结。

desc.en:
The target is taken out of any active abilities and cannot activate any abilities or movement modes while suppression persists. Afflicted combatants cannot fire their weapons.

When suppressed, [Disruption] Overload Champions are stunned.
desc.zh:
当压制效果持续时，目标将被移除任何主动技能，并且无法激活任何技能或移动模式。被影响的战斗人员将无法发射他们的武器。

被压制时，过载勇士会眩晕。

desc.en:
The target is immobilized by a web of [Strand] Strand matter, lifting them into the air. While suspended, Guardians are unable to move freely, combatants are unable to move or fire their weapon, and [Stagger] Unstoppable Champions are stunned.

Suspended targets unwind into a Tangle when defeated.
desc.zh:
目标被一张缚丝物质网定身，将其举到空中。处于悬停状态时，守护者无法自由行动，战斗人员无法移动或开火，而势不可挡勇士会被眩晕。

悬停的目标被击败时会解绕为一个缠结。

desc.en: Light buffs include [Arc] Amplified, [Arc] Bolt Charge, [Solar] Cure, [Solar] Radiant, [Solar] Restoration, [Void] Devour, [Void] Invisibility, and [Void] Overshield.
desc.zh: 光能增益包括增幅、 电光充能治愈、焕光、恢复、吞食、隐身以及覆盖护盾。

desc.en: A creature woven from pure Strand matter that seeks nearby targets and attacks, dealing damage.
desc.zh: 一种由纯缚丝物质编织而成的生物，会寻找附近的目标并发动攻击，造成伤害。

desc.en: Quests from the latest expansion.
desc.zh: 来自最近扩展的任务。

desc.en:
Accumulate stacks of Arc Bolt Charge. While you have Bolt Charge, sustained weapon damage generates stacks of Bolt Charge. At maximum stacks, any ability damage generates a powerful bolt of Arc lightning at the target's location.

Receiving a stack of Bolt Charge grants you melee energy.
desc.zh:
叠加电弧电光充能层数。当你拥有电光充能时，持续的武器伤害会生成电光充能层数。达到最大层数时，任何技能伤害都会在目标位置生成一道强大的电弧闪电。

获取电光充能层数时会得到近战能量。

desc.en:
The target is trapped in [Stasis] Stasis matter and is unable to move.

After taking additional damage while frozen, the target shatters.
desc.zh:
目标将被困在冰影物质中，无法移动。

在冻结状态下受到额外伤害后，目标将会碎裂。

desc.en: Light debuffs include [Arc] Blind, [Arc] Jolt, [Solar] Scorch, [Solar] Ignitions, [Void] Suppression, [Void] Volatile, and [Void] Weaken.
desc.zh: 光能减益包括致盲、震颤、灼烧、点燃、压制、不稳定以及削弱。

desc.en: Feast on the energy of your defeated foes. Final blows restore health, grant grenade energy, and extend Devour.
desc.zh: 吞食你击败的敌人的能量。最后一击将回血，获得手雷能量，并延长吞食时间。

desc.en: Your body is encased in a protective mesh of tightly woven [Strand] Strand matter, greatly reducing any incoming non-precision damage.
desc.zh: 你的身体被禁锢在一层紧密编织的缚丝物质保护网中，会大幅减少任何非精准伤害。

desc.en:
The target is energized with destructive [Arc] Arc Light. They take additional damage while jolted and chain lightning to nearby targets.

Jolt damage causes [Disruption] Overload Champions to be stunned.
desc.zh:
使目标被毁灭性的电弧光能充能。被震颤的目标会受到额外伤害，并向周围的目标释放连锁闪电。

震颤伤害会使过载勇士眩晕。

desc.en: You are healed in a burst of mending [Solar] Solar Light.
desc.zh: 你在一束修复烈日光能中痊愈了。

desc.en: A large [Solar] Solar explosion which deals damage in an area around the target and stuns [Stagger] Unstoppable Champions.
desc.zh: 可对目标周围区域造成伤害的大型烈日爆炸，并使势不可挡勇士眩晕。

desc.en:
Your movement speed and weapon handling are greatly increased. After sprinting for a short time, your movement speed is further increased.

Rapidly defeating targets with [Arc] Arc damage makes you amplified.
desc.zh:
你的移动速度和武器操控性大大增强。短时间冲刺后，你的移动速度会进一步提高。

用电弧伤害快速击败目标便可进入增幅状态。

desc.en: A dimensional rupture teeming with [Void] Void energy. When picked up, Void Breaches grant class ability energy.
desc.zh: 充满虚空能量的次元破裂。当被拾取时，虚空裂口会提供职业技能能量。

desc.en: The target takes increased damage and has their movement speed slowed.
desc.zh: 目标将承受额外伤害并减缓移动速度。

desc.en:
A crystal of solidified [Stasis] Stasis matter. Upon creation, freezes nearby combatants and slows nearby players.

Crystals can be destroyed, dealing damage in an area.
desc.zh:
某种凝固冰影物质的结晶。生成后，可冻结附近的战斗人员并减速附近玩家。

结晶可被摧毁，在区域内造成伤害。

desc.en: You regenerate health and shields over time. Cannot be interrupted by taking damage.
desc.zh: 你会随时间逐渐恢复生命值和护盾。不会因受到伤害而被打断。

desc.en: Quests from the current Season.
desc.zh: 来自当前赛季的任务。

desc.en: A bolt of pure [Arc] Arc energy that travels along the ground, seeking toward its creator. When picked up, Ionic Traces grant ability energy.
desc.zh: 由纯电弧能量构成的闪电，沿着地面移动，追寻它的创造者。当被拾起时，离子轨迹会赋予技能能量。

desc.en: A small shard of [Stasis] Stasis matter that can be collected to restore melee energy.
desc.zh: 某种小块冰影物质，可进行收集以恢复近战能量。

desc.en:
The target is afflicted with unstable [Void] Void energy and will explode upon taking additional damage. 

Volatile Rounds from your [Void] Void weapons pierce the shields of [Shield-Piercing] Barrier Champions and stun them.
desc.zh:
目标受不稳定虚空能量影响，在受到额外伤害时产生爆炸。

你的虚空武器射出的不稳定弹药会穿透屏障勇士的护盾并使其眩晕。

desc.en: Quests from the current Season.
desc.zh: 来自当前赛季的任务。

desc.en:
The target has slowed movement and ability regeneration; their weapon performance is reduced. [Disruption] Overload Champions are stunned.

After accumulating enough Slow stacks, the target is frozen.
desc.zh:
目标的移速、技能回复速度将减缓；武器性能降低。过载勇士会眩晕。

积累足够多的减速层数后，目标将被冻结。

desc.en: Career metric data where available.
desc.zh: 可用的职业生涯统计数据。
